nicknameZh: 雨林电光蓝宝石
nicknameEn: Electric Blue Jewel of the Rainforest
length: 翼展 12 - 20 cm (雨林中最大的蝴蝶之一)
lifespan: 成虫约 2 - 3 周 (幼虫阶段约 3 - 4 个月)
food: 熟透发酵的热带水果汁液 (香蕉/芒果/树汁)
habitat: 中南美洲热带雨林、树冠层与溪流两岸
speed: 林间滑翔约 15 km/h
overviewZh: 大蓝闪蝶是世界上最著名的美丽蝴蝶！翅膀表面具有神奇的“物理结构色”，在阳光下会绽放出夺目耀眼的金属电光蓝，犹如一颗在雨林中穿梭飞舞的璀璨蓝宝石。
overviewEn: The Blue Morpho is one of the most magnificent butterflies on Earth! Its wings feature dazzling structural physical color that reflects brilliant metallic electric blue in sunlight.

bodyParts.descZh: 巨大的前翅折射出极高饱和度的金属钴蓝色光芒，边缘点缀着黑丝绒边框与白色波浪花纹。
bodyParts.descEn: Massive forewings shimmering with radiant metallic cobalt-blue iridescence edged by velvet-black borders.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 前翅的蓝色其实并不是色素，而是纳米鳞片对光波干涉产生的“物理结构色”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Its blue color comes from structural interference on nano-scales rather than pigment!

bodyParts.pinyin: jiàn biàn hú xíng hòu chì
bodyParts.descZh: 波浪扇形边缘的后翅，蓝色光泽从天蓝自然渐变到深宝蓝，提供平稳而优雅的滑翔升力。
bodyParts.descEn: Scalloped hindwings displaying a lush gradient from cyan to royal blue, providing smooth gliding lift.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 合拢双翅时，翅背的褐色枯叶纹理能让它瞬间隐身在树干上。
bodyParts.funFactEn: When closed, the brown underside camouflages the butterfly against tree bark.

bodyParts.descZh: 放大 400 倍！像瓦片一样排列的多层纳米阶梯鳞片，专门干涉反射纯蓝光波。
bodyParts.descEn: Magnified 400x! Overlapping nanoscale ridge scales that physically reflect pure blue light waves.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 科学家正模仿闪蝶鳞片结构，研发无需染料、永不褪色的环保色彩材料与防伪钞票技术。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Scientists mimic morpho wing scales to build dye-free structural colors and anti-counterfeit tech.

bodyParts.descZh: 翅膀背面长有像猫头鹰眼睛一样的一圈圈大眼斑，能在危险时刻威慑掠食小鸟。
bodyParts.descEn: Concentric circular eyespots along the wing underside that mimic owl eyes to scare away birds.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 闪烁的亮蓝与褐底眼斑交替出现，会让追捕的鸟类产生视觉错觉而飞偏方向。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Alternating bright blue flashes and brown eyespots confuse pursuing birds mid-flight.

bodyParts.descZh: 平时像弹簧卷尺一样盘在脸下，吸食发酵香蕉、芒果汁液时像吸管一样伸展出来。
bodyParts.descEn: A straw-like coiled proboscis that unrolls to sip fermented fruit juices and tree sap.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 和偏爱花蜜的蝴蝶不同，大蓝闪蝶更喜欢吃落地发酵的热带水果汁！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike flower-sipping butterflies, Blue Morphos prefer fermenting tropical fruit juices!

bodyParts.descZh: 头顶两根细长的黑色触角，末端稍微变粗，能嗅探到几百米外热带熟透水果的香气。
bodyParts.descEn: Slender black antennae with thickened tips that sniff out sweet fruit aromas from far away.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 棒状触角不仅用来闻味道，还能在飞行中感知气流速度与身体平衡。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Clubbed antennae detect scents as well as airflow speed and balance during flight.

bodyParts.descZh: 由成千上万个六角形小眼组成的大黑眼睛，对紫外线和闪烁的蓝光极其敏感。
bodyParts.descEn: Large faceted compound eyes made of thousands of lenses, finely tuned to UV and flashing blue light.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蓝闪蝶飞行时闪烁的金属蓝信号，可以被同伴在雨林上空几百米外识别。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Flashing blue wing signals can be spotted by other morphos from hundreds of meters away.

bodyParts.descZh: 密布深褐色保暖绒毛的强劲胸部，内部包裹着驱动巨大双翅强力扑打的肌肉群。
bodyParts.descEn: A furry dark thorax packed with powerful flight muscles that drive its massive flapping wings.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 清晨阳光刚照进雨林时，闪蝶会展开蓝翅晒太阳给胸部肌肉“热身”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Morphos bask in morning sunbeams to warm up the flight muscles inside their thorax.

bodyParts.descZh: 细长的小腿末端长有味觉感应细毛，只要脚掌一踩在水果表面，就能立刻“尝”到甜味！
bodyParts.descEn: Slender legs equipped with chemical sensors on the feet that taste food the moment they land.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蝴蝶用脚“品尝”味道的灵敏度比人类舌头还要高出许多倍！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A butterfly's feet taste sweetness far more sensitively than a human tongue!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于双翅中间的细长深色腹部，两侧排列着微小呼吸孔（气门），储存能量。
bodyParts.descEn: The slender segmented dark underbelly housing internal organs and lateral breathing spiracles.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 昆虫不用鼻子肺部呼吸，而是靠腹部两侧成对的微型气门直接交换氧气。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Instead of lungs, butterflies breathe through tiny spiracles along their abdomen.

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大蓝闪蝶翅膀璀璨的电光蓝色，主要来自哪个纳米级结构？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which nanoscale structure gives the Blue Morpho its electric blue color?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！多层纳米阶梯鳞片通过光波干涉反射纯蓝光，这就是神奇的物理结构色。
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Multilayered nanoscale ridges reflect pure blue light via optical interference.

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大蓝闪蝶停在熟透的水果上时，用哪个部位瞬间“尝”出甜味？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which part lets the Blue Morpho instantly taste ripe fruit upon landing?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对了！蝴蝶脚掌末端长满味觉感应细毛，一踩上果汁就能立刻“尝”出味道。
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Well done! Sensory hairs on its feet allow it to taste fruit the instant it lands.

quizQuestions.promptZh: 当大蓝闪蝶合拢双翅休息时，翅膀背面的什么图案能吓退小鸟？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What pattern on the closed wings helps scare away hungry birds?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！像猫头鹰眼睛一样的防身眼斑能威慑捕食者，配合枯叶配色隐身保护自己。
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Owl-like eyespots deter predators while brown undersides blend into tree bark.

nicknameZh: 空中的捕猎高手
nicknameEn: The Aerial Hunter
lifespan: 成虫约 1-2 个月 (幼虫在水中生活数年)
food: 蚊子、苍蝇等小型飞行昆虫
habitat: 池塘、湖泊、溪流
speed: 最高可达 50 km/h
overviewZh: 蜻蜓是地球上最敏捷的空中猎手之一，拥有3亿年的进化历史。它们不仅能高速向前飞行，还能在空中悬停、倒退甚至翻滚。
overviewEn: Dragonflies are among the most agile aerial hunters on Earth with a 300-million-year evolutionary history. They can hover, fly backwards, and even do flips in the air.

bodyParts.descZh: 由成千上万个小眼组成，视野广阔，能快速发现猎物。
bodyParts.descEn: Made up of thousands of tiny eyes, giving a wide field of view and helping detect prey quickly.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜻蜓的复眼几乎占据了整个头部，几乎拥有 360 度的全景视野！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A dragonfly's compound eyes cover almost its whole head, giving nearly 360-degree vision!

bodyParts.descZh: 短小细弱，用于感知气味和周围环境。
bodyParts.descEn: Short and thin, used to sense smells and the surrounding environment.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜻蜓主要依靠超强视力捕猎，所以触角退化得非常短小。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Because dragonflies rely so much on vision, their antennae are tiny compared to other insects.

bodyParts.descZh: 有两对透明翅膀，翅脉清晰，飞行灵活。
bodyParts.descEn: Two pairs of transparent wings with clear veins, allowing agile flight.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 前后两对翅膀可以独立拍打，这使它们能够做出各种高难度的空中特技！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Front and rear wings can flap independently, enabling incredible acrobatic maneuvers!

bodyParts.descZh: 翅膀前缘的深色斑块，帮助蜻蜓在飞行时保持平衡。
bodyParts.descEn: The dark patch on the leading edge of the wing helps with balance during flight.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 翅痣就像飞机机翼上的配重块，可以消除高速俯冲时的剧烈震颤。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Pterostigma acts like a counterweight on aircraft wings, eliminating harmful vibrations.

bodyParts.descZh: 咀嚼式口器，用于捕捉并咬食猎物。
bodyParts.descEn: Chewing mouthparts used to bite and eat prey.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜻蜓的上下颚非常有力，甚至可以在飞行过程中直接将猎物撕碎吞下。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Their jaws are so strong they can tear and eat prey while staying in mid-air!

bodyParts.descZh: 胸部强壮，控制飞行和足的运动。
bodyParts.descEn: The strong thorax controls flight and leg movement.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 胸部内部充满了强韧的肌肉纤维，占到了蜻蜓体重的绝大部分。
bodyParts.funFactEn: The thorax is packed with flight muscles, making up the bulk of its body mass.

bodyParts.descZh: 足有刺毛，便于抓住猎物和停留。
bodyParts.descEn: Legs have spines that help catch prey and perch.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜻蜓的六条腿形成了一个“捕猎篮”，但它们几乎不能用来在地上行走。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Their legs form a "basket" to trap prey, but they cannot walk on the ground.

bodyParts.descZh: 腹部细长，由多个体节组成。
bodyParts.descEn: The long abdomen is made up of many segments.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 细长的腹部就像方向舵，在飞行中提供出色的气动稳定性和转向力矩。
bodyParts.funFactEn: The slender abdomen acts like a rudder, providing aerodynamic stability during flight.

bodyParts.descZh: 腹部末端有附器，用于交配和产卵。
bodyParts.descEn: The tip has appendages used for mating and laying eggs.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 我们常说的“蜻蜓点水”，其实是雌性蜻蜓在把卵轻轻产在水面上或水生植物上。
bodyParts.funFactEn: When dragonflies tap the water surface, they are actually laying eggs!

bodyParts.descZh: 头顶有三只单眼，感知光线强弱，帮助维持飞行平衡。
bodyParts.descEn: Three ocelli on the top of the head sense light intensity and help maintain flight balance.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 单眼反应速度极快，能在千分之几秒内察觉天际线与光线角度的变化。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Ocelli react in milliseconds to detect horizon and light angle shifts for instant stabilization.

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Compound Eyes (复眼)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Compound Eyes
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！复眼由数万只小眼构成，能看清几乎 360 度的广阔视野！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Compound eyes are made of thousands of tiny eyes for a wide field of view!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 蜻蜓翅膀前缘的小黑斑被称为什么？它有什么神奇作用？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What is the dark patch on the wing leading edge called? What does it do?

options.textZh: 翅痣 (Pterostigma) - 保持平衡与减震

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！翅痣就像小重锤，防止翅膀在高速飞行中剧烈震动。
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Pterostigma prevents wing vibration during high-speed gliding.

quizQuestions.promptZh: “蜻蜓点水”其实是蜻蜓的哪个部位在水面产卵？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which part touches water when dragonflies tap the surface to lay eggs?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！雌性蜻蜓通过腹部末端的产卵器将卵安全安置在水中。
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Female dragonflies use the abdominal tip to lay eggs in water.

nicknameZh: 热带雨林中的电光蓝宝石
nicknameEn: The Electric Blue Jewel of the Rainforest
length: 翼展 12 - 20 cm (雨林中最大的蝴蝶之一)
lifespan: 成虫约 2 - 3 周 (幼虫阶段约 3 - 4 个月)
food: 熟透发酵的热带水果汁液 (香蕉/芒果/树汁)
habitat: 中南美洲热带雨林、树冠层与溪流两岸
speed: 扑翼飞行闪烁蓝光，反射光 1 公里外清晰可见
overviewZh: 大蓝闪蝶是世界上最著名的美丽蝴蝶！翅膀表面具有神奇的“物理结构色”，在阳光下会绽放出夺目耀眼的金属电光蓝，犹如一颗在雨林中穿梭飞舞的璀璨蓝宝石。
overviewEn: The Blue Morpho is one of the most magnificent butterflies on Earth! Its wings feature dazzling structural physical color that reflects brilliant metallic electric blue in sunlight.

bodyParts.descZh: 巨大的前翅折射出极高饱和度的金属钴蓝色光芒，边缘点缀着黑丝绒边框与白色波浪花纹。
bodyParts.descEn: Massive forewings shimmering with radiant metallic cobalt-blue iridescence edged by velvet-black borders.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大蓝闪蝶的蓝色并不是真正的蓝色颜料，哪怕把翅膀泡在水里，它依然闪耀着电光蓝！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The blue color contains zero blue pigment—it comes from physical light reflection!

bodyParts.descZh: 波浪扇形边缘的后翅，蓝色光泽从天蓝自然渐变到深宝蓝，提供平稳而优雅的滑翔升力。
bodyParts.descEn: Scalloped hindwings displaying a lush gradient from cyan to royal blue, providing smooth gliding lift.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 当它们在树冠上飞行时，翅膀一开一合会产生“闪光灯”一样的视觉错觉，让天敌根本无法瞄准！
bodyParts.funFactEn: As they flap their wings, the rapid blue flashes confuse flying predators in mid-air!

bodyParts.descZh: 放大 200 倍！像瓦片一样排列的多层纳米阶梯鳞片，专门干涉反射纯蓝光波。
bodyParts.descEn: Magnified 200x! Overlapping nanoscale ridge scales that physically reflect pure blue light waves.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 科学家模仿大蓝闪蝶的翅膀纳米结构，发明了永远不褪色的无颜料环保显示屏！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Scientists mimic the nanoscale wing structure to create pigment-free, non-fading optical screens!

bodyParts.descZh: 翅膀边缘与背面长有像猫头鹰眼睛一样的一圈圈大眼斑，合上翅膀时就像枯树皮一样隐形。
bodyParts.descEn: Concentric circular eyespots along the wing edges that mimic owl eyes to scare away birds.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大蓝闪蝶合上翅膀后就像一片枯叶，捕食者完全找不到它，一打开又瞬间光芒万丈！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When closed, wings look like dry dead leaves; opening them unleashes a blinding burst of blue!

bodyParts.pinyin: juǎn qū hóng xī kǒu qì
bodyParts.descZh: 平时像弹簧卷尺一样盘在脸下，吸食发酵香蕉、芒果汁液时像吸管一样伸展出来。
bodyParts.descEn: A straw-like coiled proboscis that unrolls to sip fermented fruit juices and tree sap.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大蓝闪蝶不怎么喜欢采花蜜，它们最喜欢吃掉在地上发酵变甜的烂香蕉和芒果！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Blue morphos rarely visit flowers; they feast eagerly on sweet fermented fallen rainforest fruits!

bodyParts.descZh: 头顶两根细长的黑色触角，末端稍微变粗，能嗅探到几百米外热带熟透水果的香气。
bodyParts.descEn: Slender black antennae with thickened tips that sniff out sweet fruit aromas from far away.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 触角上的微观化学感受器灵敏度是人类鼻子的几千倍，隔着密林就能找到食物！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Chemoreceptors on their antennae are thousands of times more sensitive than a human nose!

bodyParts.descZh: 由成千上万个六角形小眼组成的大黑眼睛，对紫外线和闪烁的蓝光极其敏感。
bodyParts.descEn: Large faceted compound eyes made of thousands of lenses, finely tuned to UV and flashing blue light.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大蓝闪蝶的复眼能看到人类看不到的紫外线波段，用来在树冠层远距离辨认同伴！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Their eyes can detect ultraviolet patterns invisible to humans, helping them spot mates across the forest!

bodyParts.descZh: 密布深褐色保暖绒毛的强劲胸部，内部包裹着驱动巨大双翅强力扑打的肌肉群。
bodyParts.descEn: A furry dark thorax packed with powerful flight muscles that drive its massive flapping wings.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大蓝闪蝶起飞前会像做热身运动一样轻微震颤胸部肌肉，让身体迅速升温！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Before takeoff, morphos shiver their thoracic muscles to warm up for powerful flight!

bodyParts.descZh: 细长的小腿末端长有味觉感应细毛，只要脚掌一踩在水果表面，就能立刻“尝”到甜味！
bodyParts.descEn: Slender legs equipped with chemical sensors on the feet that "taste" food the moment they land.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大蓝闪蝶是用“脚”来尝味道的！踩到好吃的甜汁才会把卷曲的嘴巴伸出来！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Blue morphos taste with their feet! They only uncoil their proboscis after their feet detect sugar!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于双翅中间的细长深色腹部，两侧排列着微小呼吸孔（气门），储存能量。
bodyParts.descEn: The slender segmented dark underbelly housing internal organs and lateral breathing spiracles.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蝴蝶没有肺，它们是通过腹部两侧微小的气门孔直接把氧气输送到全身细胞的！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Butterflies do not have lungs—they breathe through tiny spiracle pores along their abdomen!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Electric Blue Forewings (电光蓝前翅)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Electric Blue Forewings
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！巨大的电光蓝前翅反射出金属蓝宝石般的光芒，美极了！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The massive electric blue forewings reflect dazzling metallic iridescence!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大蓝闪蝶最神奇的“电光蓝”并不是颜料，而是因为哪个微观部位产生了物理结构反光？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Why do Blue Morpho wings flash blue? Which microscopic structure creates this physical effect?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太聪明了！微观多层纳米阶梯鳞片物理干涉反射蓝光，属于永不褪色的结构色！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Nanoscale ridge scales physically reflect blue light, creating unfading structural color!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大蓝闪蝶吃东西前，是用身体的哪个部位先去“品尝”热带发酵水果的甜味的？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part does the Blue Morpho use to "taste" sweet fruit when it lands?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真棒！蝴蝶脚掌上的化学感应器能直接品尝味道，确定甜了才伸出口器吸食！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Chemical sensors on their feet taste the sugars before the proboscis unrolls to drink!

nicknameZh: 昆虫界的举重冠军
nicknameEn: The Insect Weightlifting Champion
lifespan: 成虫 2-4 个月 (幼虫 8-10 个月)
food: 发酵橡树汁、熟透的水果
habitat: 温带及亚热带阔叶林、橡树栎树林
speed: 可举起自身体重 850 倍重物
overviewZh: 独角仙是昆虫界的“超级大力士”！雄性头上长着威风的 Y 型巨角，身披发亮的黑红硬甲，能举起相当于自身体重 850 倍的物体。
overviewEn: The Rhinoceros Beetle is the mighty weightlifter of the insect world! Males feature a magnificent forked head horn and shiny armor, capable of lifting 850 times their own body weight.

bodyParts.descZh: 雄虫最威风的标志！像一把大叉子，在争夺树汁领地时把对手掀翻抛飞。
bodyParts.descEn: The signature fork-like horn used by males in battles to flip rivals into the air.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 独角仙的角里没有骨头，它其实是坚硬外骨骼生长出来的超强战斗杠杆！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The horn is not made of bone—it is a heavy-duty extension of their hard chitin exoskeleton!

bodyParts.descZh: 长在胸部上方较短的前倾尖角，与头部的长角形成一个强有力的“大夹子”。
bodyParts.descEn: A shorter horn on the thorax that pairs with the head horn to clamp tightly onto opponents.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 头角和胸角配合，就像液压老虎钳一样能牢牢夹住并锁死挑战者！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Working together like a hydraulic clamp, both horns lock down tightly on rivals!

bodyParts.descZh: 长在头角两侧的黑色圆眼睛，由许多六角形小眼组成，适合夜间感知光线。
bodyParts.descEn: Glossy black eyes on the sides of the head made of tiny lenses, adapted for night vision.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 独角仙主要在夏天的夜间活动，它们的眼睛对微弱的月光和树影非常敏感。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Active mostly on summer nights, their eyes are finely tuned to faint moonlight and tree shadows.

bodyParts.descZh: 短短的触角末端有像小扇子一样的叶片，可以张开像雷达一样嗅闻甜甜的树汁香味。
bodyParts.descEn: Short antennae with fan-like tips that open up to sniff out sweet fermented tree sap.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 触角末端的小扇面张开时，能够捕捉几百米外橡树汁发酵的香甜气味！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When spread open, these tiny fan plates can smell sweet oak sap from hundreds of meters away!

bodyParts.descZh: 口器上长满了密密麻麻的金黄色细毛，专门用来舔食流淌的树汁。
bodyParts.descEn: Mouthparts lined with dense golden bristles designed to lap up sweet tree sap.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 独角仙不咬人，它们的嘴巴像温和的小毛刷一样刷取可口的汁液！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Rhinoceros beetles do not bite humans; their brush-like mouths gently lap up liquid sap!

bodyParts.descZh: 光滑坚硬的黑色胸部护甲，像一面发亮的重型盾牌，保护内部强劲的肌肉。
bodyParts.descEn: A shiny, armored plate that shields the powerful muscle-packed thorax beneath.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 前胸背板内部充满了驱动六足抓爬和双角发力的超级肌肉群！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Packed inside is an engine of dense muscles that power its legendary lifting force!

bodyParts.descZh: 背部两片厚重发亮的硬壳，完美保护着折叠在下方的娇嫩飞翼。
bodyParts.descEn: Hard, glossy dark chestnut-brown wing covers that shield the delicate flight wings beneath.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 鞘翅表面涂有一层天然蜡质，不仅防水耐磨，还能折射出漆光质感！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The elytra are coated in natural wax, making them waterproof and shiny like polished lacquer!

bodyParts.descZh: 平时像折纸一样折叠在硬壳下的透明薄翅膀，飞行时迅速展开并嗡嗡振动。
bodyParts.descEn: Large, transparent flight wings neatly folded origami-style beneath the hard armor.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 别看独角仙看起来笨重，展开大翅膀后它们在森林里飞行速度非常快！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Despite their heavy build, unfolded flight wings propel them through the forest with great speed!

bodyParts.descZh: 六条粗壮的腿上长有锋利的倒刺和小钩爪，像登山靴一样紧紧抓牢粗糙树皮。
bodyParts.descEn: Six robust legs armed with sharp spines and curved dual claws that lock onto tree bark.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 独角仙抓在树干上时，大人用力都很难把它拔下来，抓地力极其惊人！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Their hooked claws grip tree bark so strongly that even adults find them hard to pry off!

bodyParts.descZh: 身体后方由多个硬质体节构成的坚韧腹部，两侧带有呼吸空气的气门。
bodyParts.descEn: The sturdy segmented rear section of the body with respiratory pores along the sides.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 独角仙是用肚子两侧的小孔呼吸的，受到惊吓时还会排出气体发出“嘶嘶”威吓声！
bodyParts.funFactEn: They breathe through side pores and can hiss by forcing air out when threatened!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Y-shaped Head Horn (Y型头角)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Y-shaped Head Horn
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！雄性独角仙就是用这把威武的 Y 型头角把对手掀飞的！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Male beetles use this mighty Y-horn as a lever to toss rivals into the air!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 独角仙用来像扇子一样张开、嗅探几百米外甜甜树汁香味的器官是？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which fan-like organ helps the beetle smell sweet sap from hundreds of meters away?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！触角末端的小扇叶能展开极大地增加嗅觉感应面积。
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! The fan plates spread open to catch even faint scents of sweet fermented sap.

quizQuestions.promptZh: 独角仙虽然看起来笨重，但它隐藏在坚硬鞘翅下用来飞行的翅膀是？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which large transparent wings are hidden under the hard elytra for flying?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！膜质后翅折叠在鞘翅下方，展开后能提供强大的飞行升力！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! The membranous flight wings unfold from under the elytra for powerful flight!

nicknameZh: 花园里穿红裙的除害小卫士
nicknameEn: The Red-cloaked Garden Guardian
lifespan: 约 1 - 2 年 (成虫在枯叶下集群越冬)
food: 蚜虫、粉虱等农业害虫
habitat: 花园、农田、草地与灌木丛
speed: 飞行时速约 30 - 60 km/h (振翅可达每秒85次)
overviewZh: 七星瓢虫是农夫和园丁最好的昆虫朋友！鲜红色的半球形硬壳上点缀着 7 颗黑色圆斑，一只瓢虫一生能吃掉成千上万只祸害庄稼的蚜虫。
overviewEn: The Seven-spotted Ladybug is a gardener’s best friend! Sporting a vibrant scarlet dome with exactly seven black spots, a single ladybug can devour thousands of crop-damaging aphids.

bodyParts.descZh: 圆圆发亮的红色硬壳，上面正好有 7 颗黑色小圆点，警告捕食者“我很苦不好吃”。
bodyParts.descEn: A shiny scarlet domed shell with exactly seven black dots that warns predators: "I taste bad!"
bodyParts.funFactZh: 鞘翅上的 7 颗斑点并不代表年龄，而是一出生就固定好的物种身份证！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The seven spots do not show the ladybug’s age—they are a permanent species identifier from birth!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于头部后方的黑色护盾，两侧各有一块显眼的奶油白色三角斑块。
bodyParts.descEn: A black shield behind the head featuring two prominent creamy-white triangular patches on each side.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 前胸背板上的两块白斑看起来很像两只大眼睛，能吓退小鸟等捕食者！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The white patches on the pronotum look like giant fake eyes, scaring away hungry birds!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于头部两侧的黑色微观小眼睛，能敏锐感知光线强弱和周围的动静。
bodyParts.descEn: Faceted black eyes on the sides of the head that detect light levels and nearby movement.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 瓢虫的视力其实比较模糊，捕食蚜虫主要靠触角和气味引路！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Ladybugs have fairly blurry vision and rely heavily on antennae to smell and track aphids!

bodyParts.descZh: 短短的触角末端略微膨大像小木槌，用来闻气味和触摸周围环境。
bodyParts.descEn: Short antennae with knob-like tips used to smell, taste, and navigate the surrounding environment.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 瓢虫可以通过触角闻到蚜虫排泄出的“蜜露”甜味，准确找到食物聚集地！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Ladybugs can smell the sweet honeydew left behind by aphids, guiding them right to their next meal!

bodyParts.descZh: 灵活有力的小下颚，能够轻松夹住并咬碎多汁的蚜虫。
bodyParts.descEn: Strong and agile mandibles capable of easily grabbing and crunching through juicy aphids.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 一只成年七星瓢虫一天能嚼碎吃掉 50 到 100 只蚜虫！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A single adult seven-spotted ladybug can crunch through 50 to 100 aphids every single day!

bodyParts.descZh: 小巧的黑色头部，遇到危险时能迅速缩进前胸背板下方保护自己。
bodyParts.descEn: A compact black head that can tuck neatly under the protective pronotum shield when danger threatens.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 受到惊吓时，瓢虫不仅会把小脑袋缩起来，还会一动不动“装死”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When startled, ladybugs tuck in their heads, pull in their legs, and play dead!

bodyParts.descZh: 腿部关节处的神奇防线！受到惊吓时会渗出又黄又苦又臭的防御液体。
bodyParts.descEn: Special knee joints that ooze foul-smelling, bitter yellow drops of blood (reflex bleeding) to deter foes.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这滴黄色的苦水有毒素气味，小鸟只要尝过一次就再也不敢吃瓢虫了！
bodyParts.funFactEn: This bitter liquid tastes terrible to birds, teaching them never to attack a ladybug again!

bodyParts.descZh: 脚底长有成千上万根微小细毛，分泌天然微油，能倒挂在光滑的玻璃和叶片上。
bodyParts.descEn: Feet lined with thousands of microscopic adhesive hairs allowing them to walk upside down on smooth leaves.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 瓢虫脚掌上的纳米级细毛抓地力极强，就算大风吹也吹不掉！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Microscopic hairs on ladybug feet lock onto smooth plant wax, keeping them steady in strong winds!

bodyParts.descZh: 平时精密折叠在红色硬壳下面的透明大翅膀，飞行时迅速展开强劲扇动。
bodyParts.descEn: Large, transparent flight wings folded complexly under the red elytra that deploy rapidly for flight.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 瓢虫的飞翼折叠方式像高级折纸艺术，能在 0.1 秒内瞬间收进壳里！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A ladybug folds its flight wings like intricate origami, packing them away in less than 0.1 seconds!

bodyParts.descZh: 被红壳遮盖的黑色多节腹部，里面容纳消化系统和储存越冬能量的脂肪。
bodyParts.descEn: The black segmented underbelly shielded by the hard elytra, storing fat reserves for winter hibernation.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 秋天时瓢虫会在腹部储存厚厚的脂肪体，然后成百上千只抱团在一起冬眠！
bodyParts.funFactEn: In autumn, ladybugs pack their abdomens with fat reserves and huddle in giant clusters to hibernate!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Spotted Elytra (斑点鞘翅)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Spotted Elytra
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！斑点鞘翅不仅保护身体，鲜红的颜色还是警告敌人的警戒色！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! The bright red spotted elytra protect the insect and warn predators away!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 七星瓢虫受到惊吓时，会从哪个部位分泌又黄又苦的防御液体？
quizQuestions.promptEn: From which body part does a ladybug ooze bitter yellow fluid when threatened?

options.textZh: 防御分泌腺 / 膝关节 (Reflex Bleeding Glands)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！这种“反射性流血”分泌的苦味液体让小鸟再也不想吃它！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! This bitter reflex bleeding fluid tastes awful, teaching birds to avoid ladybugs!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 七星瓢虫能倒挂在光滑的玻璃或叶片上，是因为哪个部位长满了纳米级吸盘细毛？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part is lined with microscopic adhesive hairs for climbing smooth surfaces?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！附节吸盘爪上的纳米细毛能产生分子间吸附力，牢牢抓紧叶面！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Thousands of tiny tarsal hairs create strong grip on smooth plant leaves!

nicknameZh: 昆虫王国的绿色刀客与伏击大师
nicknameEn: The Ambush Master of the Green Forest
lifespan: 约 6 - 8 个月 (秋末产下卵鞘越冬)
food: 蝗虫、苍蝇、蟋蟀、蛾类等各类昆虫
habitat: 田野、灌木丛、草地与花园绿叶间
speed: 捕食瞬间出击仅需 0.05 秒
overviewZh: 螳螂是昆虫世界著名的肉食性“伏击大师”！它们拥有一对像大刀一样锋利的捕捉前足，身体呈翠绿或枯草褐色，静立在枝叶间与环境融为一体，一旦发现猎物便会以闪电般的速度精准夹获。
overviewEn: The Praying Mantis is a famous ambush hunter of the insect kingdom! Equipped with powerful scythe-like front legs and cryptic green camouflage, it stays motionless among leaves, striking at lightning speed when prey wanders close.

bodyParts.descZh: 像两把折叠的大砍刀，腿节内侧生有两排锋利的倒刺，用来在瞬间牢牢钳制住猎物。
bodyParts.descEn: Folded like sharp scythes with rows of interlocking spines, built to clamp down securely on struggling prey.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 螳螂出击抓捕猎物的速度比人类眨眼还要快数倍，猎物往往还未看清就已被捕获！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A praying mantis can strike and grab prey several times faster than a human blink!

bodyParts.descZh: 呈倒三角形的脑袋与细长前胸相连，颈部极其灵活，能够在不移动身体的情况下转动 180 度。
bodyParts.descEn: A flexible triangular head connected by a mobile neck joint, capable of swiveling 180 degrees without moving its body.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 螳螂是昆虫世界中极少数能够把头转向身后直接看东西的昆虫！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Mantises are among the only insects on Earth capable of rotating their heads to look directly behind them!

bodyParts.descZh: 两颗巨大凸出在头顶两侧的复眼，具备罕见的 3D 立体视觉，能够精确测算与猎物之间的距离。
bodyParts.descEn: Large bulging eyes on the sides of the head that provide rare 3D stereo vision to calculate exact strike distances.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 复眼中央总能看到一个跟着你转动的黑点，那是光线折射形成的“假瞳孔（Pseudopupil）”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The dark spot appearing in a mantis's eye isn't a real pupil, but an optical illusion called a pseudopupil!

bodyParts.descZh: 额头前方一对纤细如丝的触角，上面布满化学感受器，帮助探知空气中的气味与气流波动。
bodyParts.descEn: A pair of slender thread-like antennae covered in sensitive receptors to detect airborne smells and vibrations.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 雄性螳螂的触角比雌性更加修长，能更灵敏地捕捉到雌性释放的信息素信号。
bodyParts.funFactEn: Male mantises have longer and more sensitive antennae to track down female pheromones across long distances.

bodyParts.descZh: 隐藏在头部下方的咀嚼式口器，边缘坚硬锋利，像微型剪刀一样迅速切碎进食猎物。
bodyParts.descEn: Powerful cutting jaws beneath the head with serrated edges that act like sharp shears to consume prey.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大颚极为有力，甚至可以轻松咬穿甲虫坚硬的甲壳！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A mantis has jaws so strong it can easily slice right through tough beetle exoskeletons!

bodyParts.descZh: 长而优雅的颈部前胸，为前足提供了宽阔的挥动半径，使捕捉足能自由全方位出击。
bodyParts.descEn: A long neck-like segment that gives the raptorial arms immense reach and flexibility to strike in any direction.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 细长的前胸使螳螂能高高昂起上半身，摆出经典的“祈祷”警惕姿势。
bodyParts.funFactEn: This extended neck segment allows the mantis to raise its front body into the famous "praying" posture.

bodyParts.descZh: 中足与后足细长匀称，末端带有微小抓钩，能稳稳倒挂或攀爬在各种光滑的植物枝叶上。
bodyParts.descEn: Slender middle and hind legs tipped with tiny claws, allowing the mantis to grip and climb twigs effortlessly.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 四条步足虽然不参与捕猎，但能让螳螂在风中像树叶一样缓慢摇曳，完美隐蔽！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The walking legs sway rhythmically when moving, helping the mantis mimic a windblown leaf to stay hidden.

bodyParts.descZh: 前翅呈坚韧的革质绿色，覆盖在腹部上方充当伪装保护罩；后翅展开呈扇状，用于短距离滑翔飞行。
bodyParts.descEn: Leathery green forewings provide leafy camouflage over the back, while large fan-shaped hindwings allow flight.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 当遇到天敌受到威胁时，螳螂会猛然张开绚丽的双翅，发出嘶嘶声威吓敌人！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When threatened, a mantis spreads its wings wide and hisses to appear twice as large and scare predators away!

bodyParts.descZh: 由多个体节构成的翠绿色腹部，内含消化、呼吸气门与生殖器官，秋季雌性腹部会显著饱满。
bodyParts.descEn: A green segmented abdomen housing digestive organs and spiracles, swelling significantly in females before autumn.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 螳螂的腹部下方生有一个特殊的单一听觉器官，能够听到蝙蝠发出的超声波并紧急俯冲躲避！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Mantises have a single "ear" on their underside tuned to ultrasonic bat clicks, triggering mid-air escape dives!

bodyParts.descZh: 捕捉足末端带有尖锐弯曲的利钩，与胫节上的锐刺形成双向闭锁夹子，猎物一旦被捕便无法逃脱。
bodyParts.descEn: Curved sharp claws at the tip that fold against tibial spines like a locked pocket knife, trapping prey.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这些锐利的倒刺排布极为精密，就像多齿夹钳，保证捕食时绝不滑脱！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The interlocking needle-like spines work just like a vice clamp, ensuring prey cannot wiggle free.

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Raptorial Forelegs (大刀状捕捉前足)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Raptorial Forelegs
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！大刀状捕捉前足长有坚硬倒刺，是螳螂闪电捕食最厉害的武器！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The spined raptorial arms fold like scythes and strike with incredible speed!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 螳螂的大脑袋呈什么形状，且能在不移动身体的情况下旋转多少度？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What shape is a mantis's head, and how far can it rotate without moving its body?

options.textZh: 倒三角形，能转动 180 度

options.textEn: Square, only nods up and down

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！倒三角形的脑袋配合灵活的脖子，让螳螂能看清身后 180 度的视野！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Its triangular head and flexible neck grant an incredible 180-degree field of view!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 螳螂身体两侧用来伪装成绿叶、展开后用于飞行的器官是哪个？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part provides green leaf camouflage and allows the mantis to fly when spread?

options.textZh: 革质前翅与后翅 (Tegmina & Flying Wings)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！绿色的革质前翅像天然树叶，遇到敌人时展开双翅还能威吓对手！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Green wings act as natural leaf camouflage and can flash open to scare enemies away!

nicknameZh: 勤劳的花粉搬运工与自然授粉使者
nicknameEn: The Hardworking Golden Pollinator
lifespan: 工蜂约 6 周 (蜂后可存活 3 - 5 年)
food: 花蜜与花粉
habitat: 蜂巢、花丛、果园与草甸
speed: 飞行时速约 24 - 30 km/h
overviewZh: 蜜蜂是维系地球生态平衡最重要的授粉昆虫！它们全身长满带静电的绒毛，在花丛中采集花蜜和花粉。蜜蜂还拥有精密的社会分工，通过独特的“八字摇摆舞”向同伴传递花蜜方位的精确坐标。
overviewEn: Honey bees are vital pollinators essential for Earth’s ecosystems! Covered in electrostatic hairs, they gather nectar and pollen across blossoms. They communicate the exact direction and distance of flowers using an ingenious waggle dance.

bodyParts.descZh: 后足外侧特化的平滑凹槽，周围环绕着硬刚毛，工蜂将收集的花粉揉成紧实的小金球塞入其中运回蜂巢。
bodyParts.descEn: A specialized smooth hollow surrounded by stiff bristles on the hind legs used to pack and carry golden pollen pellets.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 装满花粉的花粉篮重量可以达到蜜蜂自身体重的三分之一！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A pair of fully loaded pollen baskets can weigh up to one-third of the bee’s entire body weight!

bodyParts.descZh: 头部两侧的大型复眼由数千个六角形小眼组成，表面长有微小毛发，能感知紫外线和偏振光。
bodyParts.descEn: Large multifaceted eyes that perceive ultraviolet nectar guides on flowers, covered with tiny protective hairs.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜜蜂眼中的花朵和我们看到的完全不同，花瓣上闪耀着人类看不见的紫外线“花蜜跑道”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Flowers look completely different to bees, glowing with UV patterns that guide them straight to the nectar!

bodyParts.descZh: 像肘部一样可以灵活弯折的触角，上面分布着数万个嗅觉与触觉感受器，负责闻花香和在巢内交流。
bodyParts.descEn: Elbow-jointed antennae packed with thousands of chemical sensors used to detect floral scents and pheromones.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜜蜂可以用触角闻出几公里外特定花朵散发的微弱香气！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A honey bee’s sense of smell is so sharp it can detect faint floral scents miles away!

bodyParts.descZh: 平时折叠在头部下方的长吸管，探入花朵深处像吸管一样吸取甜美花蜜。
bodyParts.descEn: A flexible, straw-like tongue that extends deep inside flower blossoms to lap up sweet nectar.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜜蜂采集的花蜜暂时存放在体内的“蜜胃”中，带回蜂巢后经工蜂酿造成天然蜂蜜！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Nectar is stored in a special "honey stomach" before being transformed into rich golden honey!

bodyParts.descZh: 头胸部密布的金色分叉绒毛带正电荷，在飞行中能像磁铁一样把带负电的花粉粒瞬间吸附在身上。
bodyParts.descEn: Dense, branched golden hairs carrying a static charge that naturally attract airborne pollen grains like magnets.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜜蜂在花间飞行时会积累微弱静电，只要轻轻靠近花朵，花粉就会自动“跳”到它身上！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Flying bees build up positive static charge, causing pollen to literally leap onto their fuzzy coats!

bodyParts.descZh: 前后两对透明翅膀，后翅边缘长有一排微小的锁扣钩（翅钩），飞行时将前后翅紧扣成一体强力振翅。
bodyParts.descEn: Two pairs of translucent wings locked together during flight by a row of microscopic hooks called hamuli.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜜蜂每秒钟振翅超过 200 次，我们听到的“嗡嗡嗡”声正是翅膀高速拍打空气的声音！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Bees flap their wings over 200 times per second, creating their famous signature buzzing hum!

bodyParts.descZh: 身体中部的动力中心，容纳了强大的飞行肌群，控制六条足与两对翅膀的协调运动。
bodyParts.descEn: The central powerhouse containing heavy-duty flight muscles controlling both wings and legs.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 冬天蜜蜂通过高频震动胸部肌肉产生热量，让整个蜂巢内部始终保持温暖如春！
bodyParts.funFactEn: In cold winter, bees rapidly shiver their thorax muscles to heat the hive and keep the colony warm!

bodyParts.pinyin: hēi huáng tiáo wén fù bù
bodyParts.descZh: 由活动节环组成的黑黄相间腹部，包含消化系统、蜡腺与呼吸气门，伸缩自如。
bodyParts.descEn: A flexible banded abdomen with amber and black stripes, housing internal organs and wax glands.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 鲜艳的黑黄条纹是自然界的“警戒色”，警告捕食者不要轻易靠近！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The bold amber-and-black stripes serve as warning coloration, telling predators to stay away!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于雌性工蜂腹部末端的自卫武器，连通毒囊，带有微小倒刺，仅在蜂巢受到严重威胁时使用。
bodyParts.descEn: A defensive needle at the abdomen tip linked to venom glands, armed with microscopic barbs.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 工蜂一生只能蜇一次，而蜂后拥有光滑的螫针，可以反复使用保卫王位！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Worker bees lose their stinger after a single use, but queen bees have smooth, reusable stingers!

bodyParts.descZh: 工蜂腹部下表面特化的分泌腺体，能分泌出透明的蜂蜡薄片，用来搭建精密的六边形蜂巢。
bodyParts.descEn: Specialized glands on the underside of the worker bee abdomen that secrete thin beeswax flakes to construct honeycomb.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜜蜂用蜂蜡建成的正六边形巢房是自然界结构最坚固、空间利用率最高的建筑奇迹！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Hexagonal honeycombs made from beeswax are an architectural marvel of maximum storage and strength!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Pollen Basket (花粉篮)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Pollen Basket
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！后腿上的花粉篮就像两个小口袋，装满了金灿灿的花粉团！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The pollen basket on the hind leg carries compact golden balls of pollen!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 蜜蜂身上用来吸取花朵深处花蜜的细长工具是哪个？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which flexible straw-like body part does a bee use to sip sweet nectar from flowers?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！管状口器就像吸管，能伸进花芯吸出香甜的花蜜！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! The proboscis works like a straw to lap up nectar deep inside flowers!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 蜜蜂为什么能在飞行中像磁铁一样吸附花粉？是因为哪个部位？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Why do pollen grains stick like magnets to a bee during flight? Which part is responsible?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！毛茸茸的静电绒毛带有正电，会把花粉粒牢牢吸住，让蜜蜂成为最好的授粉使者！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Positively charged fuzzy hairs attract and hold pollen grains like little magnets!

nicknameZh: 黑夜提灯精灵与零能耗冷光大师
nicknameEn: The Luminous Night Lantern Beetle
lifespan: 幼虫期约 1 年，成虫仅存活 1 - 2 周
food: 幼虫捕食蜗牛与蛞蝓，成虫多吸食花蜜或露水
habitat: 潮湿灌木丛、稻田边、清澈溪流与森林湿地
speed: 飞行轻盈平缓，时速约 3 - 5 km/h
overviewZh: 萤火虫是夏夜大自然中最神奇的光学奇迹！它们不是真正的“虫”，而是一种会发光的鞘翅目甲虫。萤火虫腹部的发光器通过荧光素酶催化生物化学反应，将化学能几乎100%转化为冷光，完全不产生废热。成千上万只萤火虫通过有节奏的闪光“莫尔斯电码”在黑夜中交流与寻找伴侣。
overviewEn: Fireflies are glowing marvels of the nocturnal world! Actually soft-bodied beetles, their luminous abdomen converts nearly 100% of chemical energy into cool, radiant light without wasting heat. Using rhythmic flashing like biological Morse code, they communicate across the darkness of summer nights.

bodyParts.descZh: 位于腹部末端特化的发光组织，荧光素在荧光素酶与三磷酸腺苷(ATP)的作用下发生氧化，发出纯净黄绿色的生物冷光。
bodyParts.descEn: A specialized photic organ at the tip of the abdomen where luciferin reacts with luciferase to generate brilliant, heat-free yellow-green light.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 人类普通的白炽灯只有10%能量变成光，90%都浪费成热量；而萤火虫的发光效率接近100%，是最高效的天然冷光源！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Incandescent bulbs waste 90% of energy as heat, while fireflies convert nearly 100% of chemical energy directly into light!

bodyParts.descZh: 紧贴在发光细胞层上方的一层致密白色尿酸盐晶体，像手电筒背后的反光聚光碗一样，把向内散射的光子全部反弹向外。
bodyParts.descEn: A dense reflective layer of white urate crystals behind the photocytes that mirrors scattered photons outward like a flashlight reflector cup.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 现代科学家仿照萤火虫的反光层与纳米微透镜，制造出了光效大幅提升的高亮度 LED 芯片！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Engineers copied the micro-reflector and nanostructures of fireflies to design ultra-bright, energy-saving LED displays!

bodyParts.descZh: 密布在发光器官深处的超微气管网络，通过神经系统瞬时输送或阻断氧气，精准控制光芒一闪一灭的频次。
bodyParts.descEn: A network of microscopic tracheoles that rapidly supplies pulses of oxygen, acting like an electrical switch to trigger synchronized flashes.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 萤火虫想要发光就深吸一口氧气点亮反应，想要灭灯就切断氧气，开关只需几毫秒！
bodyParts.funFactEn: To flash, the firefly simply floods the cells with oxygen; cutting off the oxygen supply turns off the lamp in milliseconds!

bodyParts.descZh: 背部覆盖着轻巧柔软的黑褐色皮革质鞘翅，质地比一般甲虫轻韧许多，既保护薄膜后翅，又不会增加飞行负重。
bodyParts.descEn: Lightweight, leather-like protective wing covers that shield the delicate flight wings without adding excess weight.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 萤火虫飞行时会把两扇鞘翅高高扬起固定角度，像滑翔机的机翼一样提供稳定升力！
bodyParts.funFactEn: During flight, fireflies hold their elytra outward like glider wings to generate aerodynamic stability and lift!

bodyParts.descZh: 向前大幅延伸的半透明琥珀色前胸背板，像一顶宽檐遮阳帽遮盖住藏在下方的头部，防止在密草穿行时撞伤脆弱复眼。
bodyParts.descEn: A shield-like amber pronotum projecting forward over the head like a helmet visor, shielding the delicate eyes during dense foliage navigation.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 从正上方看萤火虫几乎看不到它的眼睛，因为整张脸都缩在坚韧圆润的胸甲头盔底下！
bodyParts.funFactEn: From above, a firefly’s head seems invisible because it tucks safely under this smooth protective helmet!

bodyParts.descZh: 占据头部两侧的巨大半球形黑色复眼，拥有极高灵敏度的感光小眼阵列，能在伸手不见五指的黑暗森林中捕捉微弱闪光。
bodyParts.descEn: Large hemispherical eyes equipped with thousands of light-sensitive ommatidia facets optimized to pinpoint dim flashes in pitch-black forests.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 雄萤火虫的复眼往往比雌虫大得多，这让它们在夜空盘旋时一眼就能锁定藏在草丛中的雌虫回应！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Male fireflies have noticeably larger compound eyes, allowing them to spot female signals from high in the night canopy!

bodyParts.descZh: 前端呈锯齿或梳状分节的精密触角，表面密密麻麻分布着化学感应毛，负责在微风中嗅探空气湿度与同伴费洛蒙气味。
bodyParts.descEn: Feathered or saw-toothed sensory antennae packed with microscopic olfactory sensilla to track pheromone scent plumes and humidity.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 萤火虫幼虫也是用这对抗风触角沿着地面粘液追踪蜗牛，是名副其实的“微型气味雷达”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Firefly larvae follow snail slime trails using their sensitive antennae like biological micro-radars!

bodyParts.descZh: 足部末端具有成对的锋利微弯倒钩，搭配爪间纳米级疏水绒毛，即使在挂满沉重晨露的水草上也能牢牢倒挂稳如磐石。
bodyParts.descEn: Paired curved hook claws accompanied by hydrophobic micro-pads that securely grip dewy, slippery blades of grass.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 倒挂在湿漉漉的草叶上倒立发光时，这双微爪能产生自身体重上百倍的抓握附着力！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When hanging upside down to flash, these micro-claws generate clinging forces over 100 times the beetle’s weight!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Bioluminescent Light Organ (生物冷光发光器)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Bioluminescent Light Organ

options.textZh: 半透明护眼头胸甲 (Pronotum Hood)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！萤火虫腹部末端的发光器产生近100%发光效率的生物冷光，一点都不烫手！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The bioluminescent photic organ converts nearly all chemical energy into pure, cool light!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 像手电筒反光碗一样，把向内照射的光子全部反射向外的结构是哪个？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which structure acts like a flashlight reflector cup, bouncing internal photons outward?

options.textZh: 微气管脉冲供氧阀 (Oxygen Valve)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！紧贴发光细胞的白色尿酸盐微晶层就像镜子，让微弱的光芒瞬间明亮聚焦！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! The reflective crystal layer functions like a mirror behind the glowing cells to focus the beam!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 萤火虫如何实现每隔几秒闪烁一次光芒？是通过调节哪个部位？
quizQuestions.promptEn: How does a firefly pulse its flash on and off every few seconds? Which part controls the rhythm?

options.textZh: 微气管脉冲供氧阀 (Oxygen Flash Valve)
露珠防滑攀附微爪 (Tarsal Claws)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！微气管网络像阀门一样控制氧气流入，供氧就亮，断氧就灭，节奏随心所欲！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Microscopic tracheal tubes rapidly pulse oxygen in and out, switching the light on and off!

nicknameZh: 微型举重冠军与地下超级农业工程师
nicknameEn: The Master Underground Fungus Farmer
length: 工蚁约 0.3 - 1.6 cm，兵蚁可达 2.4 cm
lifespan: 工蚁约几个月，蚁后可存活 15 - 20 年
food: 自身精心培育的地下白蘑菇菌丝体（切树叶用来种蘑菇，而非直接食用）
habitat: 中美洲与南美洲热带雨林、地下巨型真菌农场
speed: 负重急行速度可达 100 米/小时（相当于人类百米冲刺同时背负货车）
overviewZh: 切叶蚁是热带雨林中不可思议的“微型农业工程师”！在人类学会农耕的数千万年之前，它们就已经建立起了庞大的地下生态农庄。它们用犹如手术刀般锋利的大颚切下一片片比自身重大数十倍的新鲜树叶，高高举过头顶运回深邃的地下巢穴。它们不吃树叶，而是将叶片嚼碎培植一种美味的特化白蘑菇，喂养整支由数百万只蚂蚁构成的超级社会！
overviewEn: Leafcutter ants are the rainforest’s ultimate agricultural pioneers! Millions of years before humans discovered farming, they built sophisticated subterranean fungal cities. Using razor-sharp vibrating mandibles, worker ants slice leaf fragments many times their own weight and carry them overhead to underground chambers to cultivate nutrient-rich mushrooms.

bodyParts.descZh: 边缘富含重金属锌元素的锯齿大颚，硬度堪比优质不锈钢；切割坚硬叶片时以每秒数千次的超高频微振动驱动，像微型电锯般轻盈裁开蜡质树叶。
bodyParts.descEn: Heavy zinc-reinforced serrated jaws that vibrate at kilohertz frequencies like an electric chainsaw, cleanly slicing through tough leathery leaves.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 科学家发现切叶蚁大颚含有重金属锌晶体，硬度比普通昆虫几丁质高出整整3倍，怎么咬都不会变钝！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Zinc atoms incorporated into their jaws make them as hard as stainless steel surgical blades that never dull!

bodyParts.nameZh: 五千倍负荷弹簧颈关节
bodyParts.descZh: 头部与胸部连接处的复合弹簧嵌合软组织与球窝关节，能承受超过自身体重 5000 倍的峰值拉伸拉力，是仿生重型起重机械的黄金蓝本。
bodyParts.descEn: An interlocking ball-and-socket cervical membrane capable of withstanding forces over 5,000 times the ant’s body weight without rupturing.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 相当于一个普通成年人嘴里咬住几辆满载的大卡车，颈椎依然毫无损伤并轻松奔跑！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Engineers study this miraculous joint because it can withstand forces equivalent to a human holding several semi-trucks in their teeth!

bodyParts.pinyin: sān chā jǐ fáng yù cì
bodyParts.descZh: 胸背部向后上方挺立的数根锋利棘刺骨板，既能在搬运硕大叶片时充当天然杠杆支点稳定重心，又能让天敌鸟类与两栖动物难以下咽。
bodyParts.descEn: Formidable backward-pointing dorsal spine projections that serve both as load-balancing fulcrums and sharp physical deterrents against predators.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 当大风吹过时，棘刺就像托架一样卡住翻飞的叶片，防止蚂蚁被巨叶像风筝一样带飞！
bodyParts.funFactEn: These rigid spines act like roof racks, locking flapping leaf sails firmly into place during strong tropical gusts!

bodyParts.pinyin: xī zhuàng dǎo háng chù jiǎo
bodyParts.descZh: 呈 90 度灵活折叠的肘状触角，末端拥有数十万个超敏化学气味感应器，通过左右微弱浓度差在密林地面锁定几百米长信息素“高速公路”。
bodyParts.descEn: Elbow-bent sensory antennae scanning ground-level chemical trails in stereo, keeping thousands of foragers marching along precise pheromone highways.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 切叶蚁通过立体嗅觉感知气味梯度，一旦偏离队伍哪怕半厘米，触角瞬间就能警觉纠偏！
bodyParts.funFactEn: With 3D stereo olfaction, antennae detect faint concentration gradients, instantly steering wandering ants back on track!

bodyParts.descZh: 足爪末端拥有精密分节的弹性爪垫(Arolium)与双倒钩，通过毛细液体粘附力和微机械嵌合，在完全光滑湿润的垂直树叶和玻璃上如履平地。
bodyParts.descEn: Dual curved tarsal claws paired with a fluid-filled capillary suction pad (arolium) that provide relentless traction on slippery waxy leaves.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 即使垂直倒挂在挂着水珠的蜡质叶背，切叶蚁足底的吸盘垫也能轻松吊挂自身几十倍的重量而不滑脱！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A leafcutter ant can hang completely upside down from wet, frictionless glass while carrying a leaf 30 times its own weight!

bodyParts.descZh: 胸部与腹部之间特有的两节球窝状腹柄节，如同汽车的高级万向减震悬挂系统，使沉重叶片在快速颠簸跑动中保持重心动态平衡。
bodyParts.descEn: A double-node flexible waist articulating the thorax and gaster, functioning as an active shock absorber and gyroscopic ballast during high-speed runs.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 扛着巨叶飞奔时，蚂蚁会通过腹柄灵活上下左右摇摆后腹部，像杂技演员手中的平衡杆一样随时调控重心！
bodyParts.funFactEn: By wagging its abdomen through this two-node hinge, the ant actively shifts its center of mass just like a tightrope walker’s balance pole!

bodyParts.descZh: 外骨骼微孔凹窝内共生培养着白色放线菌群，源源不断分泌强效天然抗生素，专门用来喷洒地下真菌农场，消灭入侵的有害霉菌病原体。
bodyParts.descEn: Microscopic thoracic crypts hosting white symbiotic actinobacteria that secrete powerful natural antibiotics to sanitize the subterranean fungus gardens.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 切叶蚁在大自然中应用抗生素消灭霉菌已经有5000万年历史，比人类弗莱明发现青霉素早了千百万年！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Leafcutter ants have been farming with natural antibiotic medicines for 50 million years, vastly predating human medicine!

bodyParts.descZh: 头部两侧隆起的半球形复眼，除了常规观察周围环境外，还能感应林冠缝隙中天空的偏振光分布，充当全天候的“天文太阳罗盘”。
bodyParts.descEn: Hemispherical convex compound eyes calibrated to detect polarized sunlight patterns filtering through the canopy as a celestial solar compass.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 哪怕天空大部分被乌云遮挡，只要露出一小角蓝天，切叶蚁复眼就能根据紫外偏振光判断正南正北！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Even beneath dense rainforest overcast, these multifaceted eyes read ultraviolet polarized skylight to pinpoint cardinal directions!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Vibro-Shear Mandibles (微振动大颚)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Vibro-Shear Mandibles

options.textZh: 五千倍负荷弹簧颈关节 (Neck Joint)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！切叶蚁的大颚含有微量锌元素，像手术电锯一样能高频振动切碎坚韧叶片！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Zinc-hardened mandibles vibrate like micro-chainsaws to slice cleanly through tough plant leaves!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 切叶蚁能够举起比自己重几十倍的叶片奔跑，靠的是哪个不可思议的承重连接结构？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which incredible anatomical joint enables the ant to support loads over 5000 times its own body weight?

options.textZh: 五千倍负荷弹簧颈关节 (Neck Joint)
全景广角凸面小复眼 (Convex Eyes)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！嵌合式的球窝颈椎软组织能承受超过体重5000倍的拉力，是生物机械学的奇迹！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! The interlocking ball-and-socket neck joint bears up to 5,000 times body weight without failing!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 切叶蚁背甲上附着的白色鳞斑有什么神奇功能？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What is the amazing function of the white powdery crust hosted on the ant’s cuticle armor?

options.textZh: 共生抗生素白色鳞甲 (Antibiotic Armor)
胸背三叉戟防御棘刺 (Defensive Spines)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！白色鳞斑是与蚂蚁共生的放线菌，分泌天然抗生素帮地下蘑菇农场消毒灭菌！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! The white crust consists of mutualistic bacteria that secrete natural antibiotics to protect their fungal farms!

nicknameZh: 夏日森林交响乐首席与地下潜行歌唱家
nicknameEn: The Sonic Master of Summer Trees
length: 体长 4.0 - 5.5 cm，翼展可达 10 - 13 cm
lifespan: 地下幼虫期 3 - 17 年，破土羽化为成虫仅存活 4 - 6 周
food: 以长吻管穿透树皮吸食新鲜木质部树汁，幼虫吸食树根汁液
habitat: 温带与亚热带森林、果园、林荫大道树冠与地下土壤
speed: 飞行迅猛敏捷，起飞时速可达 15 - 25 km/h
overviewZh: 蝉是盛夏大自然中最壮丽的“高音歌唱大师”！雄蝉腹部拥有一套极其精密的生物微机电发音系统，通过强劲发音肌驱动几丁质鼓膜剧烈振动，并在中空腹腔产生强烈声学共鸣，音量最高可超过 100 分贝，是自然界最响亮的昆虫之一。蝉的幼虫在黑暗潮湿的泥土下潜伏数年甚至长达 17 年，只为在酷夏破土蜕壳羽化，在阳光下尽情唱响生命最绚烂的赞歌！
overviewEn: The cicada is the champion acoustic maestro of summer! Male cicadas possess a marvel of natural bioacoustics: specialized muscular tymbal organs that click hundreds of times per second, amplified by a hollow abdominal resonance chamber to unleash songs exceeding 100 decibels. After subterranean slumber as nymphs for 3 to 17 years sipping root sap, they emerge into the canopy for a brief, glorious chorus.

bodyParts.nameZh: 腹部声学发音肌与发音鼓膜
bodyParts.descZh: 雄蝉腹部基部两侧特化的波状瓦楞几丁质鼓膜，由体内强大的声学肌肉以每秒数百次的高频拉拽内陷与回弹，并在中空的充气腹腔内形成强烈共鸣，爆发出百米外清晰可闻的高亢鸣叫。
bodyParts.descEn: A corrugated chitinous membrane at the base of the abdomen buckled inward and released hundreds of times per second by massive acoustic muscles, resonating through a hollow belly.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蝉叫的声音最高能达到 100 到 120 分贝，堪比一架电锯或摇滚音乐会现场！蝉在自己唱歌时还会主动折叠听觉器官，防止把自己震聋！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A cicada’s chorus can surpass 100 decibels—as loud as a chainsaw! To avoid deafening themselves, they fold shut their own auditory mirrors while singing!

bodyParts.nameZh: 刺吸式坚硬树汁吻管口器
bodyParts.descZh: 折叠在头部下方的细长喙管，内部包裹着极细硬的针状口针，能轻巧钻透高大乔木的厚韧树皮，像医用微型注射针头一样直达植物木质部导管，吸饮富含营养的天然植物汁液。
bodyParts.descEn: A rigid needle-like stylet sheath folded beneath the head capable of piercing tough tree bark to siphon mineral-rich xylem fluid directly from vascular channels.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蝉完全不吃叶子也不咬人，一生只靠这根“超细吸管”喝树汁维生，被称为只饮甘露的大自然歌者！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Cicadas never chew leaves or bite animals; their entire life is spent sipping pure, watery tree sap through this microscopic straw!

bodyParts.descZh: 蝉的晶莹翅膀表面密布着数十亿根肉眼不可见的纳米级微型圆锥柱阵列，不仅具备极高的超疏水自洁效应，还能在物理微观层面上直接刺破入侵细菌的细胞膜，使其无法在翅面存活。
bodyParts.descEn: Transparent glassy wings textured with billions of sub-microscopic nanocones that physically rupture bacterial membranes upon contact while shedding raindrops effortlessly.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 现代医学科学家模仿蝉翼上的纳米圆锥结构，研发出了不需要任何化学抗生素就能天然杀灭细菌的医用手术器械表面！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Biomedical engineers bio-replicated cicada wing nanostructures to create bactericidal surgical implants that destroy germs purely by physical puncture without drugs!

bodyParts.descZh: 蝉在幼虫阶段特化膨大的挖掘前足，长有坚硬的粗齿和强壮的屈肌，就像一对微型合金挖土挖掘机斗铲，支撑它们在暗无天日的板结泥土和树根缝隙中高效开凿隧道。
bodyParts.descEn: Heavily sclerotized, toothed excavator-like raptorial forelegs with massive flexor muscles that allow underground nymphs to dig tunnels through dense soils.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 北美著名的“十七年蝉”幼虫在暗无天日的泥土里辛勤挖洞生活整整17年，是昆虫界最长寿的地下掘进工程师之一！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Periodical cicada nymphs use these digging forelegs to burrow and tunnel underground for up to 17 long years before their final summer metamorphosis!

bodyParts.descZh: 在两只巨大的复眼之间，头顶额心呈正三角形整齐嵌着 3 颗犹如红宝石般通透的简单单眼，专门用来高灵敏感知头顶天光偏振与白昼明暗变换，充当体内的天文光照时钟。
bodyParts.descEn: Three spherical ruby-red simple eyes arranged in a neat triangle on the forehead vertex, acting as light meters and celestial clocks to regulate circadian rhythm and flight tilt.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这三颗小红宝石单眼虽然不能看清物体的形状，却能比普通眼睛快几十倍感应到天敌阴影袭来，瞬间触发翅膀起飞避险！
bodyParts.funFactEn: While they cannot resolve sharp images, these 3 ruby ocelli detect sudden shadow drops micro-seconds faster than compound eyes, triggering instant takeoff reflexes!

bodyParts.nameZh: 大角度侧凸视网膜复眼
bodyParts.descZh: 宽阔头部两侧向外明显突出的圆球状复眼，由数千只六边形小眼呈宽广圆顶排列，赋予蝉停栖在粗壮树干上时，无需转头就能获得将近 360 度的全景无死角周界视野。
bodyParts.descEn: Bulging hemispherical compound eyes perched at the wide lateral corners of the head, packed with thousands of facets to deliver broad panoramic field vision.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蝉的头非常宽，两只大眼睛就像汽车前脸两侧的车灯，天敌鸟类从背后树干悄悄靠近，蝉一眼就能看到！
bodyParts.funFactEn: With eyes pushed so far out to the sides, a cicada perched on a tree can literally watch what is happening behind its own back!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于雄蝉胸腹交界腹面的两片宽大半月形几丁质板盖，不仅像盾牌一样保护内侧的听觉膜与发音共鸣腔，还能通过微幅升降调节共鸣声道的开口，改变歌声的旋律抑扬与音量。
bodyParts.descEn: Large overlapping plate flaps covering the acoustic chambers beneath the thorax that actively lift and lower to modulate sound volume, resonance, and directional projection.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蝉唱歌时腹部总是一翘一翘的，正是因为听盖在不断调整角度，就像音响的低音炮倒相孔一样改变音效！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When singing, a cicada pumps its abdomen rhythmically to shift the opercula plates, modulating sound resonance just like an audio equalizer!

bodyParts.descZh: 幼虫爬上树干完成最后一次蜕皮羽化后，留下的空心琥珀色外骨骼硬壳。六足牢固锚定在树皮上，背部留有一道整齐的十字裂缝，见证了破茧成蝶般脱胎换骨的生命奇迹。
bodyParts.descEn: The resilient, hollow amber-colored chitinous exoskeleton left firmly hooked to tree bark after the winged adult splits the thoracic seam and takes flight.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蝉蜕不仅是天然几丁质高分子材料，在传统自然科学与本草医药中更是一味久负盛名的温润名贵药材！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Known in traditional natural philosophy as a symbol of rebirth, shed cicada shells are made of resilient, biodegradable chitin prized in natural medicine!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Acoustic Tymbal Organ (腹部发音鼓膜)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Acoustic Tymbal Organ
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！雄蝉腹部的发音鼓膜以每秒数百次高速形变，产生超过100分贝的夏日林间交响乐！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The tymbal organ vibrates hundreds of times each second inside the hollow abdomen to create loud summer songs!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 蝉的翅膀为什么能够天然杀灭细菌，甚至启发了现代医用手术刀的防菌设计？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Why do cicada wings naturally destroy bacteria, inspiring modern antibacterial surgical surfaces?

options.textZh: 纳米防菌柱透明薄翅 (Nanocone Wings)
前足粗壮挖掘附肢 (Fossorial Legs)
坚韧几丁质透明蝉蜕 (Chitinous Exuviae)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！蝉翼表面密布肉眼看不见的纳米微型圆锥柱，能像微型钉板一样物理刺破细菌细胞膜！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Billions of sub-microscopic nanocones on cicada wings physically puncture bacterial membranes on contact!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 蝉在两只大复眼之间额头上长有的 3 颗红色小宝石结构是什么？有什么作用？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What are the 3 glowing ruby structures on the cicada’s forehead vertex, and what is their role?

options.textZh: 额头三角红宝石单眼 (Triangular Jewel Ocelli)
腹侧听觉反射听盖 (Opercula Covers)
大角度侧凸视网膜复眼 (Compound Eyes)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！这三颗红宝石般的简单单眼专门用来感应阳光强度和头顶天敌阴影，是超快的避险光电警报器！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! The 3 jewel ocelli detect subtle changes in light and shadow, alerting the cicada to diving predators in milliseconds!

nicknameZh: 大自然仿生火箭弹射器与草甸杂技跳跃家
nicknameEn: The Acrobatic Grassland High-Jumper
length: 体长约 3.5 - 6.0 cm，后足伸展可达 8 - 10 cm
lifespan: 成虫寿命约 2 - 4 个月，多以卵在泥土中越冬
food: 各类禾本科植物、多汁野草叶片、麦苗与芦苇嫩叶
habitat: 温带与亚热带草甸、向阳草坡、低矮灌木与向日葵花田
speed: 后足起跳弹射瞬时初速可达 3.2 m/s，起跳加速度超 20G
overviewZh: 蚱蜢是草甸原野上无可争议的“微型杂技弹跳冠军”！它们拥有一对极其强大的后肢，关节处自带由坚韧弹性蛋白构成的“半月板弹簧蓄能系统”。起跳时肌肉先锁死预压储存巨大能量，随后像强力弓弩般瞬间弹射，能将自身高高抛起达到体长数十倍的惊人高度！更神奇的是，蚱蜢的耳朵并不长在头上，而是长在腹部两侧的翅膀下方！
overviewEn: The grasshopper is the supreme catapult gymnast of the grassland! Engineered with massive saltatorial hind legs, their knee joints incorporate elastic cuticle pads that store immense mechanical energy under muscle tension before releasing like an archery bow, propelling them dozens of body lengths into the air. Astonishingly, their sensitive hearing ears are located not on their head, but on the sides of their abdomen!

bodyParts.nameZh: 后足弹簧蓄能半月板肌腱
bodyParts.descZh: 粗壮大腿内充盈着呈鱼骨状人字形排列的高密度快肌纤维，膝关节处包含极具弹性的甲壳质半月板弹簧。起跳前先缓慢锁紧积聚巨大势能，瞬间释放产生超过自身体重数百倍的起跳推力。
bodyParts.descEn: A swollen femur packed with pennate jumping muscles coupled to a semi-lunar cuticular spring in the knee joint that stores elastic potential before explosive release.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蚱蜢起跳时的爆发加速度超过 20G（是宇航员火箭发射过载的数倍），但弹性缓冲机构保护它们毫无震荡损伤！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A grasshopper accelerates at over 20 Gs upon launch—far exceeding the G-force felt by astronauts during rocket liftoff!

bodyParts.nameZh: 后腿摩擦发音音锉棘刺
bodyParts.descZh: 后腿大腿内侧排布着一整排几十颗微米级硬质小齿（发音音锉），当后腿上下高速抽动时，小齿与前翅坚硬的主径脉相互刮擦，像拉小提琴一样发出清脆悦耳的草丛求偶歌声。
bodyParts.descEn: A microscopic comb-like row of cuticular pegs on the inner hind femur scraped against the raised vein of the leathery forewing like a violin bow.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蚱蜢拉响“大腿小提琴”时每秒可以擦奏数十下，不同种类的蚱蜢拥有专属的节拍和音频，同伴绝不会听错！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Grasshoppers play their "femur violins" at dozens of strokes per second, producing unique acoustic signatures recognized only by their own species!

bodyParts.nameZh: 腹部侧位微型听觉鼓膜
bodyParts.pinyin: fù bù tīng jué gǔ mó
bodyParts.descZh: 位于第一腹节两侧、紧贴在后足基部上方的半透明椭圆形薄膜，被坚韧的甲壳环形支架绷紧，内接复杂的听觉神经节，专门用来收听同伴在草丛中演奏的求偶摩擦声波。
bodyParts.descEn: An oval translucent eardrum membrane stretched taut on the first abdominal segment beneath the wings, detecting sound vibrations carried across the meadow breeze.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蚱蜢的耳朵长在肚子两侧！这样当它们在草丛中蹦跳落地时，腹部耳朵刚好朝向开阔草野监听远处的鸟鸣天敌！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A grasshopper’s ears are on its belly! This low body placement lets them tune into ground vibrations and airborne sounds simultaneously!

bodyParts.nameZh: 强力锯齿切割咀嚼口器
bodyParts.pinyin: jù chǐ jǔ jué kǒu qì
bodyParts.descZh: 左右对向横向开合的厚实大颚，内缘分布着硬度极高的高刚性微齿，像微型剪草修枝机一样，能轻松剪断含有高硬度二氧化硅纤维的干燥坚韧草叶。
bodyParts.descEn: Heavy, transverse-acting jaws lined with hardened cutting denticles and grinding molar surfaces designed to shred abrasive silicate plant tissue.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蚱蜢咀嚼树叶时嘴巴是横向左右开合咀嚼的，下唇旁的小触须还会像灵巧的手一样不断往嘴里扶稳草叶！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Grasshopper jaws chew sideways, assisted by dexterous mouth-feelers (palps) that steady grass stems like tiny human hands!

bodyParts.descZh: 前胸背部向后延伸包裹的加厚革质骨板，形状宛如骑兵的马鞍，在昆虫钻行密草时保护脆弱的颈部神经中枢与四翅翅基免遭摩擦割伤。
bodyParts.descEn: A flared, saddle-shaped cuticular collar protecting the vulnerable neck joint and wing attachments against abrasive twigs during dense foliage movement.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这个马鞍背板表面布满密生微孔和迷彩条纹，在强烈的草甸阳光直射下能像遮阳伞一样帮助身体降温散热！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The saddle-shaped shield acts like a personal parasol, dissipating intense midday solar radiation while blending seamlessly with vegetation!

bodyParts.nameZh: 微米倒钩爪间肉垫吸盘
bodyParts.descZh: 足端配有一对锐利的微弯倒钩，两钩正中间长有充满分泌液的弹性爪垫(Arolium)，在粗糙草茎上使用倒钩抓紧，在挂满露珠的湿滑垂直草叶表面则靠液体表面张力紧密吸附。
bodyParts.descEn: Paired curved tarsal claws flanking an adhesive spongy central pad (arolium) that uses fluid capillary forces to grip smooth waxy vertical stems.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 就算大风把草杆吹弯到贴近地面，蚱蜢爪间吸盘产生的毛细粘附力依然能让它们稳如磐石、绝不脱落！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Even when gales bend grass stalks horizontally, the capillary fluid suction of the arolium pads keeps the insect anchored securely!

bodyParts.pinyin: róu rèn biān zhuàng chù jiǎo
bodyParts.descZh: 由数十个细密圆柱节组成的丝状触角，具有极高的弯曲弹性，表面覆盖密集的机械感应毛与化学受体，在起跳前测定侧风阻力并在降落时判断草叶软硬。
bodyParts.descEn: Long, segmented thread-like antennae bristling with microscopic mechanoreceptors and chemosensors that gauge airflow wind resistance and plant freshness.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蚱蜢在准备跳跃前总会前后挥动触角，这其实是在测量风速和风向，像高尔夫球手感受风力一样计算最佳弹道！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Before leaping, grasshoppers wave their antennae forward and back to calculate headwind speed and optimize jumping trajectories!

bodyParts.descZh: 平时像一把精巧的日式折扇一样整整齐齐紧凑折叠在狭长的革质前翅(覆翅)下方，起跳至最高点时瞬间向两侧完全舒展，提供强劲气动升力并辅助超远距离滑翔。
bodyParts.descEn: Broad, delicate membranous flight wings that pleat fan-style along radiating veins beneath narrow protective forewings, snapping open at jump apex.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 有些蝗虫的后翅展开后呈现明艳的黄红双色或者带有斑纹，弹跳瞬间突然展开能瞬间吓退紧随其后的捕食小鸟！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Many grasshopper species feature brilliantly colored flash-wings that snap open mid-jump to visually startle and confuse chasing predators!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Semi-Lunar Spring Jumping Leg (后足弹簧蓄能半月板肌腱)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Semi-Lunar Spring Jumping Leg
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！蚱蜢后腿膝盖处的半月板弹性构造像弩弓一样积蓄能量，弹射爆发力超强！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The semi-lunar spring organ in the jumping knee stores and releases mechanical energy like a loaded bow!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 蚱蜢用来收听同伴歌声与天敌动静的“耳朵”（听觉鼓膜）长在身体的哪个部位？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Where are the grasshopper’s auditory ears (tympanal membranes) located on its body?

options.textZh: 腹部侧位微型听觉鼓膜 (Abdominal Ear)
强力锯齿切割咀嚼口器 (Mandibles)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！蚱蜢的耳朵居然长在第一腹节两侧的翅膀下方，是昆虫界奇妙的身体构造！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! A grasshopper’s ears are remarkably located on the sides of its abdomen underneath the wings!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 蚱蜢在夏日草甸里发出的欢快歌声，是用哪个结构像拉小提琴一样擦奏出来的？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which structure does a grasshopper scrape like a violin bow to create its meadow chirping song?

options.textZh: 后腿摩擦发音音锉棘刺 (Stridulatory Pegs)
微米倒钩爪间肉垫吸盘 (Footpads)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！后腿内侧的一排微型音锉小齿与前翅坚硬叶脉高速摩擦，奏出了经典的夏日鸣奏！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Microscopic pegs on the inner hind femur rub against the hard forewing vein like a violin bow playing on strings!

nicknameZh: 陆地庞然巨兽与草原生态工程师
nicknameEn: The Gentle Giant of the Savannah
length: 肩高 3.2 - 4 米 / 重达 4 - 7 吨
lifespan: 约 60 - 70 年 (具备超长家族记忆)
food: 草本植物、树枝、树皮与野果 (每天吃 150-200 公斤)
habitat: 非洲大草原、稀树丛林与河流湿地
speed: 冲刺最高时速可达 40 km/h
overviewZh: 非洲草原象是现存地球陆地上体型最庞大的哺乳动物。它们拥有超过四万块肌肉构成的灵巧象鼻、形似非洲地图的大耳朵以及极其深厚的家族智慧，能够开辟水源和森林小径，是大自然真正的“生态工程师”。
overviewEn: The African Bush Elephant is the largest living land mammal on Earth. Renowned for its prehensile trunk containing over 40,000 muscles, huge cooling ears shaped like Africa, and remarkable social intelligence, it acts as a keystone ecosystem engineer across the continent.

bodyParts.descZh: 由超过四万块精密肌肉组成，末端长有两个指状突起，既能拔起参天大树，又能捏起一粒细小的花生。
bodyParts.descEn: Packed with over 40,000 muscles and two delicate finger-like lips at the tip, able to uproot trees or pluck tiny berries.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大象在过深河游泳时，会把象鼻高高举出水面，当成天然的“潜水呼吸管”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When swimming across deep rivers, elephants hold their trunks high above the water to use them as natural snorkels!

bodyParts.descZh: 由上门齿特化延长的象牙终生都在生长，大象用它剥开树皮、在干涸河床挖掘地下水或自卫。
bodyParts.descEn: Elongated upper incisors that grow continuously throughout life, used for stripping tree bark, digging for water, and defense.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大象也有“左撇子”和“右撇子”，经常用来撬树皮的一侧象牙磨损会更明显！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Just like right- or left-handed humans, elephants have a favorite tusk that shows more wear and tear!

bodyParts.descZh: 外形酷似非洲大陆轮廓，皮下布满密集的毛细血管网，扇动时能让流经的血液迅速降温数度。
bodyParts.descEn: Shaped like the continent of Africa and filled with dense blood vessels, flapping gently to radiate heat away in the hot sun.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大象的大耳朵不仅能扇风降温，还能接收数公里外同伴发出的低频“次声波”秘密信号！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Elephant ears can detect low-frequency infrasound rumbles traveling for miles across the savannah!

bodyParts.descZh: 厚达两厘米的灰褐色皮肤布满交错深邃的褶皱，大象洗泥浴后，泥浆与水分能被锁在缝隙中长时间防晒防蚊。
bodyParts.descEn: Thick gray hide with intricate deep fissures that retain cooling mud and water for hours, shielding against sun and insects.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大象虽然皮厚，但对蚊虫叮咬非常敏感，所以它们最喜欢把泥巴像防晒霜一样抹满全身！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Despite having skin up to an inch thick, elephants are sensitive to bug bites and use mud as natural sunscreen!

bodyParts.descZh: 脚掌内部有一层厚达数厘米的蜂窝状弹性脂肪软骨垫，能吸收数吨体重落地冲击，走路悄无声息。
bodyParts.descEn: A thick layer of spongy fat and cartilage beneath the sole that absorbs massive shock, allowing a multi-ton titan to tread silently.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 脚底敏锐的神经能感知地下传来的远方象群奔跑震波，甚至察觉几十公里外的雷暴雨！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Nerves in elephant footpads can detect subterranean seismic vibrations, sensing distant thunderstorms 50 miles away!

bodyParts.descZh: 骨骼近乎笔直垂直排列，像坚不可摧的罗马立柱，使大象无需耗费过多肌肉力量即可轻松站立支撑庞大身躯。
bodyParts.descEn: Bones aligned nearly vertically like structural stone pillars, enabling elephants to support massive weight with minimal muscle strain.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大象由于独特的直立柱状腿骨结构，是极少数完全无法离地跳跃的哺乳动物！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Because of their rigid pillar-like leg structure, elephants are among the only mammals that cannot jump!

bodyParts.descZh: 生有浓密纤长的黑色睫毛与半透明第三眼睑（瞬膜），有效阻挡草原飞扬的沙尘与耀眼烈日。
bodyParts.descEn: Framed by long, dense protective eyelashes and a nictitating membrane that shield the eyes from blinding dust and bright sun.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 虽然大象视力一般，但它们的听觉与嗅觉比猎犬还要灵敏数倍，几公里外就能闻到水源！
bodyParts.funFactEn: While elephant eyesight is modest, their sense of smell is several times superior to that of a bloodhound!

bodyParts.descZh: 细长尾巴末端长着一簇坚硬如铁丝的粗黑刚毛，能像苍蝇拍一样灵活挥动驱赶臀部的吸血飞虫。
bodyParts.descEn: A flexible long tail ending in a stiff tuft of wire-like black bristles, flicking constantly to swat away biting flies.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在象群迁徙时，小象幼崽经常会用象鼻紧紧抓着前面妈妈的尾巴，像小火车一样排队前行！
bodyParts.funFactEn: During herd travel, baby calves often hold onto their mother's tail with their trunk to keep safe!

bodyParts.descZh: 硕大的单拱形前额内部布满类似蜂窝的微小空气腔室，既大幅减轻了头部重量，又能稳固支撑沉重的象牙。
bodyParts.descEn: A massive rounded forehead filled with lightweight honeycomb air cavities that reduce weight while supporting heavy tusks.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大象拥有陆地动物中最大、最重的大脑（重达5公斤），赋予了它们超凡的认知与同理心！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Elephants have the largest brain of any land animal, giving them exceptional memory and deep empathy!

bodyParts.descZh: 如同砖块般巨大的板状臼齿，表面带有菱形硬珐琅质棱嵴，像石磨一样前后研磨粗糙的坚硬树皮与干草。
bodyParts.descEn: Brick-sized flat molars with diamond-shaped enamel ridges that grind tough tree bark and fibrous grasses like millstones.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大象一生中会轮换更新 6 套臼齿，新牙会从颌骨后方像传送带一样向前推移更替！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Elephants go through 6 sets of molars in a lifetime, each set sliding forward from behind like a conveyor belt!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Prehensile Trunk (灵巧多能象鼻)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Prehensile Trunk
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！象鼻包含超过四万块肌肉，既能推倒大树，又能精巧捡起细小食物！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The trunk contains over 40,000 muscles and can lift huge trees or pick small berries!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 非洲象的哪个部位形状像非洲大陆，扇动时能帮助排出体内过多的热量？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part is shaped like the African continent and helps radiate body heat away?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！大耳朵布满细密毛细血管网，扇动起来就像移动空调一样给血液降温！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Filled with blood vessels, flapping large ears acts just like a natural radiator!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 重达几吨的大象为什么走起路来悄无声息？是因为哪个神奇的身体结构？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Why can a 6-ton elephant walk almost completely silently? Which structure is responsible?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！脚掌厚厚的弹性脂肪软骨垫能彻底吸收重击，还能像雷达一样感知地面的震动！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Spongy shock-absorbing pads muffle steps and detect vibrations traveling through the ground!

nicknameZh: 原野陆地极速飞人
nicknameEn: The Speed Champion of the Savannah
lifespan: 野外约 10 - 12 年
food: 汤氏瞪羚、黑斑羚与野兔
habitat: 非洲开阔热带稀树草原与半荒漠
speed: 0 到 100 km/h 仅需 3 秒 (极速 112 - 120 km/h)
overviewZh: 猎豹是陆地上奔跑速度最快的哺乳动物，几乎全身每一个解剖结构都为了极速爆发而进化：弹簧般的柔韧脊柱、像赛跑钉鞋一样的半伸缩爪，以及如航行尾舵般控制平衡的粗长尾巴。
overviewEn: The cheetah is the undisputed fastest land animal on Earth. Its entire anatomy is a marvel of aerodynamic engineering, featuring a flexible catapult spine, non-retractable traction claws, and a rudder-like tail for high-speed turns.

bodyParts.descZh: 从内眼角延伸至嘴角的浓黑条纹，能有效吸收非洲烈日强烈的地面反射眩光，保持高速追捕中的清晰视野。
bodyParts.descEn: Distinct black stripes running from the eyes to the mouth that absorb blinding sunlight glare during high-speed daytime hunts.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 就像橄榄球运动员在眼底涂抹黑油彩防反光一样，猎豹大自然天生就自带一副“太阳镜”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Just like professional athletes wearing eye black under their eyes, cheetahs have natural built-in glare guards!

bodyParts.descZh: 如同高回弹弹簧般极度柔软强韧的脊椎骨，奔跑时能剧烈弓起与伸展，使单次跃步跨度高达 7 米。
bodyParts.descEn: A hyper-flexible spinal column that coils and uncoils like a steel spring, propelling the cheetah forward up to 7 meters per stride.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 当猎豹全速冲刺时，它有超过一半的时间四脚完全腾空，就像在离地低空飞行！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When sprinting at top speed, a cheetah spends more than half of its stride completely airborne in mid-air!

bodyParts.descZh: 肌肉紧实且末端扁平的长尾巴，在百公里时速急刹急拐弯时如船舵般剧烈甩动反向配重，防止侧翻。
bodyParts.descEn: A long muscular, flattened tail that swings violently to act as a stabilizing counterweight during sudden sharp-angle turns.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 如果没有这条强大的“舵尾”，猎豹在高速拐弯抓瞪羚时就会像失控赛车一样打转甩飞！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Without this powerful steering tail, a sprinting cheetah would flip and roll over when taking sharp corner turns!

bodyParts.descZh: 爪子缺乏猫科典型的完整皮鞘，始终外露坚硬变钝，奔跑抓地时就像短跑名将穿的田径钉鞋。
bodyParts.descEn: Unlike other cats, a cheetah's claws remain exposed and blunt, acting like running cleats for maximum dirt grip.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在所有大型猫科动物中，只有猎豹的爪子不能完全收回，是专属的硬核防滑跑鞋！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Cheetahs are the only living big cats whose claws cannot fully retract into protective sheaths!

bodyParts.descZh: 格外宽大的鼻孔与扩展鼻腔通道，配合超常容积的心脏与肺部，能为狂奔中的肌肉瞬间吸入海量氧气。
bodyParts.descEn: Exceptionally large nostrils and wide sinus airways paired with an oversized heart deliver colossal oxygen to sprinting muscles.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 猎豹在冲刺时呼吸频率会从每分钟 60 次暴增到 150 次以上，比我们人类跑步喘得快多啦！
bodyParts.funFactEn: During a sprint, a cheetah's breathing rate skyrockets from 60 to over 150 breaths per minute!

bodyParts.descZh: 脚掌肉垫质地坚硬，表面带有横向胎纹般的沟槽与脊棱，提供极佳的摩擦力以适应极速刹车。
bodyParts.descEn: Tough, hard, leathery footpads featuring tire-tread ridge grooves that act like anti-skid brakes on savannah soils.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 猎豹的脚垫比普通猫咪硬得多，摸起来就像结实的越野车轮胎橡胶！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Cheetah paw pads are significantly harder than house cat pads, textured just like rugged off-road tires!

bodyParts.descZh: 面部朝前的亮琥珀色双眼具有超大视角与双目视觉景深，能在几公里外的高草丛中精准测距锁定目标。
bodyParts.descEn: Forward-facing bright golden-amber eyes that provide high-resolution wide-angle binocular vision to calculate hunting distance.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 猎豹的动态视力极强，即便在 5 公里外有一只小羚羊轻轻晃动耳朵，它都能立刻捕捉到！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A cheetah's keen daytime eyesight can spot the slight flick of a gazelle's ear miles across the plains!

bodyParts.descZh: 小巧圆润的头部与贴伏的低矮小耳朵，极大地降低了高速冲刺时遭遇的迎面空气阻力。
bodyParts.descEn: A compact rounded skull with flattened low-profile ears engineered to minimize aerodynamic drag at 100+ km/h.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 猎豹的小脑袋在赛跑时就像高铁车头一样破风前行，风阻小到不可思议！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A cheetah's small aerodynamic head slices through air resistance just like a bullet train nose!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 猎豹眼角下黑黑的条纹是什么神奇结构？它有什么特殊功能？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What is the black marking beneath the cheetah's eyes and what does it do?

options.textZh: 防眩光黑泪痕 (吸收刺眼阳光)
破风流线小头骨 (降低风阻)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒啦！黑色泪痕能像太阳镜一样吸收强烈的太阳反光，帮助猎豹在烈日下看清猎物！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! The black tear lines absorb blinding sunlight glare so the cheetah can clearly see its prey!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的部位：Dynamic Rudder Tail (急转弯平衡舵尾)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Dynamic Rudder Tail
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！猎豹长长的粗尾巴在高速变向时像船舵一样甩动，维持身体稳定！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The rudder tail acts as a counterweight stabilizer during high-speed chases!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 猎豹的哪一个身体部位像田径运动员的跑鞋鞋钉，能在泥土上提供超强抓地力？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part works like track spikes, providing incredible grip on savannah ground?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太聪明了！猎豹的爪子无法完全收回，像钉鞋一样直接插进泥土，起步加速极快！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Exposed claws dig into the dirt like cleats, enabling explosive instant acceleration!

nicknameZh: 原野百兽之王与草原家族守护者
nicknameEn: The King of Beasts & Pride Guardian
lifespan: 野外约 10 - 15 年
food: 角马、斑马、水牛等中大型食草兽
habitat: 非洲热带大草原、开阔稀树灌丛与草地
speed: 短程冲刺最高达 60 - 80 km/h
overviewZh: 非洲狮是现存体型最大的猫科捕食者之一，也是唯一拥有典型雌雄二态性与高度群居合作捕猎习性的猫科动物。雄狮拥有威风凛凛的厚实鬃毛与令人胆寒的震天咆哮，守护着整个狮群领地。
overviewEn: The African Lion is a majestic apex predator and the only truly social big cat. Famous for the adult male's glorious protective mane and spine-chilling territorial roar, lions thrive in close-knit family prides across the sun-drenched savannah.

bodyParts.descZh: 环绕雄狮颈部与胸膛的茂密鬃毛，从金黄渐变为深黑，不仅能威慑对手，还能在领地搏斗时抵御利齿撕咬。
bodyParts.descEn: A magnificent dense ruff of coarse hair framing the male's head and neck, providing critical protection against throat bites in battles.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 鬃毛越深黑浓密的雄狮通常越健康、力气越强大，因此在狮群中最受母狮们的倾慕！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Lions with darker, thicker manes are healthier and stronger, making them the most attractive leaders to female lionesses!

bodyParts.descZh: 长达8厘米的弧形弯爪平时被韧带拉入肉垫皮鞘内保护，捕猎扑击猎物时可闪电弹出紧紧勾住目标。
bodyParts.descEn: Curved razor-sharp claws up to 8 cm long that retract into protective skin sheaths, keeping them razor-sharp for gripping prey.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 狮子平时走路时会把指甲完全“藏”起来，这样指甲就不会在粗糙的地面上被磨钝！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Lions keep their claws pulled inside while walking so the sharp points never touch the rough ground!

bodyParts.descZh: 近十厘米长的圆锥形粗壮犬齿具有高达几百公斤的咬合力，后面的臼齿像重型剪刀般能切开厚实的坚硬动物皮肉。
bodyParts.descEn: Massive conical canine teeth deliver crushing bite force, while shearing carnassial molars slice through tough muscle and hide.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 狮子的舌头上还长满了微小的坚硬倒刺（丝状乳头），能像砂纸一样把骨头上的最后一点碎肉刮得干干净净！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A lion's tongue is covered with tiny rough backward-facing spines like sandpaper, used to strip meat right off the bone!

bodyParts.descZh: 盘子般硕大的前爪底部覆有厚重柔软的黑色脂肪肉垫，能让重达两百公斤的巨兽在干草上悄无声息地接近猎物。
bodyParts.descEn: Massive dinner-plate paws cushioned with thick soft pads that absorb all sound, allowing 400-pound lions to stalk in utter silence.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 狮子的前爪有一记掌击拍断斑马肋骨的超强力量，但落地时却比小猫还要安静！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A single swipe of a lion's front paw can knock down a zebra, yet it treads as softly as a whisper!

bodyParts.descZh: 极其发达的前胸与肩颈肌肉群，重心偏前，赋予了狮子正面格斗、扑倒重达数百公斤野牛的无与伦比压制力。
bodyParts.descEn: Massive chest and shoulder musculature engineered with forward mass balance to overpower and grapple massive cape buffalos.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 与擅长长跑的狼不同，狮子是短跑爆发力摔跤手，前半身的力量比后半身强壮得多！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike wolves built for long running, lions are heavyweight wrestlers with incredible upper body strength!

bodyParts.descZh: 长在口吻两侧粗壮坚韧的白色胡须，根部连接着极其密集的神经元，能在黑夜摸黑行进中精准感知周围草木阻隔。
bodyParts.descEn: Stout white vibrissae rooted in dense sensory nerve clusters on the muzzle, functioning as spatial radars during night stalks.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 狮子嘴边每一排黑色的胡须斑点分布都是唯一的，科学家甚至能靠“数胡须点”来认出每只不同的狮子！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The pattern of black whisker spots on a lion's muzzle is unique to each lion, just like a human fingerprint!

bodyParts.descZh: 长尾末梢的一大簇深黑毛刷，内部隐藏着一粒微小骨刺，在茫茫夜色高草丛中甩动时是幼崽排队跟随的醒目标志。
bodyParts.descEn: A distinctive dark brush at the tail tip concealing a tiny bone spur, held upright in tall grasses to guide cubs in the dark.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大狮子在前面走时会把黑尾巴高高竖起，小狮子幼崽就像看着车尾灯一样紧紧跟着妈妈！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Lionesses hold their dark tail tuft up high like a visual lighthouse so little cubs never get lost in the savannah tall grass!

bodyParts.descZh: 特化弹性的软骨舌骨结构与厚实声带，能使吸气与呼气皆引发空气巨幅共振，发出震撼原野的百兽之王低频巨吼。
bodyParts.descEn: A specialized flexible hyoid apparatus and deep vocal folds that generate immense acoustic resonance reaching 114 decibels.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 一头雄狮的咆哮声最远能在 8 公里外被听见，地表上的水坑都会被震得荡起一圈圈涟漪！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A lion's deep roar can be heard 5 miles away, loud enough to send gentle ripples across nearby watering holes!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 雄狮脖子上厚厚的一圈毛叫什么？它在战斗中能起到什么关键保护作用？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What is the thick circle of fur around a male lion's neck called?

options.textZh: 威武雄狮鬃毛 (保护颈部防撕咬)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！雄狮浓密的鬃毛像防弹衣一样保护着脖子脆弱的血管，还让它看起来威严巨大！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The thick mane acts as natural armor shielding the throat from enemy claw and bite wounds!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到的英文发音对应部位：Fully Retractable Sharp Claws (完全收缩利爪)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Fully Retractable Sharp Claws
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真棒！狮子平时把尖爪缩在肉鞘里保持锋利，抓捕猎物时才像小弹簧刀一样弹出！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Lions keep their claws safely tucked away inside so they never get blunt while walking!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 母狮带着小狮子穿过茂密高草丛时，会竖起哪个部位像“信号灯”一样带路？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part is raised like a beacon flag to guide little cubs through tall grasslands?

options.textZh: 尾端黑绒球信号灯 (Black Tail Tuft)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对啦！高高竖起的黑尾巴尖就像导航旗帜，让小狮子宝宝们不会在大草原里走丢！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! The dark tassel on the tail stands out clearly against yellow savannah grass to lead the cubs!

nicknameZh: 原野云端巨人与自然树冠修剪师
nicknameEn: The Gentle Sky-Scraper of the Wilderness
lifespan: 野外约 20 - 25 年
food: 金合欢树嫩叶、嫩芽、花朵与野果 (每天吃 30-40 公斤)
habitat: 非洲稀树草原、金合欢疏林与开阔原野
speed: 奔跑最高时速可达 55 - 60 km/h
overviewZh: 长颈鹿是陆地上现存最高的动物，修长优雅的体态宛若原野上的活动瞭望塔。它们拥有能防晒避刺的蓝紫色长舌、与人类数量相同却无比巨大的7块颈椎骨，以及独特的斑纹散热系统，是大自然演化奇迹的典范。
overviewEn: The giraffe is the tallest living terrestrial creature, wandering the plains like a graceful natural watchtower. Endowed with a sun-proof bluish-purple prehensile tongue, seven gigantic neck vertebrae, and mosaic thermal patches, it is an evolutionary masterpiece.

bodyParts.descZh: 长达两米以上、重达两百公斤的优雅脖颈，令人惊叹的是其内部骨骼和人类一样只有 7 块，但每块长达近 30 厘米。
bodyParts.descEn: An extraordinarily long 2-meter neck constructed from just 7 giant cervical vertebrae, the exact same number of neck bones as humans.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 虽然长颈鹿脖子有两米长，但骨头数量跟我们人类完全一样，只有7块巨大的颈椎！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Despite stretching over 6 feet long, a giraffe's neck has only seven bones—the exact same count as in your neck!

bodyParts.descZh: 长达 45-50 厘米的灵活长舌，深蓝紫色富含高浓度黑色素能抵御强烈紫外线晒伤，表皮坚韧可轻松卷取多刺的金合欢。
bodyParts.descEn: A prehensile 50-centimeter bluish-black tongue rich in protective melanin that resists sunburn while plucking thorny acacia foliage.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 长颈鹿因为整天伸着长舌头在高树上吃树叶，为了不被太阳晒伤，大自然专门把它染成了防晒的深蓝紫色！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Because a giraffe keeps its tongue extended in the harsh sun all day, high melanin turns it purple to prevent sunburns!

bodyParts.descZh: 头顶上由软骨骨化而成并被皮毛紧紧包裹的一对角，顶端生有黑色刚毛丛，雄性在争夺配偶甩颈角斗时用它防御。
bodyParts.descEn: Unique blunt horn-like knobs formed from ossified cartilage and covered in furry skin, used in rhythmic swinging neck battles.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 长颈鹿头上的小角出生时其实是平贴在头骨上的软骨，长大后才会直立并和头骨彻底长在一起！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Baby giraffes are born with flat cartilage horns to protect their mothers, which stand upright days after birth!

bodyParts.descZh: 深浅不一的几何多边形栗色色块，既在树影斑驳中起到天然光学伪装，斑纹下复杂的大血管网还能如散热器般排热。
bodyParts.descEn: Geometric chestnut mosaic patches that blend seamlessly with tree shade, featuring extensive vascular rings that radiate body heat away.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 就像人类独一无二的指纹一样，大自然中每一只长颈鹿身上的斑纹多边形都绝不相同！
bodyParts.funFactEn: No two giraffes ever share the identical spot pattern—each coat is as uniquely individual as a human fingerprint!

bodyParts.descZh: 重达11公斤的强韧心脏产生常人两倍以上的血压把血液泵上海拔三米的脑部；低头饮水时颈静脉内单向阀门会立刻锁闭防脑溢血。
bodyParts.descEn: An 11-kilogram engine of a heart pumping blood 3 meters uphill, equipped with series valves preventing brain damage when bowing down.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 长颈鹿低头喝水再猛然抬头不会头晕脑胀，是因为脖子血管里装满了神奇的“单向压力调节阀”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Giraffes never get dizzy when lifting their head from water holes thanks to smart natural check-valves in their jugular veins!

bodyParts.descZh: 大而深情的深褐色眼睛生在头部两侧，睫毛浓密纤长阻隔飞沙与带刺树枝，高耸视野能将方圆数公里风吹草动尽收眼底。
bodyParts.descEn: Large soulful brown eyes framed by dense, sweeping eyelashes that repel stinging sand, offering a 360-degree hilltop panorama.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 长颈鹿是整个非洲大草原上的“哨兵塔”，斑马和羚羊都最喜欢呆在长颈鹿身边，因为只要有猛兽接近它第一个就能看到！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Giraffes serve as the savannah's live guard towers; other grazing animals feel safest hanging around them!

bodyParts.descZh: 长达 1.8 米的大长腿比许多成年人还要高，强健有力的蹄部挥击能爆发惊人力量，甚至足以击退凶猛的狮子捕食。
bodyParts.descEn: Towering 6-foot stilted limbs delivering bone-cracking defensive kicks capable of deterring predatory lion prides.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 长颈鹿仅仅一条前腿的长度，就比一个一米八的成年人身高还要长！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A giraffe's front legs alone are over 6 feet tall, longer than most full-grown adult humans!

bodyParts.descZh: 细长尾巴末端垂挂着一米多长的粗硬黑毛束，在身后像天然拂尘一样不知疲倦地甩动驱赶贪婪的吸血牛蝇与飞虫。
bodyParts.descEn: A slender tail tipped with a long flowing tuft of stiff black bristles that flicks like a broom to ward off biting tsetse flies.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 长颈鹿尾巴上的黑色毛发是动物界中最长、最粗硬的毛发之一，曾被古老部落用来编织幸运手环！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Giraffe tail hairs are among the longest and coarsest mammalian hairs on Earth, once used as ancient good-luck bracelets!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 长颈鹿伸出嘴巴吃金合欢树叶的长舌头为什么是深蓝紫色的？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Why is the giraffe's long flexible tongue dark bluish-purple?

options.textZh: 蓝紫色防晒长舌 (富含黑色素防晒防刺)
大理石散热斑块 (帮助散热伪装)
皮毛骨角 (争夺配偶角斗)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！长颈鹿整天把长长的舌头伸在烈日下卷吃树叶，深蓝紫色能防止舌头被太阳紫外线晒伤！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! High melanin pigments turn it bluish-purple to prevent severe sunburn under the African equatorial sun!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 虽然长颈鹿的脖子长达两米以上，但里面惊人的颈椎骨头数量和我们人类完全一样，只有几块呢？
quizQuestions.promptEn: A giraffe's neck is 6 feet long, but how many vertebrae does it share with humans?

options.textZh: 7节超长颈椎 (和人类一样也是 7 块！)
高跷承重大长腿 (比人还要高的大长腿)
强压防眩晕心血管 (强劲的增压泵)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太神奇啦！长颈鹿的脖子虽然巨大，但颈椎数量跟我们人类是一模一样的，都是 7 块！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Amazing! Despite its massive neck size, giraffes have precisely 7 cervical vertebrae, just like humans!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的部位：Fur-Covered Ossicones (皮毛骨角)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Fur-Covered Ossicones
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真棒！长颈鹿头顶上长着两个萌萌的骨角，表面覆有柔软的带毛皮肤，非常具有标志性！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Super! Ossicones are the unique skin-covered cartilage horns on top of a giraffe's head!

nicknameZh: 竹林黑白隐士与和平萌宝
nicknameEn: The Bamboo Forest Diplomat
lifespan: 野外约 15 - 20 年 (圈养可达 30 年以上)
food: 箭竹、冷箭竹与水竹嫩叶竹笋 (每天吃 12-38 公斤)
habitat: 中国西南高山温带竹林与茂密山谷 (海拔 1200-3400 米)
speed: 漫步 3-5 km/h (爬树与奔跑最高可达 32 km/h)
overviewZh: 大熊猫是栖息在中国高山秘境中的珍稀国宝。它们拥有标志性的黑白双色毛皮、灵巧的腕骨“伪拇指”和极其强大的咀嚼力量。虽然属于食肉目动物，但它们在数百万年的演化中爱上了美味的竹子，是大自然最呆萌可爱的和平使者。
overviewEn: The Giant Panda is a rare living fossil native to the misty bamboo forests of Southwestern China. Famed for its iconic black-and-white coat, specialized pseudo-thumb wrist bone, and formidable chewing power, this bamboo-loving bear charms the world with its gentle demeanor.

bodyParts.descZh: 由前掌腕部桡籽骨显著增大特化形成的“第六指”，能像人类手指一样与五指对握，牢牢夹住光滑的细竹竿。
bodyParts.descEn: An enlarged radial sesamoid wrist bone acting as a sixth opposable thumb, allowing pandas to tightly grasp and strip smooth bamboo stalks.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大熊猫其实并不是真正拥有六根手指，这个神奇的“假大拇指”是腕骨为了吃竹子专门进化出的大智慧！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Pandas don't actually have six true fingers; their "thumb" is a specialized enlarged wrist bone evolved specifically for holding bamboo!

bodyParts.descZh: 头骨上方附着极其粗壮的颞肌和咬肌，让脸盘显得圆圆滚滚，能爆发惊人的咬合力，轻松咬碎坚硬的毛竹筒。
bodyParts.descEn: Immense chewing and temporalis muscles attached to a vaulted skull, giving a round face and biting power capable of cracking solid bamboo.
