bodyParts.funFactZh: 大熊猫圆滚滚的脸看起来像个毛绒球，但它们的咬合力在陆地食肉目动物中名列前茅，几乎不输给狮子！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A panda's chubby round face is packed with pure muscle—its bite force ranks among the strongest land carnivores, close to a lion!

bodyParts.descZh: 粗硬的黑白毛皮外层富含天然油脂分泌物，下层是绵密的绒毛，像一件透气冲锋衣，能完美抵御高山冰雪和湿气。
bodyParts.descEn: Thick, oily outer guard hairs over a woolly undercoat that repel mountain rain, icy slush, and morning mist like a natural raincoat.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 雨雪天大熊猫直接坐在泥地上吃竹子，抖一抖毛发雪花就全掉了，身上一点都不会湿透！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A panda can happily sit in freezing rain or snow eating bamboo without getting wet, because its oily fur repels water completely!

bodyParts.descZh: 黑亮八字形眼圈像一副天然太阳镜，能吸收高山积雪反弹的刺眼紫外线，还能通过调整眼神大小向同伴传递社交信号。
bodyParts.descEn: Black teardrop patches around the eyes that absorb blinding snow glare while magnifying eye expression for communication among pandas.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 熊猫幼崽刚出生时全身粉嘟嘟的，并没有黑眼圈，大约出生一周后才慢慢长出酷酷的黑色“墨镜”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Newborn pandas are tiny, pink, and hairless—their iconic black eye patches don't appear until about a week after birth!

bodyParts.descZh: 毛茸茸的黑色圆耳朵能向各个方向微微转动，精准捕捉密林深处竹子折断的脆响与同伴低沉的呼唤。
bodyParts.descEn: Plump rounded black ears covered in thick fur that swivel to locate subtle sounds in dense bamboo thickets and distant vocal calls.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 当熊猫警惕或生气时，两只黑耳朵会向后贴紧；心情愉快好奇时，圆耳朵会高高竖起，像两个小雷达！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Pandas express their mood through their ears—flattened ears mean cautiousness, while perked-up ears mean playful curiosity!

bodyParts.descZh: 平坦而巨大的臼齿表面分布着复杂的珐琅质凹凸棱纹，像石磨一样每天不知疲倦地粉碎重达几十斤的高纤维坚硬竹茎。
bodyParts.descEn: Massive, wide-crowned flat molars with complex enamel ridges that crush and grind kilograms of fibrous bamboo stalks with ease.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大熊猫每天要花 10 到 16 个小时都在认真吃竹子，一颗牙齿一生要研磨成千上万根坚硬的竹杆！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A giant panda spends 10 to 16 hours every single day chewing, relying on these indestructible molars to crush tough bamboo!

bodyParts.descZh: 五根粗短有力的脚趾配有坚硬锋利的弯曲不可伸缩利爪，能深深扣进粗壮树干的树皮缝隙中，支撑身体灵敏爬树。
bodyParts.descEn: Stout, curved non-retractable claws on wide paws that dig firmly into thick tree bark, allowing agile climbing to escape danger.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 别看熊猫在地上走路慢条斯理，遇到危险或者想在树杈上睡个美觉时，几秒钟就能爬上二十米高的松树顶！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Though pandas look clumsy on the ground, their sharp claws let them scamper up 60-foot pine trees in just a few seconds!

bodyParts.descZh: 仅约10-15厘米长的洁白短尾紧贴臀部，尾巴下方藏有发达的肛周气味腺，熊猫通过在树干倒立涂抹气味宣告专属领地。
bodyParts.descEn: A short 10-15 cm white tail resting over a specialized scent gland used to rub territory-marking scents high onto tree trunks.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大熊猫为了让自己的气味留在更高的地方，甚至会练习“倒立撒尿”，倒立得越高的熊猫在林子里越威风！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Pandas actually do handstands against tree trunks to rub their scent mark as high as possible to impress their neighbors!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大熊猫能够像人类一样单手灵活握住光滑细竹子，全靠前掌上的哪个特殊结构？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which unique structure on the front paw allows a panda to grip smooth bamboo stalks like a human hand?

options.textZh: 灵巧六指伪拇指 (腕骨特化的大智慧)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太聪明了！这是腕骨特化出来的“伪拇指”，它像钳子一样帮大熊猫牢牢抓住竹子！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The enlarged wrist bone acts as an opposable thumb to firmly grip and peel bamboo stalks!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Dark Anti-glare Eye Patches (墨镜防眩光眼圈)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Dark Anti-glare Eye Patches
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！黑眼圈就像随身携带的帅气墨镜，能吸收高山白雪反弹的强烈紫外线！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! The black patches absorb blinding glare from snow and communicate mood to other pandas!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大熊猫每天要咀嚼十几个小时坚硬的高纤维竹子，是哪个部位发挥了像石磨一样的粉碎作用？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Pandas chew tough bamboo for hours each day. Which part grinds down the fibers like a millstone?

options.textZh: 宽厚研磨大臼齿 (平坦坚硬的石磨臼齿)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对啦！大熊猫拥有格外宽大坚固的臼齿，表面布满凹凸纹路，能把硬邦邦的竹子磨得粉碎！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Massive flat molars act like stone millstones, crushing tough bamboo fibers for digestion!

nicknameZh: 澳洲红土大陆跳跃霸王
nicknameEn: The Red Outback Leaper
length: 站立身高 1.8 - 2 米 / 尾长约 1 米
lifespan: 野外约 12 - 15 年 (圈养可达 20 年以上)
food: 各类原生青草、多汁灌木嫩叶与耐旱植物
habitat: 澳大利亚干旱灌木林与红土荒原
speed: 巡航跳跃 25 km/h (冲刺极速可达 65-70 km/h)
overviewZh: 大赤袋鼠是地球上体型最大的有袋类动物，也是澳洲辽阔红土大陆的跳跃之王。它们拥有天然的恒温育儿袋、像强力弹簧般回弹能量的后腿，以及粗壮如三脚架的平衡大长尾，能够以令人惊叹的高速连续跳跃穿越广袤干旱的荒原。
overviewEn: The Red Kangaroo is the world's largest marsupial and the undisputed leaping ruler of the Australian outback. Equipped with a warm marsupial pouch, spring-loaded hind legs with elastic tendons, and a heavy muscular tripod tail, it bounds effortlessly across thousands of miles of arid wilderness.

bodyParts.descZh: 位于雌性腹部的紧闭式肌肉弹性育儿袋，内部无毛且温润洁净，有4个乳头，为花生米大小的新生幼崽提供遮风避雨的生长温床。
bodyParts.descEn: A snug, elastic muscular pouch on the female's abdomen containing teats that produce tailored milk as the joey grows from peanut size.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 小袋鼠出生时只有 2 厘米长（就像一颗花生米大），它要全凭本能自己爬进妈妈温暖的育儿袋里吃奶长大！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A newborn baby joey is only about 2 cm long (the size of a peanut!) and must crawl up into mother's pouch completely on its own!

bodyParts.descZh: 由超过20块粗壮尾椎骨与强韧肌腱构成，站立时与双腿形成稳固的三脚架支撑，慢步走时甚至能充当“第五条腿”发力推进。
bodyParts.descEn: A thick, muscular tail made of heavy vertebrae that acts as a stable third leg when standing and a fifth propulsion limb when walking slowly.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 袋鼠在慢速走动时，会把强健的尾巴撑在地上抬起双脚，尾巴提供的推力相当于另外四肢的总和！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When grazing slowly, kangaroos push off the ground with their heavy tail like a fifth leg, generating more mechanical force than their front paws!

bodyParts.descZh: 粗壮后肢内藏有巨大柔韧的肌腱，落地时弯曲吸收冲击并像高弹力皮筋一样锁住动能，跳得越快反而越省力气。
bodyParts.descEn: Enormous elastic tendons running through long hind legs that store kinetic energy on each landing like giant biological trampolines.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 袋鼠每次落地都能将上一步跳跃中 70% 的冲击动能回收，就像踩在蹦床上一样，蹦得飞快却几乎不累！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A kangaroo's leg tendons recycle over 70% of landing shock energy into the next leap, making fast travel incredibly fuel-efficient!

bodyParts.descZh: 脚掌极度细长特化，第四趾格外粗长坚固且配有粗壮角质蹄爪，提供了惊人的地面抓地抓力，单次跳跃距离长达 9 米。
bodyParts.descEn: Specialized elongated feet centered on an oversized fourth digit with a stout claw that provides massive traction for leaps up to 30 feet long.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大赤袋鼠一跳能飞过 3 米高的篱笆，单次跳跃跃过近 10 米，相当于一口气跳过两辆并排停放的轿车！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A single leap from a red kangaroo can span nearly 30 feet in distance and clear a 10-foot-high fence with room to spare!

bodyParts.descZh: 两只细长的漏斗状耳朵可以各自独立旋转 180 度，如同灵敏的声纳雷达，捕捉数公里外草原上捕食者靠近的声音。
bodyParts.descEn: Long, funnel-shaped upright ears that rotate independently like radar dishes to pick up distant predator footsteps across flat plains.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 袋鼠的两只耳朵可以一只朝前听同伴呼唤、另一只朝后警戒天敌，完全不需要转动脑袋！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A kangaroo can point one ear completely forward and the other ear backwards at the same time to monitor every angle!

bodyParts.descZh: 后脚内侧第二和第三趾在演化中紧密愈合在一起，长出两枚精细的微型指甲，专门当作清理厚密毛发与寄生虫的梳子。
bodyParts.descEn: Fused second and third toes on the hind foot forming a dual-claw comb specialized for cleaning dirt and parasites from dense wool.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大袋鼠随身携带着一把纯天然的“脚趾发梳”，吃饱喝足后会用后脚灵活地给自己从头到脚梳理毛发！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Kangaroos have a built-in biological hair comb on their back paws that keeps their reddish-brown coat tidy and clean!

bodyParts.descZh: 前肢内侧皮肤较薄且密布细密的浅表毛细血管网。炎热干旱时袋鼠通过舔舐前肢，利用唾液蒸发带走体内的灼热热量。
bodyParts.descEn: Thin-skinned inner forearms lined with dense capillary blood vessels; licking them provides instant evaporative cooling under blazing heat.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在超过 40 度的澳洲酷暑中，袋鼠不会出汗，它们就像开启“生物空调”一样不断舔前爪来给自己吹凉风！
bodyParts.funFactEn: In 100°F outback heat, kangaroos don't sweat all over; they lick their wrists so evaporating saliva chills their flowing bloodstream!

bodyParts.descZh: 雄性袋鼠拥有强壮有力的宽阔胸大肌与粗壮的前肢爪，能依靠长尾与后脚挺立，用前爪推搡格斗以争夺领地与家庭领导权。
bodyParts.descEn: Heavy muscular shoulders and chest on mature males, enabling them to balance on tails and exchange powerful punches in territorial bouts.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 袋鼠是动物界著名的“职业拳击手”，在对决时不仅会用前爪挥拳格斗，还会把重心放在尾巴上用双脚猛力飞踢！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Famous as outback boxers, male kangaroos balance all their weight on their tail while delivering devastating double-leg jump-kicks!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 小袋鼠刚出生时只有花生米大小，它要在妈妈身体的哪个温暖部位里吃奶并度过前几个月？
quizQuestions.promptEn: A baby joey is the size of a peanut when born. Inside which cozy maternal part does it nurse and grow?

options.textZh: 恒温天然育儿袋 (安全温暖的婴儿床)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！袋鼠妈妈肚子上的天然育儿袋不仅温暖挡风，还能随着小袋鼠长大自由伸缩！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The elastic marsupial pouch keeps the baby warm and nourished until it is ready to explore outside!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Muscular Tripod Tail (三脚架承重长尾)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Muscular Tripod Tail
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！粗壮的长尾巴不仅是站立时的第三只脚，跳跃时还能在空中保持平衡！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! The muscular tail acts as a third leg for balance and a rudder during high-speed leaps!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 在炎热干燥的澳洲荒漠中，大赤袋鼠通过舔舐哪个部位的毛细血管来利用唾液蒸发散热？
quizQuestions.promptEn: In the blazing outback heat, which body part do kangaroos lick to cool down through evaporative blood chilling?

options.textZh: 散热毛细前肢 (密布浅表血管降温)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对啦！袋鼠前肢内侧皮肤薄且血管丰富，舔湿后蒸发能带走热量，相当于生物体表水冷！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Forearms have dense networks of blood vessels; licking them cools circulating blood fast!

nicknameZh: 非洲草原的黑白条纹艺术家与千里奔腾健将
nicknameEn: The Striped Nomad of the African Savannah
lifespan: 野外约 20 - 25 年，圈养可达 30 年以上
food: 坚硬粗纤维草本植物、灌木叶片与嫩枝
habitat: 东非与南非开阔稀树草原、草甸与灌木丛林
speed: 全速奔跑可达 65 km/h，耐力极强可长途迁徙
overviewZh: 斑马是非洲大草原上最富标志性的奇蹄目草食动物！它们每只都有独一无二的黑白条纹，就像人类的指纹一样绝不重样。斑马具有非凡的社会合作精神，数十万只斑马每年与角马组成浩浩荡荡的“东非动物大迁徙”。它们不仅擅长以 65 公里时速耐力长跑，后蹄势大力沉的踢击甚至能一脚击退凶猛的狮子！
overviewEn: The plains zebra is an iconic equin of the African savannas! Every zebra bears a unique pattern of black and white stripes, much like a human fingerprint. Highly social and alert, they join millions of wildebeest in the legendary Great Migration across the Serengeti, using sustained 65 km/h galloping speeds and formidable hind kicks to deter predators.

bodyParts.pinyin: guāng xué duì liú tiáo wén
bodyParts.descZh: 黑色毛皮吸热快、白色毛皮反射热量，两者之间产生微型局部空气对流风形成天然微空调；同时黑白条纹让嗜血的采采蝇产生视觉眩晕无法着陆，还在群奔时让狮子难以锁定单只目标。
bodyParts.descEn: Differential heat absorption between black and white stripes generates micro air currents that cool the skin, while confusing biting tsetse flies and dazzling hunting predators.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 科学家发现斑马其实是黑色的底色，白色的条纹是在胚胎发育期黑色素受抑制而形成的！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Zebras are actually black underneath! Their white stripes emerge during embryonic development when melanin production is selectively turned off!

bodyParts.pinyin: jiān yìng jiǎo zhì mǎ tí
bodyParts.descZh: 第三脚趾高度特化演化成的实心坚硬角质蹄，像天然跑鞋底一样减震耐磨，不仅能承受上万公里大迁徙的岩石砂砾考验，后蹄强力一踢甚至能击碎狮子的下颚。
bodyParts.descEn: A single, ultra-dense keratinous hoof evolved from the third toe, providing shock absorption over thousands of migratory miles and delivering bone-shattering defensive kicks.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 斑马奔跑时只用蹄尖着地，这相当于人类永远用脚趾尖跳芭蕾，却能跑得比汽车还快！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Zebras run exclusively on the tip of their single toe, achieving incredible speeds and mechanical efficiency!

bodyParts.descZh: 大而直立的漏斗状双耳，能各自独立向不同方向旋转近 180 度，即使在低头吃草时也能精准锁定草丛中狮子伏击的沙沙微声。
bodyParts.descEn: Large, funnel-shaped ears capable of rotating independently in all directions to pinpoint the faintest stalk of a predator even while grazing.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 斑马耳朵的朝向还能表达心情：耳朵竖直向前代表警觉好奇，耳朵向后贴平则代表愤怒准备防御！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Zebra ears also signal emotion: upright forward ears show curiosity and alertness, while flattened ears warn of anger and an impending kick!

bodyParts.descZh: 长在头部两侧的大眼睛配合横向水平瞳孔，拥有接近 350 度的全景广角视野，低头啃草时地平线上的动静尽收眼底。
bodyParts.descEn: Large lateral eyes positioned on the sides of the head with horizontal slit pupils, granting an expansive panoramic field of view of nearly 350 degrees.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 斑马的眼睛自带横向水平“地平线传感器”，无论头怎样歪斜低头，瞳孔总能自动保持水平！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A zebra’s pupils rotate automatically inside the eyeball to stay strictly level with the horizon even when grazing upside down!

bodyParts.pinyin: shù lì yìng mào zōng máo
bodyParts.descZh: 沿颈椎背中线整齐竖立的粗硬鬃毛，黑白条纹与颈部皮肤图案完美连贯，不仅威武挺拔，更像一层硬毛铠甲保护脆弱的颈部血管免遭咬击。
bodyParts.descEn: A stiff, upright brush-like crest of black and white hair along the neck that cushions predatory bite attempts and reinforces camouflage.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 家马的鬃毛通常会耷拉垂在脖子一侧，而野生斑马的鬃毛永远像修剪平整的硬刷子一样笔直挺立！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike domestic horses whose manes hang down, wild zebras always sport a stiff, brush-like mohawk that stands straight up!

bodyParts.descZh: 灵活黑润的触觉嘴唇先敏锐筛选嫩草，锋利门齿贴地切断坚硬草茎，后方高冠臼齿含有复杂的珐琅质褶皱，能如石磨般磨碎富含二氧化硅的干草。
bodyParts.descEn: A sensitive, mobile velvety muzzle paired with high-crowned molars featuring complex enamel ridges that pulverize silica-rich abrasive savana grasses.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 草类含有坚硬的二氧化硅晶体（像玻璃渣），斑马的臼齿会终生缓慢生长来弥补日复一日的磨损！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Savanna grasses contain abrasive silica crystals like micro-glass, so zebra teeth continuously push upward from deep in the jaw to offset wear!

bodyParts.descZh: 硕大紧致的臀肌群是斑马高速冲刺的动力引擎，能瞬间爆发提供 65 km/h 的疾驰加速度，在遭遇伏击时还能爆发出数千牛顿的后蹬防御踢力。
bodyParts.descEn: Dense, explosive gluteal muscle mass powering rapid 0-to-65 km/h sprint acceleration and unleashing bone-shattering hind defensive kicks.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 斑马后腿双蹬的一脚踢力高达近 1 吨，曾在野外被记录到直接将一头成年雄狮踢翻昏迷！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A double-barrel hind kick from a zebra delivers up to 1 ton of explosive impact, capable of knocking an adult lion unconscious!

bodyParts.descZh: 尾巴根部短毛紧凑，末端演化出丰盈柔顺的长黑毛流苏，在奔跑急转弯时充当动态平衡舵，平时则不知疲倦地左右摆动拍打吸血苍蝇和牛虻。
bodyParts.descEn: A long tail terminating in a dense tuft of black hair that acts as a gyroscopic rudder during high-speed turns and a tireless fly-swatter against parasites.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 斑马经常两两头尾相依站立，这样各自的尾巴刚好帮对方拍打脸上的苍蝇，是天然的“互助赶蝇队”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Zebras frequently stand head-to-tail in pairs so each animal’s tail swishes flies away from the other’s face!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Black & White Thermal Stripes (黑白光学对流条纹)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Black & White Thermal Stripes
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！黑白条纹不仅能产生温差微风降温，还能让吸血苍蝇眼花缭乱不敢降落！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Black and white stripes create micro-breezes for temperature regulation and optically deter biting flies!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 斑马在草原上奔跑时，能以极高时速飞奔上万公里的耐磨“天然跑鞋”是哪个部位？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which wear-resistant shock-absorbing body part serves as the zebra’s natural running shoe over thousands of miles?

options.textZh: 单趾坚硬角质马蹄 (Solid Single Hoof)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！斑马脚上的实心角质蹄减震耐磨，后蹄猛烈一踢甚至能击碎猛兽的骨头！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! The solid keratin hoof provides shock absorption across rocky plains and delivers powerful defensive kicks!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 斑马在低头吃草时，靠哪个部位能把周围近 350 度的地平线动静全部看在眼里？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part allows the zebra to monitor almost 350 degrees of panoramic savanna while grazing?

options.textZh: 侧置超宽广角大眼 (Wide-Angle Eyes)
研磨高纤维特化齿唇 (Muzzle & Molars)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！长在头部两侧的大眼睛搭配水平瞳孔，视野接近 350 度，几乎没有视觉死角！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Large lateral eyes with horizontal pupils grant nearly 360-degree panoramic vision to detect sneaking predators!

nicknameZh: 森林巨力全能霸主与溯河捕鱼大师
nicknameEn: The Mighty Forest Giant and Salmon Fisher
lifespan: 野外约 20 - 30 年，圈养环境下可超过 40 年
food: 杂食性：游水鲑鱼、植物块茎、浆果坚果、小哺乳动物与蜂蜜
habitat: 欧亚大陆与北美温带森林、泰加林、高山草甸与清澈河流
speed: 爆发冲刺时速可达 48 - 56 km/h，奔跑如疾风
overviewZh: 棕熊是北半球寒温带陆地上无可争议的顶级全能王者！它们看似体型沉重笨拙，实则能在高山峻岭间以 50 公里时速狂奔如风，更是一流的游泳与攀登健将。每当夏季鲑鱼成群逆流而上产卵时，棕熊便会驻守在白浪滔天的瀑布之巅，凭借闪电般的爪击精准截获肥美大马哈鱼。入冬前它们会储存上百公斤脂肪，在厚厚积雪覆盖的洞穴中安然冬眠长达半年！
overviewEn: The brown bear is the supreme land monarch of northern boreal ecosystems! Despite their immense, bulky stature, brown bears can sprint at blistering speeds exceeding 50 km/h across rugged mountain wilderness and excel at long-distance swimming. During summer salmon runs, they perch on turbulent waterfalls snatching leaping fish with surgical precision, before entering dens to hibernate through winter for up to 7 months.

bodyParts.descZh: 前足长有长达 10 厘米的坚硬微弯非伸缩性角质利爪，像天然的钢镐与鱼叉，能瞬间掀翻几百公斤的巨石挖蚁穴，更能凌空扣杀飞跃的野生大马哈鱼。
bodyParts.descEn: Massive, non-retractile keratin claws up to 10 centimeters long that function as excavators to flip heavy boulders and gaffs to spear leaping salmon in whitewater rapids.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 棕熊的爪子不能像猫那样缩进肉垫里，坚硬耐磨的爪尖无论刨土还是攀岩都毫不磨损！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike cats, bear claws never retract into their pads, making them permanent heavy-duty all-terrain crampons!

bodyParts.descZh: 类似人类脚掌的“跖行性”宽阔厚肉垫，表面布满防滑微米小肉刺和柔韧皮革纹理，将重达几百公斤的体重均匀分散在深雪与湿滑乱石上，踩踏安静无声。
bodyParts.descEn: Broad, plantigrade leather-padded soles that disperse hundreds of kilograms of body weight evenly over deep snow and slick river boulders while silencing footsteps.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 棕熊走路时整个脚底完全着地（和人类一模一样），这叫“跖行”，让它们能用后腿稳稳直立站起来环视四周！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Bears walk flat on the soles of their feet just like humans (plantigrade), enabling them to stand tall on hind legs to inspect the horizon!

bodyParts.nameZh: 超嗅觉大鼻腔与湿润鼻镜
bodyParts.descZh: 硕大湿润的黑色鼻镜内藏有极其发达的嗅觉上皮褶皱，嗅觉感受细胞数量是人类的 100 多倍、比最灵敏的猎犬还要强 7 倍，能闻到数公里外上风口的成熟野果和腐木气味。
bodyParts.descEn: An extraordinarily sensitive olfactory organ packed with millions of scent receptors, boasting an olfactory sense 7 times sharper than a bloodhound’s.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 棕熊能闻到埋在1米厚坚冰之下深处的死鱼气味，是陆地哺乳动物界数一数二的“超级嗅探仪”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A brown bear can smell animal carcasses buried beneath a meter of solid ice miles away, possessing the keenest nose on land!

bodyParts.descZh: 棕熊背部标志性的高耸肉峰，由极其强大的斜方肌与三角肌群构成，为两条粗壮的前肢提供毁灭性的挖掘杠杆力和惊人的拍击力。
bodyParts.descEn: A signature anatomical hump formed by massive trapezius and shoulder muscles that anchor and supercharge forelimb digging power and crushing swat forces.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 黑熊没有这个肌肉肩峰，只有棕熊长着这个强壮的“力量核引擎”，让它们能像推土机一样轻松翻倒巨树倒木！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Black bears lack this shoulder hump! It is unique to brown bears and acts like an excavator engine to push down heavy fallen logs!

bodyParts.pinyin: shuāng céng bǎo nuǎn máo pí
bodyParts.descZh: 外层是长达 15 厘米、带有油质防水膜的长刚毛（灰熊的毛尖常呈银灰色），内层则是紧贴皮肤的密不透风羊毛状保温绒，在零下几十度冰水漫游依然保持身体干爽温暖。
bodyParts.descEn: A weatherproof double coat featuring long, oily protective guard hairs that shed river water, backed by a dense crimped wool undercoat that traps warm air.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 北美灰熊（Grizzly）的名字正是因为外层毛尖闪耀着银灰霜花般的亮光而得名！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The name "Grizzly" comes from the grizzled, silver-tipped frosted guard hairs that sparkle across their outer coat!

bodyParts.descZh: 粗壮有力的圆锥形犬齿长达数厘米，配合强劲的下颌嚼肌能爆发出近 1200 磅的咬合力；后方平坦开阔的研磨臼齿则专门用来嚼碎植物坚果、草根与甜美浆果。
bodyParts.descEn: Heavy conical ivory canines delivering crushing bite pressures over 1,200 psi, coupled with broad molar tables adapted to grind tough vegetable pulp and nuts.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 尽管棕熊看起来凶猛如霸主，但它们食谱中超过 75% 实际上是素食，包括蓝莓、蔓越莓和多汁草根！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Despite their apex predator reputation, over 75% of a brown bear’s everyday diet actually consists of berries, nuts, and juicy roots!

bodyParts.descZh: 秋季暴食期（每天狂吃几十公斤高热量食物）在皮下积攒出厚达 10 厘米的厚实脂肪层，冬眠期间新陈代谢减半，全靠分解脂肪维持心跳、呼吸甚至在冬眠中产下幼崽。
bodyParts.descEn: A deep subcutaneous adipose blanket up to 10 centimeters thick accumulated during autumn hyperphagia, sustaining the bear through months of fasting.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 棕熊在秋天进入“暴食模式”，每天能吃下多达 40 条野生鲑鱼，短短两个月体重就能暴涨上百公斤！
bodyParts.funFactEn: During autumn "hyperphagia", a brown bear can devour up to 40 salmon in a single day, packing on over 100 kg of fat in weeks!

bodyParts.descZh: 小巧圆润的杯状双耳，耳内布满防寒防水的纤细毛丛；能灵敏感知森林深处踩碎枯枝或河流白浪中大马哈鱼跳跃拍打水花的高频声波。
bodyParts.descEn: Compact, furry cup-shaped ears lined with moisture-repellent hairs, calibrated to detect the high-frequency snap of twigs or splashing salmon in noisy rivers.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在咆哮奔腾的瀑布声浪旁，棕熊依然能敏锐听到几十米外树林里小动物踩断枯枝的微弱咔嚓声！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Even alongside roaring whitewater rapids, a bear’s ears can filter out river noise to detect a snapping twig in the forest canopy!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Heavy Curved Fishing Claws (重型长弧弯钩巨爪)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Heavy Curved Fishing Claws
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！棕熊长达 10 厘米的实心弯爪不仅能掀翻巨石，还是抓取湿滑鲑鱼的天然鱼叉！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The 10-cm heavy curved claws serve as powerful excavation tools and natural salmon gaffs!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 棕熊背部高耸隆起的结构是由什么构成的？它给棕熊带来了什么超能力？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What constitutes the hump on the brown bear’s back, and what superpower does it provide?

options.textZh: 肩部强力隆起肌肉峰 (Muscular Shoulder Hump)
厚实冬眠脂肪贮存层 (Fat Layer)
双层防水保暖毛皮 (Dual-Layer Fur)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！高耸的肩峰是由发达的斜方肌等肌肉组成的，为前肢提供了掀翻巨木、快速挖洞的超强神力！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! The hump is a powerhouse of dense shoulder muscles that gives the bear extraordinary digging and striking strength!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 棕熊的嗅觉比人类灵敏多少倍？靠哪个身体部位能闻到几公里外的食物？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part provides an extraordinary sense of smell capable of detecting food miles away?

options.textZh: 超嗅觉大鼻腔与湿润鼻镜 (Olfactory Snout)
敏锐半圆定向听觉耳 (Acoustic Ears)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！棕熊湿润的大鼻腔内充满嗅觉感受神经，嗅觉比猎犬还要强 7 倍，是顶级觅食导航仪！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! The moist olfactory snout has a sense of smell 7 times sharper than a bloodhound’s, smelling food across immense distances!

nicknameZh: 非洲水域的粉红巨口大肚汉与水底漫步大将
nicknameEn: The Heavyweight Water-Walking Giant of Africa
lifespan: 野外约 40 - 50 年，圈养可达 50 年以上
food: 夜间啃食矮草、芦苇和水生植物，一晚能吃 40-50 kg
habitat: 撒哈拉以南非洲的河流、湖泊及周边泛滥平原草地
speed: 水底漫步约 8 km/h，陆地短距离冲刺可达 30 km/h
overviewZh: 河马是非洲水域中最令人惊叹的半水栖巨兽！虽然名字里有个“马”，但它在演化树上最亲密的表亲其实是鲸鱼和海豚。河马的身体密度比水大，它们不会游泳或漂浮，而是在水底像宇航员太空漫步一样轻盈跳跃奔跑。它们白天泡在水里防晒避暑，夜晚则上岸大口啃草。巨大的下颌能张开近 150 度，拥有自然界中最具威慑力的巨口！
overviewEn: The hippopotamus is an awe-inspiring semi-aquatic heavyweight native to sub-Saharan Africa! Despite its name meaning "river horse", its closest living relatives are actually whales and dolphins. Hippos are too dense to float, so instead of swimming, they gallop gracefully along riverbeds like astronauts on the moon. They spend hot days submerged to stay cool, emerging at night to graze vast grasslands.

bodyParts.pinyin: fěn hóng liè è jù kǒu
bodyParts.descZh: 铰链式双关节下颌能张开惊人的 150 度直角大口！咬合力超过 12,000 牛顿，相当于一辆小轿车压在单个点上，能瞬间将整个大西瓜压得粉碎。
bodyParts.descEn: A double-hinged jaw that opens to an astonishing 150 degrees with a crushing bite force over 12,000 Newtons, capable of snapping a whole watermelon in half in a split second.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 河马张大嘴巴常常不是在打哈欠，而是在向周围邻居炫耀自己的威力和牙齿，意思是“看我有多强壮”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When a hippo yawns wide, it is rarely tired! It is actually flashing its massive teeth to declare territory and warn rivals!

bodyParts.nameZh: 象牙质自锐式锋利獠牙
bodyParts.pinyin: zì ruì fāng lì liáo yá
bodyParts.descZh: 下颌长有一对长达 50 厘米的象牙质下犬齿，上下牙咬合时不断相互研磨，如同两把自带磨刀石的锋利匕首，终生不断生长。
bodyParts.descEn: Lower canine tusks can reach 50 cm in length. Upper and lower teeth grind continuously against each other, acting like self-whetting daggers that grow throughout life.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 河马的獠牙硬度极高，自古以来就因为质地细腻且不会泛黄而受到关注，甚至能一口咬穿鳄鱼坚硬的背甲！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Hippo canine tusks are made of dense ivory that resists yellowing, and their bite can easily puncture a crocodile’s toughest armor!

bodyParts.nameZh: 天然防晒杀菌血汗黏液
bodyParts.pinyin: tiān rán fáng shài xuè hàn
bodyParts.descZh: 皮肤皮脂腺分泌出的无色液体在阳光下氧化变红，看起来像“流血”，实际上是由河马酸组成的天然三重护肤霜：强效防晒、杀菌止血和水下防脱水。
bodyParts.descEn: Subdermal glands secrete an oily liquid that turns reddish-orange under sunlight. Known as "blood sweat", it functions as an all-in-one sunscreen, antibiotic, and moisturizer.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 科学家发现河马的“血汗”不仅能吸收紫外线防晒，即使在满是泥巴细菌的水塘里打架受伤，伤口也不会发炎感染！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Hippo sweat contains pigments that absorb damaging UV rays while killing dangerous aquatic bacteria, keeping cuts clean even in muddy rivers!

bodyParts.descZh: 眼睛、小巧的耳朵和带肌肉阀门的鼻孔整齐排列在头骨最顶端。身体浸没水下时只需露出头顶几厘米，就能无缝侦察、监听并换气呼吸。
bodyParts.descEn: The eyes, ears, and nostril valves sit aligned atop the flat crown of the skull, functioning like a submarine periscope to see, hear, and breathe while 95% submerged.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 河马潜入水下时，耳道和鼻孔会自动像拉链一样紧紧闭合，连一滴水都渗不进去！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When submerging, muscular sphincters automatically clamp the hippo’s slit nostrils and folded ears watertight like airtight hatches!

bodyParts.pinyin: chāo hòu zhuāng jiǎ pí fū
bodyParts.descZh: 河马的皮肤厚度可达 5 厘米，表皮下有着极厚致密的胶原纤维层，如同一层天然厚橡胶装甲，能够缓冲争斗中的獠牙撞击。
bodyParts.descEn: Dermal skin up to 5 cm thick backed by dense collagen fibers creates a natural rubberized armor plate that cushions bone-crunching territorial clashes.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 河马的皮虽然极厚坚固，但角质层很薄，离开水几个小时就会严重脱水干裂，所以白天必须一直泡在清凉的水里！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Despite being bullet-tough, hippo skin lacks sebaceous moisture locks and dehydrates rapidly in dry air, requiring long daytime water soaks!

bodyParts.nameZh: 四趾半蹼水底漫步重足
bodyParts.pinyin: sì zhǐ bàn pǔ zhòng zú
bodyParts.descZh: 四只粗壮如柱的圆腿末端长有四个对称的脚趾，趾间生有厚实的皮蹼。这种构造能均匀分散吨级体重，在淤泥河床上如履平地。
bodyParts.descEn: Pillar-like stout legs end in four splayed hoofed toes connected by partial webbing, distributing heavy tonnage evenly across slippery, muddy riverbeds.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 河马在水下完全不会划水游泳，而是蹬动水底河床一跳一跳地滑翔奔跑，单次跳跃可以滑行数米远！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Hippos do not swim at all! They push off the river bottom, gliding in semi-weightless bounds like astronauts bounding across the moon!

bodyParts.pinyin: luó xuán jiǎng huà jiè wěi
bodyParts.descZh: 短粗扁平的尾巴边缘长着硬毛。在排便时，尾巴会像高速螺旋桨风扇一样左右飞速抽打旋转，将气味颗粒喷洒向周围数十米树丛以宣示领地。
bodyParts.descEn: A short, paddle-shaped tail fringed with stiff bristles. During defecation, it whirls like a high-speed propeller to scatter scent markings across territory bushes.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 河马的“螺旋桨尾巴”喷洒气味时范围可达几十米，其他河马只要闻一闻气味，就能知道这是哪位霸主的地盘！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A hippo’s propeller tail can fling scent markings over ten meters away, signaling identity, social rank, and territory boundaries to the whole river!

bodyParts.nameZh: 天然配重实心沉潜骨骼
bodyParts.pinyin: shí xīn chén qián gǔ gé
bodyParts.descZh: 河马的肋骨和四肢长骨具有极高的骨密度（骨硬化），骨髓腔几乎完全被致密骨质填满，像潜水艇的铅压舱物一样提供负浮力，让它能稳立水底。
bodyParts.descEn: Pachyosteosclerotic dense bones with solid marrow cavities act like internal scuba diving weights, granting stable negative buoyancy in rushing river currents.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 正是因为这种天然的“实心重骨头”，成年河马完全不用划水就能轻松停留在河底深处闭气长达 5 分钟！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Thanks to their solid heavy bones, adult hippos sink naturally to the river floor and can comfortably hold their breath underwater for over 5 minutes!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 河马在水底能像太空漫步一样蹦跳奔跑，依靠的是哪个身体部位呢？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part allows the hippo to walk and bound along the riverbed like an astronaut?

options.textZh: 四趾半蹼水底漫步重足

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 河马由于骨骼实心沉重不会浮水，四只脚趾间长有坚韧的皮蹼，能让它在泥泞河床上稳健漫步蹬跳！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Dense bones cause hippos to sink, but their webbed, four-toed feet allow them to walk and glide effortlessly across muddy riverbeds!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请找出被称为河马“天然防晒霜与杀菌膏”的部位：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Find the special secretion known as the hippo’s natural sunscreen and antibiotic:

options.textZh: 天然防晒杀菌血汗黏液
象牙质自锐式锋利獠牙

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 河马的“血汗”其实不是血液，而是能吸收紫外线并杀灭水中细菌的天然护肤分泌物！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Hippo blood-sweat is not real blood, but an extraordinary natural red liquid that blocks UV rays and prevents bacterial infections!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 河马几乎整个身体潜入水中时，仍然能观察四周、听到声音并呼吸，依靠的是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which structure lets a submerged hippo see, hear, and breathe above water like a submarine?

options.textZh: 天然配重实心沉潜骨骼

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 河马的眼睛、小耳朵和鼻孔长在头顶同一水平线，像潜水艇潜望镜一样露出水面即可兼顾警戒与呼吸！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: The hippo’s eyes, ears, and nostrils sit neatly aligned on top of its skull, peering out like a submarine periscope!

nicknameZh: 马达加斯加的条纹长尾魔术师与朝阳瑜伽大师
nicknameEn: The Striped-Tailed Sun-Worshipper of Madagascar
length: 体长 39 - 46 cm，尾长 56 - 63 cm，体重约 2.2 kg
lifespan: 野外约 16 - 19 年，圈养可达 25 年以上
food: 罗望子树叶、野果、花蜜、树皮汁液以及少量昆虫
habitat: 马达加斯加岛南部的干旱刺灌丛、落叶林及河岸走廊林
speed: 树冠腾跃敏捷，地面步态轻盈，四肢奔跑可达 20 km/h
overviewZh: 环尾狐猴是马达加斯加岛最富盛名的大自然明星！它们长着一条黑白相间、比身子还长的大尾巴，尾巴上交替排列着 13 圈纯黑与纯白环纹。每天清晨太阳初升时，狐猴群会像老僧入定一样面向朝阳盘腿端坐，展开肚皮晒太阳取暖，因而被尊称为“太阳的崇拜者”。它们聪明活泼、社会性极强，母狐猴更是家族中的尊贵首领！
overviewEn: The ring-tailed lemur is the most charismatic wildlife icon of Madagascar! Known for its flamboyant tail ringed with 13 alternating black and white bands, it uses this magnificent appendage as a balance pole in high canopies and a signal flag on the forest floor. Every morning, groups gather to sit cross-legged facing the sunrise like yoga masters. Living in female-led social troops, they are extraordinarily communicative and gentle!

bodyParts.pinyin: hēi bái xiāng jiān huán wěi
bodyParts.descZh: 长达 60 厘米的毛茸茸长尾拥有 13 圈黑白分明的环纹。在地面行进时高高竖起像一面旗帜防止队员走丢，在树冠跳跃时则是不可或缺的动力学平衡杆。
bodyParts.descEn: A fluffy 60-cm tail patterned with precisely 13 bold black-and-white rings. Held upright like a flagstaff to maintain troop coherence, it acts as a dynamic balance pole in mid-air leaps.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 狐猴的尾巴虽然很长很漂亮，但不能像南美洲猴子那样倒挂卷住树枝（非卷缠尾），完全依靠平衡感！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike South American monkeys, a ring-tailed lemur’s tail is not prehensile; it cannot grasp branches and is used purely for balance and signaling!

bodyParts.nameZh: 晨曦朝阳瑜伽冥想胸腹
bodyParts.pinyin: chén xī yú jiā xiōng fù
bodyParts.descZh: 胸腹部覆盖着柔软稀疏的白色绒毛。由于夜间森林气温骤降，清晨狐猴会盘腿面向初升红日，摊开双臂呈瑜伽静坐姿势，让朝阳直接晒暖胸腹核心血管。
bodyParts.descEn: A creamy-white, sparsely furred chest and belly. After chilly nights, lemurs assume a classic lotus-like sitting pose facing the morning sun to rapidly warm their core blood vessels.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 因为每天清晨全群狐猴一起整整齐齐地打坐晒太阳，当地居民曾以为它们是能与太阳神沟通的神圣精灵！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Seeing whole troops meditating quietly toward the dawn, early local observers affectionately nicknamed them "Sun Worshippers"!

bodyParts.nameZh: 晶莹金色琥珀圆瞳大眼
bodyParts.pinyin: jīn sè hǔ pò yuán tóng
bodyParts.descZh: 如同两颗金黄透明的琉璃宝石，眼周有一圈黑眼影般的面具花纹。视网膜后带有反光膜（照膜），在夜间和晨昏光线昏暗时依然能清晰捕捉周围细节。
bodyParts.descEn: Large, expressive golden-amber irises set within dramatic dark teardrop masks. Behind the retina sits a tapetum lucidum reflective layer, enhancing light sensitivity during dawn and dusk.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 狐猴的眼睛在黑夜里被手电筒照到时，会反射出金幽幽的亮光，古罗马人因此用“幽灵（Lemures）”为它们命名！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Their reflective eyes glow eerily in nighttime torchlight, leading 18th-century naturalists to name them after Roman ancestral spirits, the "Lemures"!

bodyParts.nameZh: 下颌特化精密梳妆牙齿梳
bodyParts.descZh: 下颌门齿和犬齿向前平行平伸，密集排列成一把细密的骨质小发梳。它专门用于同伴之间理毛清洁寄生虫，也是刮取树干可口汁液的精巧餐具。
bodyParts.descEn: Lower incisors and canines tilted forward into a fine, horizontal comb. This unique dental tool grooms dense fur, removes ticks, and scrapes nutritious gum from tree bark.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 狐猴舌头下方还藏着第二个特殊的“小舌头（sublingua）”，就像小刷子一样专门用来剔除牙梳里卡住的毛发！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Beneath the tongue lies a jagged secondary tongue called the sublingua, designed specifically to clean stray hairs from the toothcomb!

bodyParts.nameZh: 前腕角质刺与臭味对决腺
bodyParts.descZh: 前肢手腕内侧长有一枚坚硬的角质小刺，下方连着气味腺。雄性狐猴会将手腕摩擦树枝划出气味痕迹，更会将分泌物涂抹在长尾巴上进行“臭气大战”。
bodyParts.descEn: Horny spurs on the inner wrists connected to antebrachial glands. Lemurs rub these across branches to leave olfactory signatures and scent-mark their tails for ritual "stink fights".
bodyParts.funFactZh: 雄狐猴争夺领地时几乎从不打架流血，而是站在原地把涂满臭腺液的尾巴甩给对方，谁先被对方的体味熏跑谁就输！
bodyParts.funFactEn: During territory disputes, males conduct harmless "stink fights"—waving their scent-soaked tails at rivals until one gives up and retreats!

bodyParts.nameZh: 弹簧般强劲雨林跳跃后肢
bodyParts.pinyin: tán huáng tiào yuè hòu zhī
bodyParts.descZh: 修长且肌肉发达的后腿具有高弹性肌腱，在树林枝桠间起跳时能提供强大的瞬间推力，在开阔岩石与林冠间能横向腾空飞跃超过 3 米。
bodyParts.descEn: Elongated, muscular hind limbs with elastic tendons that act as powerful springs, propelling the lemur across vertical rock faces and forest gaps up to 3 meters.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在地面平地上奔跑时，狐猴有时会像跳跳糖一样侧身双腿蹦跳前进，步伐欢快滑稽得像在跳芭蕾舞！
bodyParts.funFactEn: On open ground, lemurs often bounce sideways on their springy hind legs in a joyful, skipping gallop that looks like a miniature ballet!

bodyParts.nameZh: 黑色抓握肉垫与灵巧手掌
bodyParts.pinyin: zhuā wò ròu diàn shǒu zhǎng
bodyParts.descZh: 手掌与脚掌覆盖着细腻防滑的黑色无毛肉垫，拥有完全对生的拇指。第二脚趾长着专门用于挠痒理毛的弯曲“梳妆爪”，其余趾端均为平坦指甲。
bodyParts.descEn: Hairless black friction pads on sensitive palms with opposable thumbs for strong branch grasp. The second toe bears an elongated "toilet-claw" purely for scratching and self-grooming.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 狐猴的手指纹路和人类非常相似，黑色掌垫像吸盘一样即使在被雨水打湿的光滑树皮上也能紧紧抓住不打滑！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Lemurs have intricate dermatoglyphic ridges (fingerprints) on their rubbery black pads, providing superb anti-slip traction even on rain-slicked branches!

bodyParts.nameZh: 机敏狐样黑鼻尖与黑白面具脸谱
bodyParts.pinyin: jī mǐn hú yàng miàn jù
bodyParts.descZh: 尖挺如狐狸的面部轮廓，黑色湿润的鼻镜（鼻黏膜），四周是纯白色的脸颊和黑色眼眶构成的几何面具。湿润的鼻头能极其敏锐地嗅探微风中熟透果实的气息。
bodyParts.descEn: A pointed vulpine muzzle tipped with a moist rhinarium, framed by snow-white cheeks and bold dark triangular eye markings, granting acute olfactory tracking of ripe forest fruits.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 狐猴属于原始灵长类（原猴类），保留着像小狗小猫一样湿漉漉的鼻子，嗅觉比人类和普通猴子灵敏得多！
bodyParts.funFactEn: As primitive strepsirrhine primates, lemurs retain a wet canine-like dog nose (rhinarium) that provides a much sharper sense of smell than monkeys or apes!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 环尾狐猴在早晨面向朝阳盘腿打坐，用来吸收温暖阳光的是哪个部位？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part does the ring-tailed lemur expose to the morning sun in its iconic yoga pose?

options.textZh: 晨曦朝阳瑜伽冥想胸腹
前腕角质刺与臭味对决腺

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 环尾狐猴早晨会坐在树干或石头上面向朝阳，敞开腹部的白色毛发晒暖身体核心血管！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Lemurs sit upright like meditating monks, exposing their white chest and belly directly to the morning sunlight to warm up!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请找出环尾狐猴用来保持平衡和像信号旗一样招展的标志性结构：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Find the iconic structure that acts as a balance pole in jumps and a signal flag on the ground:

options.textZh: 下颌特化精密梳妆牙齿梳
晶莹金色琥珀圆瞳大眼

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 环尾狐猴的大长尾巴上有 13 圈黑白相间的环纹，跳跃时用来平衡，在草丛行进时高高竖起指引队伍！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: The ring-tailed lemur’s famous 13-ringed tail functions as a dynamic counterbalance in mid-air and a visual beacon for the troop!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 环尾狐猴藏在下颌、专门用来互相梳理毛发的小工具是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: What specialized dental tool does the lemur use to comb dense fur and remove ticks?

options.textZh: 下颌特化精密梳妆牙齿梳
机敏狐样黑鼻尖与黑白面具脸谱
黑色抓握肉垫与灵巧手掌

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 狐猴的下门牙向前平平伸展，形成天然的“牙齿梳”，用来替同伴理毛梳发和刮食树汁！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Lower incisors form a toothcomb that cleans parasites from fur and gently scrapes nutritional sap from trees!

nicknameZh: 海洋智多星与跃浪跳水家
nicknameEn: The Ocean Genius & Wave Acrobat
lifespan: 野外约 40 - 50 年
food: 沙丁鱼、鲱鱼、乌贼与甲壳类
habitat: 全球温带与热带温暖海域、近岸浅海与珊瑚礁
speed: 巡航 5 - 11 km/h (短程冲刺可达 35 km/h)
overviewZh: 宽吻海豚是地球上最聪颖迷人的海洋哺乳动物之一，拥有媲美灵长类的大脑结构与高度社会化的群体协作。它们用头顶喷气孔呼吸新鲜空气，依靠前额额隆发射超声波声呐来精准扫描深海，并以标志性的“永恒微笑”和跃出海面的绝技闻名全球。
overviewEn: The Bottlenose Dolphin is one of the ocean's most intelligent and charismatic marine mammals. Famous for its perpetual smile, remarkable social communication, and acrobatic leaps, it navigates the undersea world using sophisticated biosonar echolocation.

bodyParts.descZh: 位于头顶顶端的强力瓣膜气孔，浮出水面瞬间喷出湿润水雾并快速吸入新鲜空气，潜水时自动严密关闭防水。
bodyParts.descEn: A powerful muscular valve at the top of the head that opens in a split-second to blast out stale air and inhale before sealing tight underwater.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海豚睡觉时左右脑轮流休息，醒着的半边大脑负责控制身体按时浮出水面呼吸！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Dolphins sleep with half their brain at a time so they never forget to surface for air!

bodyParts.descZh: 前额圆隆饱满的特殊脂肪体，宛如天然声学透镜，将体内发出的高频咔哒声聚焦成束投射向前方探测猎物。
bodyParts.descEn: A rounded fatty organ in the forehead acting like an acoustic lens, focusing clicks into narrow biosonar beams to scan the deep.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 通过额隆的声呐回声，海豚甚至能在浑浊的海水中“看穿”沙子底下埋着的整条鱼骨！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A dolphin's biosonar is so powerful it can "see" a hidden fish buried under sea sand like an X-ray!

bodyParts.descZh: 背部弯曲如弯刀的厚实背鳍充当水动力稳定器，防止海豚在疾速穿梭与破浪跳跃时身体失控左右翻滚。
bodyParts.descEn: A hydrodynamic sickle-shaped dorsal fin that prevents rolling and stabilizes the dolphin during high-speed leaps and sharp turns.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 每只海豚背鳍上的微小缺口和划痕都是终身独一无二的，科学家就像用“人脸识别”一样靠背鳍认出它们！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Each dolphin's dorsal fin has unique nicks and markings, functioning just like a human fingerprint!

bodyParts.descZh: 完全水平生长的坚韧无骨肌肉尾翼，通过上下强力挥击产生排山倒海的水流推进力，能让海豚腾空飞跃数米高。
bodyParts.descEn: Boneless horizontal muscular flukes driven by a powerful tail stock, flapping up and down to propel the dolphin skyward.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 鱼类的尾巴是左右摆动的，而海豚作为哺乳动物，尾巴是上下扇动起伏的！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Fish swim by moving their tail left-to-right; marine mammals like dolphins flap their tail up-and-down!

bodyParts.descZh: 胸前一对灵活的宽扁鳍肢，内部其实藏着和人类手臂完全相同的五指骨骼，主要用于水中急转弯、刹车与平衡。
bodyParts.descEn: Flexible paddle-shaped flippers concealing five-finger skeletal structures identical to human hands, used for steering and braking.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 如果给海豚的胸鳍拍一张X光片，你会惊奇地发现里面有一只完整的“小手骨”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Inside a dolphin's flipper rests a skeletal hand complete with five finger bones evolved from ancient land ancestors!

bodyParts.descZh: 修长坚硬的鸟喙状口吻，不仅符合极致流体力学破水减阻，还能在沙底轻轻翻开泥沙搜寻隐藏的猎物。
bodyParts.descEn: An elongated hydrodynamic bottle-like beak that slices through water resistance and probes seabed sand for burrowed food.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 宽吻海豚的名字“Bottlenose”正是因为它的口吻形状特别像一个复古的小玻璃瓶！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Bottlenose dolphins got their name because their cute snout looks just like an old-fashioned glass bottle!

bodyParts.pinyin: jiǎn zǔ dàn xìng pí fū
bodyParts.descZh: 表面极其光滑富有弹性的无毛外皮，每两小时更新一次外层表皮细胞，能消除水流漩涡阻力达到惊人泳速。
bodyParts.descEn: Rubbery, ultra-smooth outer skin that sheds cells every two hours, suppressing water turbulence to achieve effortless gliding.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海豚皮摸起来就像光滑柔韧的湿橡胶，人类科学家参考它的结构设计出了超快潜艇的消阻外层！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Dolphin skin feels like silky wet rubber and has inspired submarine engineers to build low-friction hulls!

bodyParts.descZh: 微向上翘的嘴角让海豚看起来永远在甜甜微笑，上下颚布满80至100枚坚韧的圆锥形小尖齿，能紧紧咬住滑溜的游鱼。
bodyParts.descEn: An iconic upturned jaw line giving an eternal cheerful smile, armed with up to 100 sharp interlocking cone-shaped teeth to grip slippery fish.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海豚一辈子只长一套牙齿，它们从不用牙齿咀嚼食物，而是直接整条吞下大鱼！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Dolphins have only one set of teeth for their entire life, and they swallow fish whole without ever chewing!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 海豚用身体哪个部位发射超声波声呐，像“透镜”一样在海里探测前方的小鱼群？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part acts as a biosonar lens to focus ultrasound beams for echolocation?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！海豚前额圆圆的“额隆”就像一个超声波聚焦透镜，是它水下探路的秘密法宝！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The rounded melon in the forehead focuses acoustic sound clicks into a precise scanning sonar beam!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的部位：Horizontal Tail Flukes (强力推进尾叶)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Horizontal Tail Flukes
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！海豚水平的尾叶通过上下大力摆动，能爆发出惊人的推力跃出水面！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Flukes pump up and down to produce immense underwater thrust!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 如果给海豚身体哪个部位拍X光片，会发现里面藏着和人类一样神奇的“五指小手骨”？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Inside which part can you find five finger bones inherited from ancient land ancestors?

options.textZh: 转向平衡胸鳍 (内含五指骨)
镰状稳定背鳍 (无骨软组织)
强力推进尾叶 (肌肉纤维韧带)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太神奇了！海豚的胸鳍内部骨骼与我们人类的小手一模一样，证明几千万年前海豚的祖先曾生活在陆地上！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! The pectoral flippers house five-digit finger bones that reveal their land mammal ancestry!

nicknameZh: 海葵城堡里的橙白探险家
nicknameEn: The Sea Anemone Dweller & Reef Explorer
length: 体长 7 - 11 厘米 / 体重 10 - 25 克
lifespan: 野外约 6 - 10 年 (人工饲养可达 15 年)
food: 微型浮游动物、桡足类、丝状藻与海葵食物残屑
habitat: 印度洋与太平洋温暖珊瑚礁区海葵丛中
speed: 敏捷游动，短程摇摆冲刺
overviewZh: 小丑鱼是热带珊瑚礁中最受欢迎的明星小精灵，因鲜艳的橙红底色与三道白黑镶边斑纹而得名。它们与致命剧毒的海葵达成了神奇的“互利共生”盟约，依靠自身特制的抗毒粘液在带刺触手丛中安家，成为大自然共生演化的奇迹。
overviewEn: The Ocellaris Clownfish is a beloved coral reef jewel, instantly recognized by its brilliant orange body adorned with three bold white bands. Protected by an immunity-granting mucus coat, it thrives fearlessly inside deadly stinging sea anemone tentacles.

bodyParts.descZh: 体表分泌的一层富含糖蛋白的特殊粘液膜，海葵触手接触它时会误认为是自己的身体，因而绝不发射刺细胞毒刺。
bodyParts.descEn: A specialized thick glycoprotein slime layer covering the body, fooling anemone tentacles into treating the clownfish as part of itself.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 新诞生的小丑鱼一开始没有免疫力，需要一点点试探蹭海葵，慢慢把海葵的气味涂满全身才能不怕毒刺！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Baby clownfish aren't born immune; they must gently acclimate by coating themselves in the anemone's own mucus!

bodyParts.descZh: 贯穿头颈、侧腹与尾柄的三道雪白垂直斑纹，边缘镶有一圈精致黑线，在珊瑚礁阳光下起到醒目的家族标识作用。
bodyParts.descEn: Three clean snowy vertical stripes outlined in fine black pigment that signal pride identity and break up the fish's outline.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 每条小丑鱼身上的白色斑条弯曲程度都有细微差别，就像各自带着专属身份证！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The curve and black outlines of each white bar vary slightly between individual clownfish like an ID card!

bodyParts.descZh: 大而圆润的半透明橙黄胸鳍像两把小圆扇，能够像打太极般独立前后摆动，让它在密密麻麻的触手缝隙中敏捷倒车穿行。
bodyParts.descEn: Broad, rounded paddle-like pectoral fins that wave back-and-forth independently, granting agile backward swimming through tentacles.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 小丑鱼游起泳来左摇右摆像一只可爱的小企鹅，这也正是它被称为“小丑”的原因之一！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Clownfish swim with a comical, waddling paddle motion that inspired their circus clown namesake!

bodyParts.descZh: 布满成千上万微型毒刺触手的海葵是小丑鱼温暖的家，为它阻隔凶猛掠食者；作为报答小丑鱼为海葵清理寄生虫与带来食物。
bodyParts.descEn: A living forest of stinging anemone tentacles providing safe refuge from predators, while the fish cleans debris and defends the anemone.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 如果离开海葵，小丑鱼在弱肉强食的珊瑚礁中很容易被大鱼吃掉，它们是永远分不开的“好闺蜜”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Without its sea anemone bodyguard, a vulnerable clownfish rarely survives for long in the open reef!

bodyParts.descZh: 长在背部的连续背鳍，前半段包含10根坚硬锐利的硬棘，当遇到危险时会立刻竖立炸开，防止贪吃大鱼轻易下咽。
bodyParts.descEn: A continuous dorsal fin armed with 10 rigid anterior spines that flare upright instantly to prevent predators from swallowing it whole.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 小丑鱼在领地被侵犯时，会一边竖起背鳍一边通过上下颚撞击发出“哒哒”的恐吓警告声！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When defending its anemone, a clownfish raises its spines and clicks its teeth loudly to scare off intruders!

bodyParts.descZh: 圆钝扇形的橙色尾鳍，末梢带有纤细黑边，轻柔摆动即可实现原地360度急转调头，迅速钻入海葵根部躲避攻击。
bodyParts.descEn: A truncated, paddle-like orange tail fin bordered in black, offering instant pivot turns to dart safely into anemone bases.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 小丑鱼虽然长得漂亮，但并不是擅长远游的长跑健将，它们一生往往只呆在方圆几米的海葵周围！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Clownfish rarely travel more than a few feet away from their host anemone during their entire lifetime!

bodyParts.descZh: 大而灵动的深色眼眸外圈环绕着金色虹膜，具备极高对比度视觉，能在斑驳复杂的珊瑚礁光影中瞬间发现微小浮游饵料。
bodyParts.descEn: Large, dark curious eyes framed by a warm orange iris, adapted with high contrast to spot tiny drifting copepods among coral shadows.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 小丑鱼的视力非常好，哪怕在夜间微光下，也能一眼盯住飘过的一粒细如针尖的微小浮游虾！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Clownfish possess acute color vision capable of spotting pinpoint plankton in dappled coral reef waters!

bodyParts.descZh: 小巧而强韧的突出口吻，内布密密麻麻的微小角质细齿，不仅能轻巧啄食微小甲壳动物，还能帮海葵啄除附着的杂物。
bodyParts.descEn: A terminal mouth packed with rows of fine teeth, engineered to snap up tiny crustaceans and groom the host anemone clean.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 小丑鱼其实是个“勤劳的管家”，它们经常把抓到的大块食物叼回海葵身边，亲自“喂”给海葵吃！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Clownfish are attentive housekeepers—they actively carry larger food morsels back to feed their anemone host!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 小丑鱼为什么能在剧毒的海葵触手丛中自由穿梭而不被毒刺蛰伤？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Why can clownfish swim safely inside deadly sea anemones without getting stung?

options.textZh: 抗毒粘液保护层 (海葵误认是自己人)
警惕立起背鳍棘 (用刺反击海葵)
亮白警示警戒纹 (把海葵吓跑)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！小丑鱼体表覆盖着一层特制的抗毒粘液，海葵碰到它以为是自己身上的肉，所以绝不会放毒刺！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Their skin secretes a protective mucus layer that prevents anemone tentacles from releasing stingers!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的部位：Rounded Paddling Pectoral Fins (灵活漫游圆胸鳍)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Rounded Paddling Pectoral Fins
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太聪明啦！圆圆的胸鳍像小船桨一样扇动，让小丑鱼在复杂的海葵触手中灵活倒车穿梭！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Super! Rounded pectoral fins flutter like gentle oars, allowing the fish to maneuver backward effortlessly!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 小丑鱼一生中几乎寸步不离的“带刺保镖好朋友”是哪种神奇生物？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which stinging creature serves as the lifelong protective companion of the clownfish?

options.textZh: 共生带刺海葵家 (互利共生)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对啦！小丑鱼和海葵是海洋中最著名的互利共生伙伴，互相保护、形影不离！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! The sea anemone and clownfish share an extraordinary lifelong mutualistic friendship!

nicknameZh: 海洋萌力天花板与巨藻森林工具大师
nicknameEn: The Floating Mascot & Kelp Forest Tool Master
lifespan: 野外约 15 - 20 年
food: 海胆、鲍鱼、螃蟹、蛤蜊、贻贝 (每天吃体重 25% 的食物)
habitat: 北太平洋沿岸巨藻森林与冷温带近岸浅海
speed: 水面仰泳 2 - 3 km/h (水下潜水冲刺达 9 km/h)
overviewZh: 海獭是体型最小的海洋哺乳动物之一，以标志性的“水面仰泳”与萌翻众人的揉脸行为闻名。它们没有厚重鲸脂，全靠地球上最浓密密实的防水皮毛保暖。海獭还是极罕见的能够使用石头作为“砧板工具”砸开硬壳的海洋智慧精灵，守护着整片巨藻森林的生态平衡。
overviewEn: The Sea Otter is an iconic marine mammal famous for floating effortlessly on its back, wrapping in kelp, and holding hands. Lacking blubber, it possesses the densest fur in the animal kingdom and is one of the rare non-human mammals to regularly use stone tools to crack open hard shellfish.

bodyParts.descZh: 地球上最密集的毛皮，每平方厘米超十万根毛发。双层结构牢牢锁住微小空气泡，让冰冷刺骨的海水根本碰不到皮肤。
bodyParts.descEn: The densest fur coat in the animal kingdom, trapping a microscopic layer of air bubbles so icy ocean water never touches its skin.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海獭经常把手放在脸上搓呀搓，不是在害羞卖萌，而是因为它们的手掌没有毛发容易受凉，在给手手暖和呢！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When sea otters rub their cheeks with their paws, they're actually warming their hairless paw pads against warm facial fur!

bodyParts.descZh: 短小而极具抓握力的小爪子，底部有粗糙防滑肉垫并带有可收缩利爪，能灵巧抓起沉重的石块和带尖刺的海胆。
bodyParts.descEn: Nimble paws equipped with rough traction pads and semi-retractable claws, engineered to grip stones and manipulate thorny sea urchins.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海獭是除灵长类以外极少数会使用工具的哺乳动物，它们能一秒钟敲击石头两三次来砸开坚硬的贝壳！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Sea otters are master tool users, pounding shellfish against flat chest stones up to three times per second!

bodyParts.descZh: 前肢腋下两旁长有宽松富有弹性的专属皮肤褶皱，宛如随身手提袋，用来存放捕获的贝类以及心爱专属的砸贝小石头。
bodyParts.descEn: A loose, expandable flap of skin under each forearm functioning as a natural grocery bag for storing shellfish and prized rocks.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 很多海獭一生都只保留一颗自己最顺手的小石头，无论游到哪里都会把这块“专属宝贝”藏在腋下的百宝袋里！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Many sea otters have a favorite stone they cherish for life, keeping it safely tucked away in their underarm pocket!

bodyParts.descZh: 大而扁平的大号脚蹼，五趾间连有厚实的黑色皮膜，仰泳时像小船桨一样轻松划水，在水下则能爆发出飞鱼般的泳速。
bodyParts.descEn: Large, flat flipper-like hind feet connected by thick leathery webs, paddling like twin oars while floating on its back.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海獭睡觉时为了不被海流冲散，同伴之间会把小爪子紧紧“手牵手”扣在一起，或者用海草把自己绑住！
bodyParts.funFactEn: To avoid drifting away while sleeping, sea otters hold paws in "rafts" and wrap themselves tightly in giant kelp ribbons!

bodyParts.descZh: 粗壮肌肉发达的圆扁形尾巴，在水面仰卧时平铺在水面上充当方向舵与平衡浮筒，维持身体在波浪中的绝对平稳。
bodyParts.descEn: A muscular flattened tail resting on the water surface, acting as a stabilizing rudder to keep its body balanced across waves.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 小海獭宝宝刚出生时皮毛空气太多太蓬松，根本无法潜水，像个小软木塞一样只能漂在水面上等妈妈喂食！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Newborn sea otter pups have fur so buoyant they cannot submerge, floating like tiny fuzzy corks on the water surface!

bodyParts.descZh: 鼻吻两侧浓密挺拔的白色触觉胡须，根部连通极其丰富敏锐的神经束，能在浑浊漆黑的巨藻泥沙中精准摸出藏匿的蛤蜊。
bodyParts.descEn: Stout white vibrissae whiskers densely packed with sensitive nerve receptors, pinpointing buried crabs and clams in murky kelp mud.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海獭的胡须超级敏感，哪怕水底下几米外有一只小螃蟹轻轻挪动一下泥土，胡须都能立刻感知到微弱水流！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A sea otter's whiskers can detect microscopic vibrations in water caused by a crab shifting under the sand!

bodyParts.descZh: 与大多数肉食兽尖锐的撕裂齿不同，海獭演化出了又宽又平的圆形磨盘臼齿，能像液压钳一样轻松将坚硬贝壳粉碎。
bodyParts.descEn: Broad, rounded, flat molar teeth built like heavy grinding millstones, evolved specifically to crush tough shells without dulling.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 因为经常嚼食富含紫色天然色素的紫海胆，许多老年海獭的骨骼和牙齿甚至会被慢慢染成神奇的淡紫色！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Because they devour tons of purple sea urchins, elderly sea otters often develop fascinating purple-tinted bones and teeth!

bodyParts.descZh: 仰卧在水面上时宽平而充满浮力的胸腹部，不仅是它们进餐时放置石头与海胆的天然“餐桌”，还是给幼崽安睡的温床。
bodyParts.descEn: A wide buoyant chest acting as a natural floating dinner table for cracking food, as well as a cozy mattress for resting pups.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海獭妈妈出海潜水抓鲍鱼时，会先把宝宝用海草绑在水面上防止飘走，回来后就把宝宝抱在自己胸脯上梳毛！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Mother sea otters gently tether their babies in giant kelp wraps like a hammock while they dive for food!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 海獭在水面上仰泳砸开坚硬贝壳时，会把最心爱的小石头藏在身体哪个“天然百宝袋”里？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Where do sea otters store their favorite rock tools while swimming and foraging?

options.textZh: 腋下装石百宝袋 (皮肤储物褶皱)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！海獭腋下有松软的皮褶当百宝袋，专门用来装最心爱的小石头和抓到的大海胆！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Sea otters have loose underarm skin pouches that function like grocery bags for rocks and shellfish!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的部位：Ultra-Dense Waterproof Fur (百万根防水浓密绒毛)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Ultra-Dense Waterproof Fur
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！海獭拥有动物界最密的毛皮，牢牢锁住空气泡泡，让冰冷刺骨的海水根本湿不到皮肤！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! A sea otter's coat traps millions of microscopic air bubbles to keep them warm in freezing oceans!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 海獭睡觉时为了不被海浪冲散，会用哪个部位和同伴紧紧“手牵手”扣在一起？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part is held in a "hand-in-hand" grasp with family members so they never drift apart?

options.textZh: 灵活五指小肉爪 (手牵手防飘走)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 萌翻啦！海獭两两睡觉时会用前爪紧紧握住对方，像牵着小手一样，在大海里永远不分家！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! Sea otters hold each other's nimble paws while asleep to keep their family raft together!

nicknameZh: 深海超级奶爸与优雅骏马骑士
nicknameEn: The Ocean Super-Dad & Armored Steed
lifespan: 野外约 3 - 5 年
food: 微型糠虾、桡足类与微小浮游甲壳动物 (每天吃上千只)
habitat: 热带与温带沿岸海草床、红树林与珊瑚礁
speed: 世界上游得最慢的鱼类之一 (约 1.5 米/小时)
overviewZh: 海马是一种外形酷似陆地小骏马的特化硬骨鱼。它们全身包裹着坚韧的环形骨板铠甲，拥有像猴子一样能抓握海草的卷曲尾巴，以及能独立转动观察周围的“双向变焦眼”。更令人惊叹的是，海马是自然界中极罕见的由“海马爸爸”怀孕并亲自产下小宝宝的动物！
overviewEn: The Seahorse is a magical, horse-headed bony fish encased in protective ringed armor. Famous for being the only animal where males undergo true pregnancy and give birth, it anchors securely to seagrass with its monkey-like grasping tail and slurps up shrimp through a pipette-like snout.

bodyParts.descZh: 长在雄海马腹部的特殊密封囊袋，内部布满血管养分，海马爸爸在此怀孕、供给氧气，并最终亲自阵痛分娩产下数百只小海马。
bodyParts.descEn: A nutrient-rich ventral incubation pouch where the male seahorse carries fertilised eggs, regulates fluids, and gives birth to hundreds of tiny fry.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海马爸爸是自然界唯一的超级全职孕夫！海马妈妈把卵放进袋子里后，剩下的孕育产崽全由爸爸一手包办！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Male seahorses are the only true pregnant dads in nature, experiencing labor contractions to give birth to miniature babies!

bodyParts.descZh: 截面呈方形的特化骨环尾巴，内部没有尾鳍，却能像变色龙或小猴子的手一样紧紧卷缠在海草或珊瑚枝上防止被水流冲走。
bodyParts.descEn: A specialized square-prism bone tail devoid of caudal fins, curling like a monkey's hand to anchor firmly against strong ocean swells.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海马的尾巴骨骼是方形的而不是圆形的，方形能提供四倍的抗压强度和超级抓握力，连仿生机器人都在学它！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Seahorse tails are built from square bones rather than round ones, providing superior gripping strength that inspires robotics!

bodyParts.descZh: 圆球状的转动眼睛，两只眼睛可以完全独立运作，一只朝前紧紧盯着微小浮游虾，另一只朝后警戒可能扑来的掠食大鱼。
bodyParts.descEn: Turret-like chameleon eyes that swivel independently, allowing one eye to target food while the other scans behind for predators.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海马不用转动脖子就能360度全方位看清周围的一切，两只眼睛各自看不同的精彩世界！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A seahorse can look forward and backward at the exact same time without moving its head!

bodyParts.descZh: 修长无齿的吸管状长吻，能在千分之几秒内产生极高负压，像迷你吸尘器一样瞬间把飘过的活虾一口吸进嘴里。
bodyParts.descEn: A long toothless pipette-like snout creating intense elastic suction in milliseconds to slurp tiny swimming shrimp out of the water.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海马没有胃也没有牙齿，食物吃进去很快就会消化排泄，所以它们几乎一整天都在马不停蹄地“吸吸吸”吃虾！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Because seahorses have no stomach or teeth, they must graze continuously, slurping up to 3,000 tiny brine shrimp per day!

bodyParts.descZh: 覆盖全身各体节的坚韧骨质环甲，代替了普通鱼类的细软鱼鳞，不仅能抵御掠食者咬击，还能提供刚性支撑。
bodyParts.descEn: Interlocking rigid skeletal rings arranged in series beneath thin skin, forming a natural suit of armor that deters hungry fish.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 虽然海马游得超级慢，但因为全身上下全是硬邦邦的骨头铠甲，肉质极少，很多大鱼嫌硌牙根本不屑吃它！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Because a seahorse is mostly hard bony armor with almost no edible meat, most predatory fish find them too crunchy to bother eating!

bodyParts.descZh: 生长在头顶顶峰的星状骨质突起，每只海马的骨冠形状、棱角与突触都是独一无二的，是尊贵的海中身份印记。
bodyParts.descEn: A distinctive bony crest atop the head that is uniquely shaped for each individual seahorse, functioning like a royal crown ID.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 就像每位国王的皇冠各不相同，海洋里每一只海马头上的骨冠花纹也完全不重样！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Just like human fingerprints, no two seahorses in the ocean share the exact same coronet pattern on their head!

bodyParts.descZh: 背部透明细小如蝉翼的微型背鳍，每秒钟能以高达35次的高频高速震颤摆动，驱动海马直立优雅地在水中慢速穿梭。
bodyParts.descEn: A tiny, gossamer-thin translucent dorsal fin fluttering up to 35 times per second to propel the seahorse forward in an upright stance.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海马的背鳍振动速度快到肉眼看几乎是一片模糊的残影，但尽管振动得这么拼命，海马依然是海洋里“最慢散步选手”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Though its tiny dorsal fin flutters 35 times per second like a hummingbird wing, the seahorse still holds the record as the slowest swimmer!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于颈侧后方针尖般微小的圆形出水鳃孔，水流经过鳃丝呼吸氧气后从孔隙轻柔排出，不会破坏微型伪装隐蔽性。
bodyParts.descEn: A minute circular opercular pore behind the head where filtered respiratory water is discharged gently without rustling camouflage.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 普通鱼类呼吸时两边鱼鳃大开大合，而海马为了不惊动猎物，把鳃孔缩得比针尖还小，水流轻得像深海叹息！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike ordinary fish with flapping gill covers, a seahorse expels water through tiny pinholes to maintain stealth!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 在海马家族中，是谁负责在肚子上的神奇育儿袋里怀孕并生下可爱的小宝宝？
quizQuestions.promptEn: In a seahorse family, who carries the pregnancy in a brood pouch and gives birth to the babies?

options.textZh: 雄性海马爸爸 (超级全职奶爸！)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！海马是动物界中罕见的“爸爸生宝宝”奇迹，海马爸爸肚子上的育儿袋会亲自阵痛生下小海马！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The male seahorse carries the eggs inside his specialized brood pouch and gives birth to live babies!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的部位：Square-Grasping Prehensile Tail (灵活抓握卷曲尾)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Square-Grasping Prehensile Tail
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太厉害啦！海马的尾巴像小猴子尾巴一样灵活，紧紧缠在海草上，大浪再大也冲不走！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! A seahorse uses its prehensile square tail to grasp seagrass firmly like a hand!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 海马两只眼睛能一只看前、一只看后独立转动，这和陆地上的哪种神奇爬行动物特别像？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part can swivel independently in two directions at once, just like a chameleon?

options.textZh: 独立全景双向眼 (像变色龙一样！)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太神奇啦！海马的眼睛像小炮塔一样可以独立360度旋转，一只找美食，一只防坏蛋！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! Their independently rotating eyes can monitor predators and search for prey simultaneously!

nicknameZh: 蔚蓝航海家与远古水下滑翔机
nicknameEn: The Ancient Ocean Navigator & Glider
lifespan: 野外约 70 - 100 年以上 (海洋寿星典范)
food: 成年主要以海草与大型海藻为食 (海洋素食巨兽)
habitat: 全球热带与亚热带沿岸海草床、珊瑚礁与开阔远洋
speed: 巡航 2 - 3 km/h (逃生冲刺最高达 35 km/h)
overviewZh: 绿海龟是地球上最古老的爬行物种之一，已经在浩瀚大洋中游弋了上亿年。它们名字来源于体内脂肪受海草色素影响呈现的橄榄绿色。它们拥有流线型的高速盾甲与长如鸟翼的划水前肢，凭借对地球磁场的神秘感知，能横跨数千公里大洋精准回到出生沙滩产卵。
overviewEn: The Green Sea Turtle is a living dinosaur that has navigated the oceans for over 100 million years. Famous for its tear-drop hydrodynamic shell and wing-like front flippers, it travels thousands of miles guided by Earth's magnetic field to return to its natal nesting beach.

bodyParts.descZh: 呈优美水滴轮廓的骨质背甲，表面覆有五彩辐射纹的角质盾片，极扁平的平滑弧度大幅减少水流阻力，助力水中长途滑翔。
bodyParts.descEn: A streamlined, teardrop-shaped bone shell surfaced with radiating keratin scutes that minimize water resistance for oceanic migration.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 不同于陆地小乌龟遇到危险会把头缩进壳里，海龟为了在水中全速游动，头和四肢是完全无法缩进壳内的！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike land tortoises, sea turtles cannot retract their head and flippers into their shells!

bodyParts.descZh: 长达近一米的宽大前鳍肢，由坚实胸肌驱动，在水中犹如飞鸟羽翼般大幅度上下挥舞，赋予其“水中飞翔”的磅礴动力。
bodyParts.descEn: Gigantic, wing-like front flippers flapped in graceful figure-eight motions, propelling the massive reptile through water like an eagle.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海龟在水中游动的姿态就像海鹰展翅飞翔，每挥动一次大前鳍就能在蔚蓝海水中滑行十几米远！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Sea turtles look like birds flying in slow motion underwater, gliding tens of meters with each gentle stroke of their giant flippers!

bodyParts.descZh: 大眼后部隐藏着比大脑还大的特化盐腺，在吞入咸海水后，盐腺会把多余高浓度盐分化作“泪水”排出体外净化体内。
bodyParts.descEn: Eyes equipped with behind-the-socket salt-excreting lachrymal glands that pump out concentrated salty tears to stay hydrated.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 当海龟妈妈上岸在沙滩产卵时，常被看见在“默默流泪”，其实那不是在哭，而是在通过眼睛把体内多余的盐水排出去！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When sea turtles cry on sandy nesting beaches, they aren't crying out of sadness—they are flushing excess ocean salt from their bodies!

bodyParts.descZh: 坚硬如鹰喙的角质嘴唇，下颚边缘长有一排锐利的锯齿状细槽，能像天然割草机一样齐整剪断坚韧的深海海草与大型藻类。
bodyParts.descEn: A short, blunt keratinous beak with finely serrated lower jaw margins, functioning like a natural lawnmower to snip tough seagrass fronds.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 成年的绿海龟是几乎纯粹的“素食主义者”，正是因为天天吃大量绿色海草，才让它们体内的脂肪变成了翠绿色！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Adult green turtles are strict vegetarians—their diet of lush seagrass dyes their inner cartilage and fat an emerald green!

bodyParts.descZh: 从长鳍前端外缘突出的一枚坚硬弯曲短爪，在攀登斜坡沙滩、固着珊瑚岩石进食海草或求偶时提供关键抓地力。
bodyParts.descEn: A sharp, curved single spike claw protruding from the leading edge of each front flipper, used to anchor on reef rocks while feeding.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 雄性海龟的前鳍弯爪通常比雌海龟大得多也弯得多，就像天然的小铁锚！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Male green sea turtles possess elongated curved front claws that act like little grappling anchors!

bodyParts.descZh: 短而宽阔的后鳍肢主要充当精密的方向舵与升降舵，在母龟上岸时还能像坚固的小铲子一样挖出一个个一米深的沙坑产卵。
bodyParts.descEn: Paddle-shaped rear flippers functioning as steering rudders in ocean currents and digging scoops when mothers excavate beach egg chambers.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海龟妈妈全靠一双后脚蹼在黑夜沙滩上挖出完美的泪滴形“育儿洞”，把上百枚乒乓球一样的海龟蛋安放进去！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A mother sea turtle uses her rear flippers like dexterous shovels to dig a deep flask-shaped nest chamber for up to 100 eggs!

bodyParts.descZh: 腹部平坦宽阔的淡黄白色坚韧骨板，质地极为坚韧，保护着海龟柔软的心腹脏器免受浅海珊瑚礁石的剧烈刮擦碰撞。
bodyParts.descEn: A solid, flattened yellowish-white ventral armor shield protecting internal organs from razor-sharp reef coral outcrops.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海龟的腹部是浅黄白色的，而背部是深褐色的，这种被称为“反荫蔽”的伪装色让水下的鱼往上看和水上的鸟往下看都很难发现它！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A turtle's pale underside blends with sunlit water from below, while its dark back blends with deep seabed shadows from above!

bodyParts.descZh: 布满多边形马赛克鳞片的粗壮肌肉颈部，能灵活上下左右摆动调整视野，引导庞大体躯在复杂珊瑚沟壑间畅通无阻。
bodyParts.descEn: A robust, muscular neck surfaced with armored mosaic scutes that swivels gracefully to guide the heavy shell through coral canyons.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 绿海龟脑部内置了神乎其神的“生物磁罗盘”，能够感知地球磁场强度与角度，在浩瀚大洋中游几万里也绝不会迷路！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Green sea turtles possess internal magnetic compasses in their brains, navigating thousands of miles across empty oceans!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 当海龟妈妈在夜晚沙滩上产卵时，为什么眼睛会流下大滴大滴的“眼泪”？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Why do mother sea turtles shed large tears from their eyes while nesting on sandy beaches?

options.textZh: 排盐泪腺眼 (通过泪水排出体内多余盐分)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！海龟眼窝后藏着神奇的排盐腺体，所谓的“流眼泪”其实是在把喝进身体里的高浓度海水盐分排出来！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Special glands behind their eyes excrete concentrated salt solutions to prevent dehydration!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的部位：Wing-Like Gliding Foreflippers (巨型滑翔长前翼)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Wing-Like Gliding Foreflippers
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！绿海龟宽大如翼的长前肢是它在深海中像飞鸟一样优雅“飞翔”的动力发动机！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Giant front flippers flap in synchronized strokes, propelling the sea turtle gracefully through deep blue seas!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 与陆地上的小乌龟不同，生活在大海中的海龟哪个部位无法缩进壳里保护自己？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Unlike land tortoises, which body parts can a sea turtle NOT pull back inside its shell?

options.textZh: 头部与四肢 (为了极致流体力学无法缩入壳内)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对啦！为了追求在水下的极致流线型减阻和疾速游动，海龟的头和鳍肢终生都无法缩进硬壳里！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! Evolved for hydrodynamic speed, sea turtles cannot pull their heads or flippers inside their shells!

pinyin: tài píng yáng jù xíng zhāng yú
nicknameZh: 深海八臂智多星与变色伪装大师
nicknameEn: The Eight-Armed Master of Disguise
length: 臂展可达 4 - 6 米 / 重达 15 - 50 公斤
lifespan: 约 3 - 5 年 (完成繁衍后生命终结)
food: 帝王蟹、龙虾、蛤蜊、扇贝与海底甲壳动物
habitat: 北太平洋冷水礁岩、幽深海洞与大陆架 (深达 750 米)
speed: 岩礁爬行 4 km/h (喷水火箭冲刺极速可达 40 km/h)
overviewZh: 太平洋巨型章鱼是地球上体型最大、最聪明的无脊椎软体动物。它们拥有8条布满敏锐味觉吸盘的强劲触腕、在千分之一秒内完美融于环境的变色伪装皮肤、3颗强劲的心脏以及流淌着铜离子的奇幻蓝血。它们能解开迷宫与瓶盖，是当之无愧的“深海智多星”。
overviewEn: The Giant Pacific Octopus is the largest and most intelligent invertebrate on Earth. Featuring eight sucker-lined arms with chemical tasting senses, dynamic color-shifting skin chromatophores, three pulsing hearts pumping blue copper-based blood, and a distributed nervous system, it reigns as the ocean's ultimate master of disguise and problem-solving.

bodyParts.descZh: 8条长达两米以上、无骨却肌肉强韧的触腕，每条触腕上长有多达两百余个圆形真空吸盘，不仅抓力惊人，还能通过化学受体直接“品尝”物体的味道。
bodyParts.descEn: Eight muscular, boneless arms lined with over 200 powerful vacuum suction cups each, capable of strong grip and tasting objects via chemical receptors.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 章鱼的吸盘上有超级敏锐的“味蕾”，用触手摸一摸礁石或者贝壳，就能立刻尝出它是不是好吃的海鲜！
bodyParts.funFactEn: An octopus has chemical taste receptors right on its suction cups—it can literally "taste" whatever it touches without putting it in its mouth!

bodyParts.pinyin: sè sù xì bāo pí fū
bodyParts.descZh: 表皮分布着数百万个由微小肌肉直接拉拽控制的色素囊细胞，能在0.2秒内随意变成红、黄、棕、白等颜色，甚至竖起颗粒模拟粗糙的岩石质感。
bodyParts.descEn: Millions of elastic color pigment sacs in the skin controlled directly by the brain, altering shade and 3D bumpy texture in less than a second.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 章鱼是自然界顶级的“隐身术大师”，甚至在睡觉做梦的时候，皮肤颜色还会随着梦境像彩灯一样不断变幻！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Octopuses are so skilled at camouflaging that their skin changes patterns and colors even while they are sleeping and dreaming!

bodyParts.descZh: 隐藏在八腕汇合中心处的坚固上下黑褐色角质喙嘴，外形酷似坚硬的鹦鹉喙，配合带有挫刀状小齿的齿舌，能轻易破开螃蟹坚硬厚重的甲壳。
bodyParts.descEn: A sharp, powerful beak made of hardened chitin hidden at the center of the arms, capable of cracking thick crab shells and injecting venom.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 鹦鹉喙是章鱼全身唯一坚硬的骨质结构，哪怕体型有几米大，只要这只硬硬的嘴巴能钻过去，整个身体就能穿过缝隙！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The beak is the only solid part of an octopus's entire body—if its beak can squeeze through a hole, its whole body can follow!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于头部下方的漏斗状强韧肌肉喷管，能够将套膜腔内的海水强力压缩并向任意角度猛烈喷出，驱动章鱼像喷气式火箭一样高速倒退逃生。
bodyParts.descEn: A muscular funnel tube beneath the head that forcefully expels water from the mantle cavity to propel the octopus backwards like a water rocket.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 章鱼遇到危险时，会把喷水漏斗管朝向前方猛喷，像开倒车的潜水艇一样瞬间“嗖”地一下倒飞几十米！
bodyParts.funFactEn: By aiming its flexible siphon forward and blasting water, an octopus can jet backwards through the ocean at highway car speeds!

bodyParts.descZh: 拥有三颗独立跳动的心脏：两颗专门负责把缺氧血液泵入鳃部进行气体交换，一颗主心脏将富氧血泵往全身；血液中富含铜离子血蓝蛋白，呈现神秘深蓝色。
bodyParts.descEn: Three functional hearts—two branchial hearts pumping blood to the gills and a systemic heart for the body—circulating copper-rich oxygenated blue blood.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 我们人类的血液因为含有铁元素是红色的，而章鱼的血液含有铜元素，所以流淌着货真价实的“冰蓝之血”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike humans whose red blood carries iron, octopus blood uses copper to transport oxygen in cold deep water, giving it a brilliant blue color!

bodyParts.pinyin: fēn bù shì shén jīng nǎo
bodyParts.descZh: 拥有多达五亿个神经元，其中三分之二的神经元直接分布在八条触腕里，这意味着每条触腕都拥有独立的思考感知与微决策能力。
bodyParts.descEn: A sprawling nervous system with over 500 million neurons, two-thirds located in the arms, allowing each arm to explore and make decisions semi-independently.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 章鱼即使大脑在专注观察前方，八条触手也可以各忙各的，一条在翻石头、一条在捉小蟹、一条在站岗巡视！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Because their arms have their own nerve centers, an octopus's arms can each perform different complex tasks at the same time!

bodyParts.pinyin: róu rèn jī ròu tào mó
bodyParts.descZh: 位于头顶后方的圆囊状躯体，由极其厚实弹性的平滑肌构成，内部安全包裹着内脏、生殖器官与鳃叶，可极度伸缩变形穿过细窄岩缝。
bodyParts.descEn: A bulbous, boneless muscular bag housing vital organs and gills, capable of extreme elastic contortion to slide into tight crevice dens.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 几十公斤重的巨型章鱼可以把自己挤成一张薄饼，轻松钻进只有小茶杯口大小的狭窄洞穴里睡觉！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A 100-pound giant octopus can squeeze its entire soft body through an opening no larger than a small coffee mug!

bodyParts.descZh: 隐藏在腹腔套膜内的天然防御墨汁囊，遇到鲨鱼或海豹捕食时，能通过喷水管喷出一大团浓黑粘稠的黑色素烟幕，并释放酪氨酸酶麻痹捕食者的嗅觉。
bodyParts.descEn: An internal reservoir containing dark melanin fluid that forms an underwater smoke screen while dulling predators' keen sense of smell.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 章鱼喷出的墨汁不仅能当烟雾弹遮挡视线，里面还含有特殊的生物碱，能让鲨鱼的大鼻子暂时“闻不到任何味道”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Octopus ink isn't just a visual smoke screen—it contains a chemical compound that temporarily numbs a shark's sharp sense of smell!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 太平洋巨型章鱼全身没有一块骨头，唯一坚硬、能咬碎坚硬蟹壳的部位是什么？
quizQuestions.promptEn: An octopus has no bones. Which hard structure is the only rigid part used to crack crab shells?

options.textZh: 坚硬角质鹦鹉喙 (坚固如鹦鹉嘴)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！藏在触手中心的鹦鹉喙是它全身唯一坚硬的角质器官，极其锋利有力！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The keratinous parrot-like beak is the only solid part, capable of crushing crab armor!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Three Hearts & Blue Blood (三心蓝血循环系统)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Three Hearts & Blue Blood
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！章鱼拥有三颗强劲的心脏，血液里富含铜元素，在深海中流淌着幽蓝的光芒！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! Two hearts pump blood to the gills and one to the body, carrying copper-rich blue blood!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 章鱼的触手摸到贝壳就能立刻知道它好不好吃，是因为哪个神奇结构拥有“尝味道”的超能力？
quizQuestions.promptEn: An octopus knows if food is tasty just by touching it. Which structure has the superpower to taste?

options.textZh: 感官味觉吸盘腕 (每个吸盘都长有味蕾！)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对啦！吸盘表面布满高灵敏化学感受器，相当于成百上千个微型小舌头，一摸便知美味！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Chemical receptors on hundreds of suckers allow the octopus to taste everything it grasps!

nicknameZh: 蔚蓝顶级掠手与深海速度霸王
nicknameEn: The Apex Ocean Hunter & Torpedo Striker
lifespan: 约 70 年以上 (长寿的软骨鱼霸王)
food: 海豹、海狮、金枪鱼、鳐鱼与小型鲸豚
habitat: 全球温带与亚热带沿岸及开阔大洋海域
speed: 巡航 3 - 5 km/h (冲刺伏击可超 56 km/h)
overviewZh: 大白鲨是地球海洋生态系统中最受瞩目的顶级软骨鱼类掠食者。它们拥有流线如鱼雷般的健硕身形、灵敏洞察微弱心跳电信号的“罗伦氏壶腹”第六感，以及永不磨损、终生多排交替新生的锯齿利齿。作为海洋健康的守卫者，它们维系着整个远洋生命网的蓬勃生机。
overviewEn: The Great White Shark is the ocean's most iconic apex cartilaginous predator. Built like a hydrodynamic torpedo, it relies on electrosensory Ampullae of Lorenzini to detect prey heartbeats and possesses rows of serrated, self-replacing teeth. As a keystone species, it plays a vital role in balancing marine ecosystems worldwide.

bodyParts.descZh: 吻部与鼻孔周围密布的微孔感应网络，内含导电果冻状胶质，能捕捉周围猎物微弱至亿分之一伏特的心跳生物电。
bodyParts.descEn: A network of gel-filled pores around the snout that detects faint bioelectric fields generated by living prey heartbeats.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大白鲨即使在伸手不见五指的漆黑深海中闭上双眼，也能仅凭猎物的心脏跳动电信号发起百发百中的精准伏击！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Even in total pitch darkness with its eyes closed, a Great White can pinpoint a fish just from the faint electrical pulse of its beating heart!

bodyParts.pinyin: jù chǐ céng tì lǐ chǐ
bodyParts.descZh: 呈宽扁三角形且边缘布满微型锯齿，多达数排像传送带般排列，前排折损后排在数天内自动推前补位。
bodyParts.descEn: Triangular razor teeth with finely serrated knife edges arranged in conveyor-belt rows that automatically roll forward when broken.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大白鲨一生中会脱落并换上超过两万到三万颗牙齿，就像拥有一个取之不尽的天然备用齿轮库！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A Great White Shark goes through an astonishing 20,000 to 30,000 teeth in its lifetime like an endless conveyor belt!

bodyParts.descZh: 高耸直立、由坚韧软骨支承的直角三角形背鳍，在高速穿浪冲刺时抵消身体翻滚，保持完美的航行姿态。
bodyParts.descEn: A tall upright cartilaginous triangular sail that stabilizes the shark's hydrodynamic posture, preventing rolling during explosive bursts.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大白鲨的背鳍轮廓就像人类的指纹一样独一无二，科学家正是通过拍照辨认背鳍上的缺刻来记住每一条特定的鲨鱼！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Just like human fingerprints, the notched trailing edge of a Great White's dorsal fin is unique to each individual shark!

bodyParts.descZh: 表皮覆盖着数以百万计形似微型牙齿的硬质盾鳞，表面具有微米级导流沟槽，大幅削减水流涡流阻力。
bodyParts.descEn: Skin covered in millions of microscopic tooth-like enamel scales with hydrodynamic riblets that dramatically reduce underwater drag.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 人类现代最顶级的奥运速滑泳衣“鲨鱼皮”，灵感就完全来源于大白鲨皮肤上神奇的微观齿状微沟槽！
bodyParts.funFactEn: High-tech Olympic competition swimsuits were directly modeled after the micro-groove texture of shark skin to slip through water faster!

bodyParts.descZh: 头部后方整齐排列的五道狭长裂缝，内含密集的毛细血管红鳃丝，在游泳冲压水流中高效过滤吸收溶解氧。
bodyParts.descEn: Five vertical slits behind the head packed with rich capillary gill filaments that extract oxygen as seawater rushes over them.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大白鲨必须一刻不停地向前游动，让新鲜海水冲进嘴巴穿过鳃裂（冲压呼吸），如果长时间静止停下就会“窒息”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Great Whites must constantly swim forward to ram oxygen-rich water across their gills; if they stop moving, they can't breathe!

bodyParts.descZh: 上下两叶近乎对称的大型新月状尾鳍，由尾椎骨与强韧尾柄肌腱牵引，左右强力拍击提供鱼雷般的爆发推力。
bodyParts.descEn: A nearly symmetrical crescent moon-shaped tail powered by massive tendon attachments, delivering explosive hydrodynamic propulsion.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 凭借新月形强力尾鳍的终极爆发，大白鲨能够跃出水面高达 3 米，在空中上演壮观的“飞鲨腾空击”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Power from its crescent tail can propel a massive Great White entirely out of the ocean, breaching up to 3 meters into the air!

bodyParts.descZh: 从鳃部延伸至尾部的细长皮下水压传感管道，内部布满灵敏纤毛，专门感知几百米外受伤鱼类挣扎引发的微弱水波震动。
bodyParts.descEn: A fluid-filled sensory canal running along each side of the body with hair cells detecting subtle pressure waves and vibrations.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 哪怕几百米外一条小鱼只是轻轻蹬了一下水花，大白鲨的侧线也能像雷达天线一样瞬间感知到方位的剧烈变化！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A shark's lateral line can detect the tiny flutter of a struggling fish hundreds of meters away like an underwater radar dish!

bodyParts.nameZh: 全黑感光眼与保护翻转
bodyParts.descZh: 幽深神秘的墨黑色大眼，视网膜后长有脉络膜反光毯强化弱光视力；在咬击瞬间眼球会向后翻滚躲入眼窝进行物理防护。
bodyParts.descEn: Deep dark eyes backed by a reflective tapetum lucidum for night vision; the eyeball rolls backward into the socket to protect against claw scratches.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大白鲨在咬住猎物的千钧一发之际，眼球会瞬间翻转180度把黑眼睛藏进头骨里，防止猎物在拼命挣扎中抓伤眼球！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Right as it strikes, a Great White rolls its eyes backward into its skull like armored shades to prevent struggling prey from scratching them!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大白鲨哪怕在漆黑不见五指的深海中，也能感知到猎物微弱心跳生物电的“第六感器官”是什么？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which sensory organ acts as a "sixth sense" allowing the Great White to detect prey heartbeats in total darkness?

options.textZh: 罗伦氏电感壶腹 (导电胶质微孔)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！吻部周围密密麻麻的罗伦氏壶腹充满导电果冻，能精确感知微弱至极的生物电！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The Ampullae of Lorenzini pores are filled with conductive gel to detect faint bioelectric pulses!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Serrated Regenerating Teeth (锯齿状层替利齿)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Serrated Regenerating Teeth
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！大白鲨的锯齿牙齿如同一排排传送带，一生可更新换换两万到三万颗新牙！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! Rows of triangular serrated teeth rotate forward constantly, replacing lost ones like an endless conveyor!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大白鲨的表皮密布着微米级的微型齿状结构，启发了奥运会顶尖游泳选手的“鲨鱼皮泳衣”，是哪个结构？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which micro-enamel skin armor inspired Olympic high-tech swimwear by slashing water drag?

options.textZh: 流线型盾鳞皮肤 (微观牙齿微槽)
全黑感光眼与保护翻转

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对啦！显微镜下的盾鳞就如同一颗颗紧锁的微型牙齿，让水流顺滑通过，极大降低阻力！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Microscopic tooth-like dermal denticles channel water into tiny smooth pathways to eliminate drag!

nicknameZh: 深蓝巍峨巨神与地球生命之冠
nicknameEn: The Titan of the Ocean & Crown of Earth's Giants
lifespan: 约 80 - 110 年 (听栓年轮可测年龄)
food: 南极磷虾与小型浮游甲壳类 (每日消耗约 4 吨)
habitat: 全球各大洋温带与极地开阔冷水海域
speed: 巡航 8 - 14 km/h (受惊时冲刺可达 35 km/h)
overviewZh: 蓝鲸是地球有生命演化史以来体型最为庞大的动物，其体重甚至超过了曾经称霸陆地的所有最大型恐龙。它们拥有如同一艘深海核潜艇般宏伟优美的蓝色流线型身躯，靠口腔内数百片整齐的角质鲸须板滤食海洋中最细微的磷虾群，用震撼千里的低频次声波在整个大洋深处与同伴遥遥唱和。
overviewEn: The Blue Whale is the largest animal known ever to have lived on Earth—far heavier than even the biggest dinosaurs. Gliding like a living submarine, this peaceful colossus swallows entire schools of krill using hundreds of fringed baleen plates and communicates across thousands of ocean miles with thunderous low-frequency calls.

bodyParts.descZh: 上颌两侧整齐悬垂的300至400片黑色角质鲸须板，内缘密布毛发状毛刷纤维，闭嘴吞水时如精密筛网锁住磷虾。
bodyParts.descEn: Around 300 to 400 black keratinous plates hanging from the upper jaw with bristly inner fringes that filter tons of tiny krill from seawater.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蓝鲸没有一颗牙齿！它全靠嘴里像大胡子一样的鲸须板滤食，每次大口吞咽能一下网住成千上万只磷虾！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Blue Whales have zero teeth! Instead, hundreds of broom-like baleen plates trap swarms of krill while letting giant volumes of water drain out!

bodyParts.descZh: 从下颌沿腹部延伸的60至90道纵向弹性褶沟，在冲刺吞水时如同手风琴风箱般极度膨胀，能瞬间容纳等于自身体重的海水。
bodyParts.descEn: Dozens of expandable longitudinal skin folds along the throat and chest that stretch like an accordion to engulf a colossal volume of seawater.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蓝鲸张大嘴吞咽的一瞬间，喉腹褶能膨胀到比一整辆双层大巴士还要大，盛装的海水比蓝鲸自身的体重还要重！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When lunging for krill, a Blue Whale's throat pleats balloon outward so enormously they can hold more weight in water than the whale itself!

bodyParts.descZh: 头顶高高隆起的两个如鼻孔般并列的气孔瓣膜，浮出水面时以超高气压喷出高达9至12米的壮丽垂直白色汽柱。
bodyParts.descEn: Two large paired dorsal nostrils guarded by a raised splashguard that blast an awe-inspiring vertical geyser of vapor up to 12 meters high.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蓝鲸喷气冲出的垂直水雾足足有四层楼那么高，在数公里之外的海平线上都能清晰看见这根壮观的“生命之柱”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A Blue Whale's breath blasts an incredible column of warm vapor up to 12 meters into the sky—as tall as a four-story building!

bodyParts.descZh: 长达3至4米的短宽叶片状前肢鳍，内部完整保留着哺乳动物五指骨骼结构，在幽蓝深水中控制升降与优雅转向。
bodyParts.descEn: Paddle-shaped front flippers measuring 3 to 4 meters containing internal five-fingered skeletal bones used for banking, steering, and braking.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 如果你把蓝鲸胸鳍的X光片拿出来看，会惊讶地发现里面居然藏着和人类手掌一模一样的五根手指骨骼！
bodyParts.funFactEn: An X-ray of a Blue Whale's massive flipper reveals five skeletal finger bones inside, just like an enormous human hand!

bodyParts.descZh: 跨度达7至8米宽的无骨水平双叶尾鳍，由尾柄上如钢缆般粗壮的背肌群驱动，上下起伏为近两百吨身躯注入磅礴推力。
bodyParts.descEn: A gigantic horizontal tail spanning up to 8 meters across, driven by massive axial back muscles to generate tons of cruising thrust.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蓝鲸的尾巴宽度堪比一架小型飞机的双翼！只要上下轻轻摆动一次，就能推动上百吨的躯体在巨浪中平稳滑行！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A Blue Whale's tail flukes are as wide as the wings of a small passenger plane, effortlessly pushing its 180-ton bulk forward!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于身躯极后方仅约30厘米高的小巧镰刀形背鳍，相比其巨大的身躯显得极其精致，减少高速滑行时的表面摩擦阻力。
bodyParts.descEn: A disproportionately diminutive falcate fin only 30 cm tall placed far back toward the tail, minimizing drag while maintaining trim.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 相比长达三十米的巨舰身形，蓝鲸的背鳍只有大约三十厘米高，就像给一艘万吨巨轮插了一枚袖珍的小风帆！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Compared to a 30-meter body, the Blue Whale's dorsal fin is only about 30 centimeters tall—like a tiny toothpick on a cruise ship!

bodyParts.descZh: 在水下呈现出幽蓝与浅灰交织的斑驳云状花纹，表面富有弹性并分泌微量油脂，水流滑过时完全不产生附着紊流。
bodyParts.descEn: Sleek slate-blue and light grey mottled epidermis that glistens underwater, with elastic micro-structures that smooth out turbulent flow.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蓝鲸出水时看起来是灰色的，但当它潜入清澈海水时，周围水体的折射会让整条鲸鱼散发出梦幻般的宝石蓝色光芒！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Blue Whales look slate gray in air, but underwater sunlight refraction makes them glow with an ethereal turquoise-blue luminescence!

bodyParts.descZh: 特化的大型喉部与共鸣囊，能在不排出空气的情况下循环震动，发射高达188分贝的超低频次声波，在深海声道中传播上千公里。
bodyParts.descEn: Specialized laryngeal vocal folds capable of producing thunderous 188-decibel infrasonic rumbles that travel thousands of ocean miles.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蓝鲸的声音高达 188 分贝（比喷气式飞机起飞还要响亮！），低沉的鲸歌能够穿透深海声道，传到千里之外的另一只同伴耳中！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A Blue Whale's call reaches 188 decibels—louder than a jet engine! Its infrasonic song can travel across 1,000 miles of deep ocean!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 蓝鲸没有一颗牙齿，它是用挂在上颌上的什么神奇结构来像筛子一样过滤大量磷虾的？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which keratinous broom-like plates hanging from the upper jaw filter tons of krill without teeth?

options.textZh: 巨型角质鲸须板 (密集毛刷筛网)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！数百片角质鲸须板边缘有细密刷毛，海水排出时把小虾全部截留在嘴巴里！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Hundreds of fringed baleen plates act like a sieve, trapping krill while water rushes out!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Pleated Ventral Grooves (手风琴式喉腹褶)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Pleated Ventral Grooves
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！喉腹褶在蓝鲸吞水时能像巨型风箱一样拉伸膨胀，装下比自身还要重的水量！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! Dozens of pleated grooves expand like an accordion to engulf tons of water and krill!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 蓝鲸浮出水面换气时，喷出的白色高压水雾汽柱足足有几层楼高，来自头顶的哪个器官？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which paired nostrils on top of the head blast a magnificent 12-meter-high geyser of vapor?

options.textZh: 双孔高压喷气孔 (高达 12 米水柱)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对啦！双孔喷气孔由强健的肌肉瓣膜保护，喷射出的壮观水雾柱可高达 9 到 12 米！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! The twin blowholes blast an extraordinary vapor geyser reaching up to 12 meters into the sky!

nicknameZh: 深海里半透明的梦幻舞者与飘逸发光伞
nicknameEn: The Translucent Dream Dancer & Glowing Parachute
length: 伞径 25 - 40 厘米 / 重约 100 - 300 克 (95%以上是水分)
lifespan: 水母体约 6 - 12 个月 (水螅体可常年休眠繁殖)
food: 微型浮游动物、丰年虾幼虫、鱼卵与微藻
habitat: 全球温带与热带温暖近海、海湾与深蓝水层
speed: 缓慢脉动漂流 (随洋流前行，游动时速约 1-2 公里)
overviewZh: 海月水母是一种半透明如果冻般的神奇海洋无脊椎刺胞动物。它们没有坚硬的骨头，没有跳动的心脏，甚至没有真正的大脑，全身超过95%都是纯净的水！伞体中央有四个粉白色四叶草状的马蹄形腺体，下方飘荡着四条如丝绸般的口腕，伴随着有节律的收缩舒张，在深海微光中优雅起舞。
overviewEn: The Moon Jellyfish is a breathtaking, translucent cnidarian drifting through ocean currents. With no bones, heart, or brain, its gelatinous body is over 95% water! Featuring iconic four-leaf clover markings (horseshoe gonads) at its center and silky trailing oral arms, it pulses hypnotically through the sunlit depths.

bodyParts.descZh: 像一把轻柔漂浮的果冻小降落伞，通过有节律的舒展与收缩向后喷水，推动身体轻轻向前漂流。
bodyParts.descEn: A delicate umbrella-like saucer that pulses with rhythmic contractions, pushing water beneath to glide gracefully.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 水母身体里 95% 以上都是水！如果把它拿到沙滩上晒太阳，过一会儿大部分身体就会蒸发消失呢！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Moon jellies are over 95% water! In the sun on a dry beach, they would almost completely evaporate!

bodyParts.pinyin: mǎ tí xíng shēng zhí xiàn
bodyParts.descZh: 伞体中央四个粉白或淡紫色的马蹄形圆环，拼起来像一片可爱的四叶草，用来孕育水母宝宝和吸收营养。
bodyParts.descEn: Four horseshoe-shaped rings at the center resembling a lucky four-leaf clover, responsible for reproduction and nutrient absorption.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这四个“四叶草花瓣”吃饱时还会变色哦！如果海月水母吃了橘红色的丰年虾，马蹄圈就会变成可爱的橙粉色！
bodyParts.funFactEn: These clover rings change color based on diet! Eating orange brine shrimp turns them into a lovely peach pink!

bodyParts.descZh: 垂在伞体下方的四条如飘带般优美的波浪形手臂，上面布满微小的粘液和纤毛，负责将捉到的小浮游生物送进嘴里。
bodyParts.descEn: Four silky, ruffled ribbons trailing below the bell covered in microscopic cilia to sweep plankton into the central mouth.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 口腕就像水母随身携带的4条丝绸围巾，既能捕食，还能让小鱼偶尔在褶皱间躲避更大的捕食者！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The ruffled oral arms act like floating silk ribbons that filter food and occasionally give baby fish a safe shelter!

bodyParts.descZh: 环绕在伞盖边缘数百根细密如发丝的短触手，带有轻微的刺细胞，能麻痹捕捉漂过的小虾和浮游生物。
bodyParts.descEn: Hundreds of hair-thin fringe tentacles lining the rim of the bell equipped with nematocysts to stun tiny drifting prey.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海月水母对人类非常友好温和！它们的刺细胞毒性极弱，隔着人手皮肤通常完全感觉不到刺痛。
