bodyParts.funFactEn: Moon jellies are very gentle to humans! Their mild stinging cells cannot penetrate thick human skin.

bodyParts.descZh: 分布在伞缘凹口处的8个微小感觉俱乐部，包含能感知光线强弱的眼点和感知身体平衡的重力平衡囊。
bodyParts.descEn: Eight sensory clubs located in marginal indentations, containing light-sensitive ocelli and gravity-sensing statocysts.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 虽然水母没有大脑，但依靠这8个小雷达，它们能分辨海水是白天还是黑夜，还能感觉出自己是正着还是倒着游！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Even without a brain, rhopalia tell the jellyfish whether it is sunny or dark, and which way is up or down!

bodyParts.descZh: 从中央胃腔向外辐射到伞缘的分支管道网络，像植物叶脉一样把消化吸收的营养液输送到全身每一个细胞。
bodyParts.descEn: A leaf-vein-like network of canals radiating from the central stomach, delivering digested nutrients throughout the bell.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 透明的辐管网络在水族馆灯光下会呈现像电路线路板一样的光斑，美得像来自外太空的发光飞碟！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The intricate canal network glows like glowing circuits under aquarium lights, resembling an alien spaceship!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于伞体下侧正中心的开口，既是水母吞食浮游生物的唯一嘴巴，也是食物消化后排出废物的出口。
bodyParts.descEn: The single aperture situated at the underside center that serves dual roles: taking in food and expelling waste.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 水母吃东西和排泄都是用这同一个神奇小嘴巴完成的，真正的“一孔走天下”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Moon jellies use the exact same opening to eat delicious plankton and expel food waste!

bodyParts.descZh: 夹在内外表皮之间的厚厚胶状物质，具有天然弹性，收缩后能像弹簧一样自动弹回原状，帮助省力游动。
bodyParts.descEn: A thick, gelatinous extracellular layer between skin layers that acts like an elastic spring, resetting bell shape after each pulse.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 中胶层的弹性让水母成为地球上游动能量消耗最低的动物之一，每次游动几乎不费一点力气！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Thanks to springy mesoglea, jellies are among the most energy-efficient swimmers on Earth!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 海月水母伞体中央有四个粉白色像“四叶草”一样漂亮的花瓣形结构，它们是什么？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which four horseshoe-shaped rings at the center of the bell resemble a lucky four-leaf clover?

options.textZh: 四叶草马蹄生殖腺 (吸收养分与变色)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太聪明了！四个马蹄形生殖腺拼在一起就像一片幸运四叶草，吃下不同食物时还会悄悄变色呢！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! The four horseshoe gonads form a four-leaf clover pattern and can change color depending on what the jelly eats!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Translucent Pulsing Bell (半透明伞状体)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Translucent Pulsing Bell
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！伞状体像一把透明的小降落伞，一收一放轻柔喷水，推动水母在水中悠闲漫步！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The translucent bell acts like a soft parachute that contracts and expands to glide smoothly!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 海月水母没有真正的大脑与眼睛，但通过分布在伞缘的哪种小感觉器来感应光线和身体平衡？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which sensory organs located along the bell margin help the jellyfish sense light and balance without a brain?

options.textZh: 感觉缘包感应器 (微型感光与平衡雷达)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对啦！8个感觉缘包就像水母的微型小雷达，能准确分辨上方水面的光线与自身的上下姿态！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Eight rhopalia act like miniature sensors telling the jellyfish where the light is and which way is up!

nicknameZh: 海底五角星与断腕再生的海底漫步家
nicknameEn: The Five-Armed Wanderer & Regeneration Wonder
lifespan: 野外约 10 - 35 年
food: 双壳类贝类（生蚝、贻贝、蛤蜊）、藤壶与海胆
habitat: 潮间带岩礁、珊瑚礁、沙泥质海底与深海海床
speed: 依靠成千上万只水压管足缓慢爬行 (约 1 米/分钟)
overviewZh: 海星是一种生活在潮间带与深海的奇特棘皮动物。它们拥有五辐射对称的迷人五角星外形，体表覆盖着坚硬的钙质骨板刺皮。海星拥有令人惊叹的“断腕再生”超能力，哪怕失去了一条手臂，甚至只要中央盘残存一部分，就能重新长出完整的海星！它们腹面拥有数千只微小的液压吸盘管足，不仅能飞檐走壁，还能把胃翻出体外直接消化坚硬的贝壳！
overviewEn: The Sea Star (Starfish) is an extraordinary echinoderm famous for its five-armed radial symmetry and spiny armored skin. Renowned for astonishing regenerative powers, a sea star can regrow lost arms or even an entire body! Underneath, thousands of hydraulic suction tube feet let it climb vertical rocks and pry open stubborn clams to evert its stomach for external digestion.

bodyParts.descZh: 从中央盘向外伸展的五条标志性强健手臂，内部装有消化器官和神经系统，断掉后能奇迹般完整长回来！
bodyParts.descEn: Five distinct radiating arms containing digestive and reproductive organs, possessing miraculous regrowth capabilities.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海星如果被螃蟹夹断一条胳膊，几个月后胳膊就会长回来；有的种类甚至只剩一条胳膊也能长出一整只新海星！
bodyParts.funFactEn: If a sea star loses an arm to a hungry predator, it regrows a brand-new one; some species can regrow a whole body from just one arm!

bodyParts.descZh: 每条手臂腹面排列着数百只充满海水压力的小吸盘管足，像一支微型液压大军，牢牢吸附在浪涛冲刷的岩石上漫步。
bodyParts.descEn: Hundreds of fluid-filled tiny muscular suction tubes on the underside acting as a hydraulic army to crawl and grasp prey.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 管足里流淌的不是血液，而是纯净的海水！海星是用海水作为液压油来驱动这上千个小脚丫的！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Instead of blood, sea stars pump filtered seawater through their water vascular system to move their tiny tube feet!

bodyParts.descZh: 背面中央略偏旁侧的一颗纽扣状微孔圆盘，是海星的过滤进水口，海水从这里吸入并维持全身管足的液压系统。
bodyParts.descEn: A small, off-center perforated button-like disc on the upper surface that filters seawater into the hydraulic vascular network.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 筛板就像海星自带的高级海水过滤器，能挡住沙子和脏东西，只让清澈的海水进入体内的微型管道！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The madreporite acts like a high-tech mini water filter, blocking sand grains while taking in pristine seawater!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于每条腕足最尖端的一颗红色微型感光斑点，能感知明暗与大型物体的阴影，指导海星走向阴凉避难所。
bodyParts.descEn: A microscopic red light-sensitive sensory cluster at the tip of each arm, detecting light, shadow and surrounding navigation.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海星有5只“眼睛”！每条手臂的尖端都有1只，当它爬行时，会把手臂尖尖向上翘起，用小眼点探测前方！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Sea stars have 5 eyes! One at the very tip of each arm, which curls upward while crawling to check where it is going!

bodyParts.descZh: 体表由无数微小互相联结的碳酸钙骨板和凸起尖刺构成，像一套坚韧的锁子甲，保护内部器官免受天敌撕咬。
bodyParts.descEn: Tough calcium carbonate ossicles and blunt spines embedded beneath the skin, forming an interlocking armor against predators.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海星皮肤表面还有一种像微型小剪刀一样的叉棘（Pedicellariae），会自动剪掉企图附着在背上的寄生虫和海藻！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Tiny pincer-like structures called pedicellariae actively pinch away parasites and debris from the star's skin!

bodyParts.descZh: 当管足撬开生蚝或蛤蜊哪怕1毫米的微小裂缝时，海星能把胃直接从嘴里吐出来，钻进贝壳里面就地把肉消化成汤汁吸回！
bodyParts.descEn: A miraculous stomach that can push out through its mouth into a cracked clam shell, externally digesting prey into liquid.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 海星是把“胃吐出来在外面吃饭”的绝顶高手！吃饱喝足之后，再把胃完好无损地收回肚子里！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Sea stars literally turn their stomachs inside-out to eat dinner outside their bodies, then slurp it back in!

bodyParts.descZh: 位于五条腕足交汇汇合的躯干核心，容纳主神经环、口部与消化中心，是全身生命信号的中枢枢纽。
bodyParts.descEn: The central circular body hub where all five arms converge, housing the nerve ring, mouth, and key vital centers.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 中央盘内有一圈环状神经索，指挥五条胳膊统一步调向前走，让海星任何一条手臂都能充当带头的“领航员”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A nerve ring inside the central disc coordinates all arms, allowing any of its 5 arms to lead the walk!

bodyParts.descZh: 从中央嘴巴沿着每条手臂腹面一直延伸到末端的V形深沟，成排的管足在沟渠内受到安全庇护与神经控制。
bodyParts.descEn: Deep V-shaped channels running along the underside of each ray, protecting rows of delicate tube feet and radial nerves.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 遇到海葵或大鱼咬来时，步带沟两旁的活动棘刺会像卷帘门一样合拢，把里面的吸盘小管足安全锁在保护仓里！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When danger threatens, movable spines snap shut over the ambulacral grooves like protective shutters!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 海星腹面有成百上千个充满海水压力的小吸盘，帮助它在垂直岩壁上紧紧吸附爬行，这是什么？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which fluid-filled tiny muscular suction tubes on the underside act as a hydraulic army to crawl?

options.textZh: 液压吸盘管足 (成百上千个微型小脚)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！海星用海水做动力，通过管足里水压的吸附与松开，在礁石上平稳爬行！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Sea stars pump seawater through their tube feet, creating hydraulic suction to crawl and grip rocks!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Five Regenerative Arms (五辐射对称腕足)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Five Regenerative Arms
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！海星的五条腕足不仅能走路捕食，即使断掉也能重新长出一条完美的新手臂！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! A sea star's arms not only help it move and hunt, but possess incredible regenerative powers to regrow if lost!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 海星捕食紧闭的蛤蜊或生蚝时，会把身体里的哪个神奇器官吐出体外钻进贝壳缝隙里就地消化？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which organ can evert outside the body through the mouth into a cracked clam shell for external digestion?

options.textZh: 翻出式捕食胃 (吐出体外吃饭)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对啦！海星有独一无二的超能力，把胃翻到贝壳里面直接消化，然后再把胃收回体内！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! Sea stars can push their stomach outside their bodies into shells to digest meals before pulling it back in!

nicknameZh: 天空俯冲音速轰炸机
nicknameEn: The Sonic Sky Diver
length: 体长 34 - 58 cm / 翼展 80 - 120 cm
lifespan: 野外约 12 - 18 年 (人工饲养可达 25 年)
food: 野鸽、海鸥、水鸭等中小型空中飞禽
habitat: 高山悬崖、沿海峭壁与城市摩天高楼顶端
speed: 高空极速俯冲超 389 km/h (全地球动物第一！)
overviewZh: 游隼是全地球名副其实的“速度之王”！当它从数千米高空发现猎物时，会收紧双翼化作一枚极致的水滴子弹，以超越高铁的近 400 公里/小时极速俯冲而下。它拥有仿生战斗机的进气锥鼻孔、自带护目镜的抗风瞬膜以及如铁拳般的锋利钢爪，是天空最强悍的音速飞行家。
overviewEn: The Peregrine Falcon is the undisputed fastest animal on Earth. When stooping from high altitude, it folds its aerodynamic wings into a teardrop bullet, reaching dive speeds exceeding 389 km/h (242 mph). Equipped with jet-engine-like nares baffles, protective nictitating membranes, and lethal raptor talons, it rules the open skies.

bodyParts.descZh: 鼻孔内部有一枚特殊的骨质小锥体，像喷气式战斗机的进气锥一样分散减缓强风气流，让游隼在近 400km/h 极速俯冲时仍能顺畅呼吸而不伤肺。
bodyParts.descEn: Bony cones inside the nostrils channel and slow incoming supersonic air, allowing seamless breathing during 300+ km/h dives without lung trauma.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 人类现代超音速喷气战斗机（如米格-21和SR-71黑鸟）的进气道锥形设计，正是从游隼鼻孔结构中获取的仿生学灵感！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Aviation engineers modeled the air intake cones of supersonic jet fighters after the bony baffles inside a peregrine falcon's nostrils!

bodyParts.pinyin: kàng fēng shùn mó yǎn zhào
bodyParts.descZh: 一层透明坚韧的第三眼睑，在高速狂风中像潜水护目镜与雨刷一样横向快速闭合，不仅阻挡沙尘异物，还能保持角膜湿润且视线完全清晰。
bodyParts.descEn: A translucent third eyelid that sweeps horizontally like a protective diving mask and windshield wiper, shielding eyes during high-velocity dives.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 游隼的眼睛拥有双凹感光区，视力清晰度是人类的 8 倍，在千米高空能把地面上一只奔跑的小田鼠看得清清楚楚！
bodyParts.funFactEn: With vision 8 times sharper than human eyesight, a falcon can clearly spot a small fluttering songbird from over a mile away!

bodyParts.descZh: 弯曲锋利的上喙两侧各生有一枚独特的三角形角质凸齿，能与下喙凹槽精密扣合，让游隼在捕获猎物时能瞬间咬断猎物的颈椎骨。
bodyParts.descEn: A sharp, triangular notch on the upper beak that meshes into a groove on the lower mandible, specialized for severing prey vertebrae instantly.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大多数猛禽依靠巨大的爪子压死猎物，而游隼天生自备一把“断颈剪刀齿”，可以在一眨眼之间制服比自己还大的水鸭！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike eagles that squeeze prey with foot power, falcons use this specialized beak tooth like surgical snips to disarm prey in a split second!

bodyParts.pinyin: hòu lüè kōng qì dòng lì yì
bodyParts.descZh: 狭长尖锐的镰刀状飞羽形成典型的后掠翼气动外形，骨骼致密抗弯折，在收拢俯冲时将空气阻力降到极限，犹如一枚飞行的钢镖。
bodyParts.descEn: Long, pointed, sickle-shaped primary feathers that reduce drag into a bullet silhouette, capable of enduring immense G-forces during high-speed pull-outs.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 游隼在 389 km/h 高速拉升时，身体承受的重力加速度高达惊人的 25G，是顶尖战斗机飞行员承受极限（9G）的近三倍！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When pulling out of a 240 mph dive, a falcon withstands an incredible 25 Gs of force—nearly three times what human fighter pilots can endure!

bodyParts.pinyin: lì rèn tiě quán gāng zhuǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 粗壮鲜亮的明黄色脚掌配有厚实肉垫与弯曲如铁钩的黑刚爪。俯冲撞击猎物时，它会把爪子握成紧绷的拳头，重锤击落飞禽。
bodyParts.descEn: Muscular bright yellow feet tipped with needle-sharp black talons, curled into a tight biological fist to punch through mid-air targets at terminal speed.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 游隼在空中捕猎并不是像老鹰那样去抓，而是以高铁速度像一记“音速重拳”直接将空中的鸽子凌空砸晕！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Falcons don't grab airborne prey gently; they strike prey like a high-speed bowling ball, knocking birds unconscious on mid-air impact!

bodyParts.descZh: 从眼睛下方纵向延伸至脸颊的粗黑羽斑，形成如飞行员头盔一般的深色阴影区，能充分吸收高空晴空的反射烈光，防止眩目。
bodyParts.descEn: Broad dark black teardrop plumage flanking the eyes that absorbs intense glare from sunny sky and clouds, preserving target contrast.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 就像专业棒球与橄榄球明星在眼睛下方涂黑油彩一样，游隼在数百万年前就天生进化出了这一套纯天然的“防反光墨镜”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Just like NFL football players wearing black stripes under their eyes, peregrine falcons naturally evolved dark cheek feathers to cut sun glare!

bodyParts.descZh: 胸部中央耸立着如帆船龙骨般的深厚胸骨突起，上面附着占全身重量近三分之一的庞大胸大肌，为每一次有力扇翅提供狂暴推力。
bodyParts.descEn: An enlarged, deep breastbone keel anchoring massive flight muscles that comprise over 25% of total body weight, fueling explosive aerial thrust.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 游隼的心跳在剧烈飞行时每分钟超过 600 次，强大的心脏和龙骨胸肌能在短短几秒内将它推送到数百米高空！
bodyParts.funFactEn: With a heart pumping at 600 beats per minute, a falcon's massive chest muscles can propel it into steep climbs within seconds!

bodyParts.descZh: 呈致密狭长楔形的坚韧尾羽，在极速俯冲时闭拢如箭羽，减小涡流阻力；变轨和刹车拉平飞行时猛烈展开，宛如机尾减速板。
bodyParts.descEn: A tapered, stiff wedge-shaped tail that stays clamped shut to streamline dives, spreading open like an airbrake during high-G swoop recoveries.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 游隼的尾羽就像喷气式飞机的襟翼和减速板，在接近地面岩石千钧一发之际展开，能瞬间完成90度直角空中急转弯！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Acting like an aircraft airbrake and elevator, a falcon's tail allows it to pull off sharp 90-degree aerial acrobatics inches above cliffs!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 游隼在接近 400 公里/小时极速俯冲时，是哪个神奇的结构像战斗机一样减缓强风，保护肺部正常呼吸？
quizQuestions.promptEn: During a 240 mph dive, which structure acts like a jet intake cone to slow airflow and protect the lungs?

options.textZh: 进气锥减压鼻孔 (仿生战斗机的奇迹)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！游隼鼻孔里的骨质小锥体能分流减压强劲气流，超音速战斗机的进气口正是模仿了它！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Bony cones inside the nares divert supersonic airflow, inspiring the air intakes of modern jet fighters!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Tomial Tooth Beak (尖锐断颈角质齿)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Tomial Tooth Beak
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！喙部两侧锐利的三角形齿状突起，能像精准的外科剪刀一样瞬间咬断猎物颈椎！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! The triangular notch on the upper beak cuts through neck vertebrae with surgical precision!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 游隼高速追击猎物时，哪层透明的“隐形护目镜”横向闭合，既挡风沙又保持视线高度清晰？
quizQuestions.promptEn: During high-speed flights, which clear "inner goggle" sweeps across to keep the eye lubricated and debris-free?

options.textZh: 抗风防沙瞬膜眼罩 (天然高保真护目镜)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！瞬膜就是游隼随身携带的防风潜水镜与雨刷器，让它在狂风肆虐中依然能牢牢锁定猎物！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! The transparent nictitating membrane cleans and protects the cornea while maintaining crystal-clear vision!

nicknameZh: 空中悬停直升机与宝石精灵
nicknameEn: The Hovering Jewel of Nature
length: 体长 7 - 9 cm / 重仅 3 - 4 克 (比一枚硬币还轻！)
lifespan: 约 3 - 5 年 (创纪录可达 9 年以上)
food: 深筒花朵花蜜与补充蛋白质的微小昆虫与蜘蛛
habitat: 美洲热带雨林、落叶林缘与繁花盛开的花园
speed: 翅膀每秒振动 80 次 / 冲刺极速可达 45 - 50 km/h
overviewZh: 吸蜜蜂鸟是世界上体型最小的鸟类奇迹，宛如一颗在繁花间闪烁的悬浮活宝石。它们拥有极其灵活的“8”字形旋翼翅膀，是地球上唯一能向前、倒退、侧飞甚至完全定点悬停的鸟类。配合长如吸管的针喙与每分钟跳动超千次的超级心脏，它们展示着大自然最不可思议的微观飞行魔法。
overviewEn: The Ruby-throated Hummingbird is a dazzling aerial jewel of the avian realm and the ultimate hovering helicopter of nature. Possessing hyper-mobile figure-8 wings that beat up to 80 times per second, it is the only bird capable of sustained backward flight and stationary hovering, powered by a supercharged heart beating over 1,200 times a minute.

bodyParts.descZh: 肩关节具有极度自由的万向球窝结构，翅膀在空中划出完美的“8”字形闭环轨迹，在上下拍打时都能产生强劲升力，实现悬停与倒飞。
bodyParts.descEn: Hyper-flexible ball-and-socket shoulder joints sweep wings in a continuous figure-8 arc, generating lift on both the downstroke and upstroke.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜂鸟是鸟类中唯一的“倒车大师”，不仅能向后倒退飞行，甚至还能上下翻滚着倒立飞行！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Hummingbirds are the only birds on Earth that can fly backwards, upside down, and hover perfectly stationary in mid-air!

bodyParts.pinyin: fēn chà xī mì juǎn shé
bodyParts.descZh: 舌头长度可达鸟喙的两倍，前端纵向分裂为两条半透明凹槽微型卷管，遇到花蜜时自动卷合，每秒伸缩 15-20 次如同微型抽水泵。
bodyParts.descEn: A translucent tongue twice as long as the bill that splits into two fringed capillary grooves, trapping nectar instantly up to 20 licks per second.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜂鸟喝花蜜并不是像用吸管“吸”上去的，而是舌头上的微型分叉管道利用表面张力在千分之几秒内把花蜜“夹带”进嘴里！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Hummingbirds don't suck nectar like through a straw—the fringed tips of their tongue curl and spring open to physically trap fluid via surface tension!

bodyParts.descZh: 轻如蝉翼却无比坚固的流线型针状长喙，能精准探入喇叭形与深筒形花朵的最底部，同时前端可轻微开合夹取悬停花瓣上的微型小飞虫。
bodyParts.descEn: A delicate, elongated probe beak designed to reach deep into tubular blossoms, with flexible tips that snap shut to catch tiny hovering gnats.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 不同的蜂鸟演化出了完全不同弧度的鸟喙，专门契合某一种特定花朵的弯曲程度，是大自然最精妙的“钥匙与锁”组合！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Many hummingbirds evolved bill curves that match exact flower species like custom keys fitting floral locks!

bodyParts.descZh: 喉部羽毛拥有类似三棱镜的多层微观纳米薄膜，光线折射下呈现出烈火般的金属红宝石光芒；微微侧转头部时，又能瞬间变为深黑色隐蔽。
bodyParts.descEn: Microscopic multilayer keratin platelets on the throat that prismatically refract sunlight into flaming ruby red flashes, vanishing when tilted.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜂鸟喉咙上的红色并不是染料色素，而是靠羽毛内部精密的纳米光子结构产生的“结构光”，永远不会褪色！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The ruby glow isn't chemical pigment—it is structural color created by microscopic air-filled platelets refracting pure light like diamonds!

bodyParts.descZh: 足部极度退化短小，完全无法在地面走步或蹦跳，但长有四根坚韧的微型利爪，能像强力小夹子一样在狂风中死死扣住细如铁丝的树枝。
bodyParts.descEn: Extremely tiny, reduced claws incapable of walking or hopping, but specialized as featherlight clamps to lock onto hair-thin twigs while sleeping.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 因为脚爪实在太轻太短，蜂鸟如果想在树枝上移动哪怕两厘米，也必须扑扇翅膀飞过去，完全没法迈开腿散步！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A hummingbird's feet are so tiny and specialized for flight lightness that it cannot walk even a single inch—it must fly to move sideways!

bodyParts.descZh: 心脏体积巨大，占全身重量超 2.5%（人类的近三倍）。在剧烈悬停振翅时，每分钟跳动超过 1,200 次，每秒钟为肌肉输送大量富氧血液。
bodyParts.descEn: A powerhouse organ comprising 2.5% of body mass, pulsating over 1,200 beats per minute during hovering to sustain extreme metabolic energy.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜂鸟如果像人类一样大，按它体内疯狂的代谢速度，它每天产生的高温足以在一小时内把一大桶水烧得滚烫！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A hummingbird's metabolism is so fast that if humans burned calories at the same rate, our body temperatures would reach 750°F!

bodyParts.descZh: 中央凹陷的深色分叉尾羽，在空中像微型航向舵一样极度灵活地上翘、下压与偏转，为狭窄花丛间的毫米级精准急刹车提供反作用力。
bodyParts.descEn: Symmetrical, stiff steering feathers that flare and twist continuously like a miniature aviation rudder to balance hovering and instant stop-and-go.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜂鸟在花丛前悬停时，尾巴像个钟摆一样每秒微调几十次，即使遇到突然刮来的大风，也能纹丝不动地把嘴精准插进花心！
bodyParts.funFactEn: While feeding in heavy winds, a hummingbird flutters its tail dozens of times per second to keep its bill anchored perfectly still inside a flower!

bodyParts.pinyin: suǒ wēn bǎo nuǎn róng yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 贴近皮肤生长着极其细密的蓬松微型绒羽。在寒冷夜晚，蜂鸟会进入体温骤降至濒死的“假死状态（Torpor）”，全靠这层致密绒羽锁住体温。
bodyParts.descEn: Incredibly dense micro-down undercoat trapping air pockets against skin, shielding the bird as its body temperature plunges into nocturnal torpor.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 夜晚气温低时，蜂鸟会进入“装死模式”：心跳从每分钟 1,200 次断崖式降到只有 50 次，甚至摸上去像一具冰冷的小标本，早晨太阳升起才苏醒！
bodyParts.funFactEn: To save energy at night, hummingbirds enter a state called torpor: their heart rate drops from 1,200 to just 50 bpm, appearing completely lifeless until sunrise!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 吸蜜蜂鸟是世界上唯一能向后倒飞和定点悬停的鸟类，主要依靠哪个特化部位画出神奇的“8”字形？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Hummingbirds are the only birds that can fly backwards and hover motionless. Which part generates this figure-8 lift?

options.textZh: 8字形旋翼翅膀 (万向球窝关节)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！蜂鸟独特的球窝肩关节让翅膀能像直升机旋翼一样画“8”字，上下扇动都能产生浮力！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Unique ball-and-socket shoulder joints sweep wings in a figure-8, generating lift on both up and down strokes!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Iridescent Ruby Gorget (红宝石金属彩虹喉羽)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Iridescent Ruby Gorget
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！喉部羽毛微观的棱镜结构能反射出如红宝石般闪耀的金属火彩，炫目夺人！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Microscopic prism structures on throat feathers refract light into dazzling ruby red flashes!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 蜂鸟喝花蜜并不是像吸管一样往上“吸”，而是哪个精细器官在 1 秒钟内伸缩 20 次把花蜜“夹取”进嘴里？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Hummingbirds don't suck nectar like a straw. Which organ laps up nectar 20 times per second using capillary traps?

options.textZh: 分叉毛细吸蜜卷舌 (一秒伸缩20次微型泵)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真聪明！蜂鸟的舌尖分叉成两根细毛管，依靠表面张力把花蜜像磁铁一样夹进喉咙里！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! The split tongue tips curl open and snap shut, using capillary action to trap nectar droplets at lightning speed!

nicknameZh: 热带雨林大嘴卡通明星
nicknameEn: The Rainbow Beak of the Rainforest
length: 体长 55 - 65 cm / 巨喙长达 20 cm
lifespan: 野外约 15 - 20 年 (人工饲养可达 26 年)
food: 热带成熟浆果、棕榈果、种子、小昆虫及雏鸟
habitat: 南美洲热带雨林、稀树草原与林缘地带
speed: 波浪状短途滑翔 / 飞行时速约 30 - 40 km/h
overviewZh: 托哥巨嘴鸟是南美洲热带雨林里最吸睛的“卡通大嘴巨星”！它拥有长达 20 厘米、鲜艳如熟透芒果般金灿灿的惊人巨喙。虽然嘴巴大到令人难以置信，但内部却全是由海绵骨质构成的超轻蜂窝中空结构。大嘴不仅是摘果抛果的灵巧餐叉，还是调节全身温度的“天然空调散热器”，睡觉时还能把长尾向前翻折把自己裹成一个可爱的羽毛球！
overviewEn: The Toco Toucan is the most recognizable and dazzling celebrity of the South American canopy. Sporting an enormous, vibrant flame-orange bill measuring up to 20 cm, it defies gravity thanks to an ultra-lightweight cellular honeycomb bone structure. Beyond harvesting fruits with aerial acrobatics, its colossal bill functions as a biological thermal radiator, cooling its body while sleeping tucked tightly into an adorable feather ball.

bodyParts.descZh: 巨嘴表面是坚韧的角蛋白薄层，内部则是像泡沫塑料一样的多孔蜂窝骨质网络，虽然占了身体长度的三分之一，重量却仅有约 15 克！
bodyParts.descEn: A tough keratin shell reinforced by an interior bony foam matrix; despite spanning a third of the bird's body, it weighs merely 15 grams.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 科学家测试发现，巨嘴鸟大嘴的内部结构就像人类最先进的冲浪板和飞机机翼夹层，抗压能力惊人，被航空材料学家深度模仿！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Automotive and aerospace engineers study the toucan bill's foam-and-sheet architecture to design lighter, stronger impact-resistant panels!

bodyParts.pinyin: wēn kòng sàn rè wǎng luò
bodyParts.descZh: 巨喙表面密密麻麻布满了微型毛细血管。天热时血液涌入大嘴向空气辐射散热，天冷时收缩血管锁住热量，降温效率高达全身产热的4倍。
bodyParts.descEn: An intricate vascular network under the bill shell acts as an adjustable thermal radiator, radiating excess heat away four times faster than resting body heat.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 巨嘴鸟的大嘴就是鸟类中的“大象耳朵”，只要几分钟就能让全身温度下降好几度，在炎热雨林里永不中暑！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Just like African elephants flap their ears to cool down, toucans pump warm blood into their huge beaks to chill their entire body in minutes!

bodyParts.pinyin: máo shuā páo guǒ cháng shé
bodyParts.descZh: 长达 15 厘米的窄长角质舌头，边缘长满像羽毛一样的密集细小侧向流苏，不仅能感知果实成熟度，还能在抛接浆果时精准推入食道。
bodyParts.descEn: A 15 cm feather-fringed tongue lined with delicate lateral barbs, acting like a soft spatula to manipulate, toss, and swallow tropical fruits whole.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 巨嘴鸟吃东西特别好玩：它们先用长嘴尖摘下一颗浆果，向上一抛凌空接住，再仰起头直接吞进肚子里！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Toucans love playing catch with their food: they pluck a berry with their bill tip, toss it into mid-air, and swallow it in one gulp!

bodyParts.pinyin: duì zhǐ shù qī qiáng zhuǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 脚趾采用两趾向前、两趾向后的“2+2”对趾结构，粗壮有力，能像紧固扳手一样牢牢咬合在长满青苔的树枝与藤蔓上。
bodyParts.descEn: Strong perching feet with two toes facing forward and two backward, forming a specialized clamp to scamper along mossy canopy branches.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 巨嘴鸟不太擅长长时间远距离飞行，但靠着这双攀爬神爪，它们在树冠枝条间像敏捷的杂技演员一样蹦跳如飞！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Rather than flying long distances, toucans use their versatile 2+2 gripping claws to hop and leap between rainforest branches like agile acrobats!

bodyParts.descZh: 尾椎骨长有独特的万向折叠关节。睡觉时尾羽能向前 180 度平折盖在后背上，配合收缩进翅膀下的大嘴，把自己收拢进狭窄树洞。
bodyParts.descEn: A uniquely modified vertebral joint allows the tail to flip 180° forward over the back, compacting the bird into a tight ball inside hollow tree nests.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 巨嘴鸟睡觉时会变成一个圆滚滚的黑黄羽毛球，尾巴就是自己的“小棉被”，这样大嘴既保暖又不会被雨林天敌发现！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When sleeping, a toucan tucks its bill under its wing and flips its tail over its back like a warm blanket, masquerading as a harmless puffball!

bodyParts.descZh: 眼睛周围环绕着一圈无毛的鲜艳天青石蓝色裸皮，外层包围着明黄色的面部斑块，形成了极富辨识度的天然彩色眼妆。
bodyParts.descEn: A vivid ring of featherless cobalt-blue skin framing the dark iris, surrounded by luminous yellow facial skin for dramatic species recognition.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蓝色的眼圈不仅好看，还能帮助巨嘴鸟在昏暗的热带雨林树荫下让同伴一眼辨认出自己的位置！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The brilliant electric-blue eye rings reflect light beneath dense rain forest canopies, acting like neon signaling beacons between toucan pairs!

bodyParts.descZh: 纯黑身体前端覆盖着一片如绸缎般明亮的亮黄喉胸羽，下方以一道狭窄的猩红细线与腹部隔开，形成强烈的视觉对比。
bodyParts.descEn: A silky bib of brilliant sunshine-yellow plumage trimmed with a thin scarlet border, providing stark contrast against its black velvet mantle.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 喉咙下那道细细的红线就像系着一条绅士的红色小领结，是巨嘴鸟成熟求偶时的迷人标志！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The tiny crimson crescent under the yellow bib looks just like an elegant red bow tie, showing off full maturity to prospective mates!

bodyParts.descZh: 巨大鸟喙的上下边缘生有细小致密的向前倾斜小锯齿，能像面包锯齿刀一样锯开粗糙果皮，并防止滑溜的浆果从嘴尖滑落。
bodyParts.descEn: Backward-angled microscopic serrations along the bill tomia that grip slippery berries and slice open tough tropical fig skins effortlessly.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 巨嘴鸟虽然没有牙齿，但大嘴边缘自带的这排小锯齿能帮它们稳稳叼住沾满黏液的大棕榈果甚至小树蛙！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Though birds lack true teeth, these built-in serrated knife edges keep slimy tree frogs and slippery jungle berries from escaping their grasp!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 巨嘴鸟长达 20 厘米的巨大嘴巴看着非常沉重，为什么它却能轻松飞行？主要依靠哪种神奇结构？
quizQuestions.promptEn: A toucan's bill is 20 cm long. Why isn't it too heavy to fly with? Which structure makes this possible?

options.textZh: 轻量蜂窝中空巨喙 (重仅15克)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太聪明了！巨嘴鸟的巨喙内部全是由薄骨板构成的海绵蜂窝网络，坚固抗撞却轻如泡沫塑料！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Inside the beak is an ultra-light cellular bone foam network, providing massive strength at minimal weight!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Thermal Radiator Vessels (温控血管散热网络)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Thermal Radiator Vessels
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！巨喙表面的毛细血管能像天然空调一样迅速向空气散发多余热量，给全身降温！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! The bill's surface capillaries release excess metabolic heat into the breeze like an active car radiator!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 巨嘴鸟睡觉时为了钻进狭窄的树洞，是哪个部位向前 180 度翻折盖在背上把自己缩成羽毛球？
quizQuestions.promptEn: When tucking into tight tree hollows to sleep, which part flips 180° forward over the back like a blanket?

options.textZh: 前折翻转盖被尾 (天然小棉被)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！巨嘴鸟尾巴有神奇的万向折叠关节，睡觉时盖在背上，既暖和又能严密伪装！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! A flexible vertebral joint folds the tail flat across the back, compacting the bird into a cozy sphere!

nicknameZh: 心形脸魔法信使与无声幽灵
nicknameEn: The Heart-Faced Silent Ghost
length: 体长 33 - 39 cm / 翼展 80 - 95 cm
lifespan: 野外约 4 - 8 年 (人工饲养最高达 20 年以上)
food: 田鼠、睡鼠、小啮齿动物及夜行小昆虫
habitat: 农田旷野、旧谷仓、古堡钟楼与森林开阔边缘
speed: 巡航滑行约 20 - 30 km/h / 静音俯冲扑杀
overviewZh: 仓鸮是地球上辨识度最高的“心形脸魔法猫头鹰”！它拥有洁白纯净的丝绸心形面盘和落满金砂的优雅羽毛，是哈利·波特世界中神秘信使的原型。仓鸮集成了鸟类世界最顶尖的“声学黑科技”：高低错位的三维立体耳孔能听清积雪下一只田鼠的微弱心跳，而仿生消音流苏羽翼能让它在黑夜中掠过头顶却听不到一丝风声，是温柔又致命的暗夜农场守护者。
overviewEn: The Barn Owl is the globally iconic "heart-faced magic owl" with ghost-white plumage dusted in antique gold spangles. Beyond its mystical storybook appearance, it is a masterclass of evolutionary acoustics: asymmetrical ears calculate the 3D coordinates of hidden prey in total darkness, while comb-like serrated wing margins silence aerodynamic turbulence completely, making it an imperceptible phantom of the twilight meadows.

bodyParts.descZh: 由两圈致密僵硬的羽毛构成完美的心形浅碗状凹面，像微型卫星电视雷达天线一样，将黑夜中微弱的高频声波汇聚聚焦到两侧耳朵中。
bodyParts.descEn: Dense, stiff curved feathers arranged into a parabolic heart-shaped trough that channels and magnifies faint high-frequency rodent sounds directly into the ears.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 仓鸮的面盘就像自带一副生物“定向集音锅”，可以让微弱声音放大整整 10 倍，连一片树叶飘落的声音都听得清清楚楚！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The heart-shaped dish funnels and amplifies subtle sounds tenfold, letting the owl detect a vole rustling dry leaves beneath thick snow!

bodyParts.descZh: 面盘两侧的耳孔高度完全不对称：左耳孔略高且朝下，右耳孔略低且朝上。通过微秒级的声波时间差与强度差，大脑能瞬间算出猎物三维空间坐标。
bodyParts.descEn: Left and right ear cavities sit at different elevations and angles, creating microsecond timing differentials that calculate 3D azimuth and elevation with pin-point precision.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 就算用眼罩把仓鸮的双眼完全蒙上，在一个完全漆黑没有一丝光的房间里，它单凭耳朵就能百分之百抓中地上的移动小老鼠！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Experiments show a blindfolded barn owl in pitch-black darkness can swoop down and capture a scampering mouse using hearing alone!

bodyParts.pinyin: xiāo yīn chǐ zhuàng fēi yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 第一枚初级飞羽前缘生有一排像微型梳子一样的坚硬锯齿，能瓦解刺耳的空气涡流，使气流平缓流过，实现掠过耳边零分贝的完全无声飞行。
bodyParts.descEn: A comb-like leading fringe on primary feathers that breaks large air vortices into micro-eddies, dampening wind resistance and rendering flight virtually noiseless.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 日本新干线子弹列车的高速受电弓为了消除刺耳啸叫，专门模仿了仓鸮飞羽前缘的齿梳结构，成功解决了高铁噪音大难题！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Engineers designing Japan's 500-Series Shinkansen bullet train copied the owl's serrated wing fringes to eliminate sonic boom and pantograph noise!

bodyParts.pinyin: wàn xiàng zhuǎn tóu jǐng zhuī
bodyParts.descZh: 拥有多达 14 节高度灵活的颈椎骨（人类的整整两倍），配合特化的颈动脉蓄血缓冲囊，身体纹丝不动就能把头部向左或向右旋转 270 度！
bodyParts.descEn: Fourteen cervical vertebrae (double a human's) and carotid artery safety reservoirs allow a 270° head swivel without pinching off cerebral blood flow.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 仓鸮如果想看正后方的东西，根本不需要转身，脑袋一拧直接转到背后，就像魔术一样神奇！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A barn owl can pivot its head three-quarters of a full circle to stare directly behind itself without moving a single muscle in its body!

bodyParts.descZh: 眼球并非球体而是狭长圆柱状，被骨质巩膜环牢牢锁在颅骨内。视网膜富含数以亿计的超敏视杆细胞，能在极其昏暗的月光下看清微小动静。
bodyParts.descEn: Elongated, tube-shaped eyes locked in place by bony sclerotic rings, densely packed with rod cells to capture the faintest moonlit photons.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 因为眼球长得像望远镜一样不能在眼眶里转动，所以仓鸮必须靠晃动整个脑袋来切换视线，看着特别像在认真卖萌！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Because their tubular eyes cannot roll in their sockets, owls bob and tilt their heads comically to judge distance and depth!

bodyParts.pinyin: sì zhǐ yè liè gāng zhuǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 脚爪外侧第四趾拥有独一无二的万向旋转关节，捕猎瞬间可向后翻转变成两前两后，形成网状钢箍重重锁死猎物。
bodyParts.descEn: A flexible outer fourth toe that swings backward mid-strike, instantly transforming the talon from a 3-1 perch into a symmetrical 2-2 crushing trap.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 仓鸮脚爪的抓握压强极其惊人，一击命中就能像精密捕鼠器一样瞬间压制住乱窜的田鼠！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The reversible outer toe snaps shut like a four-pronged mechanical claw, instantly securing struggling rodents with crushing leverage!

bodyParts.descZh: 中趾（第三趾）内侧边缘进化出了一排细密整齐的角质梳齿，就像一把随身携带的微型发梳，专门用来清理面部羽毛和梳理耳孔碎屑。
bodyParts.descEn: A built-in miniature comb along the inner edge of the middle claw, designed specifically to preen facial disc feathers and remove parasites from ear canals.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 猫头鹰也非常爱干净，它们每天花很多时间用这把“天然指甲梳”细心梳理心形脸上的羽毛，保持雷达集音锅的最佳平整度！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Barn owls use this natural grooming comb daily to keep their facial dish feathers perfectly aligned for flawless acoustic reception!

bodyParts.pinyin: jīn shā mí cǎi róng yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 背部羽毛呈现温暖的杏黄与古金色，点缀着细腻的黑白星斑，宛如撒满金砂；腹部与胸部则是无暇的雪白绒毛，在枯草与谷仓木梁上完美隐身。
bodyParts.descEn: A magnificent tawny-gold mantle speckled with teardrop pearl-and-ebony spots, blending invisibly against grain fields and weathered barn timbers.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 仓鸮飞过农田时，从下往上看白得像一片雪花融入夜空，从上往下看黄褐色的斑纹与大地融为一体，是全天候的双面隐身衣！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Seen from below, its pure white belly blends with pale twilight clouds; from above, golden spangles blend seamlessly into harvested barley fields!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 日本新干线高速子弹列车为了降低高速运行时的风切刺耳噪音，仿生了仓鸮的哪个身体结构？
quizQuestions.promptEn: To eliminate high-speed wind pantograph noise, Japanese Shinkansen bullet trains biomimicked which barn owl part?

options.textZh: 消音齿状流苏飞羽 (仿生新干线降噪梳齿)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！仓鸮飞羽前缘像梳子一样的小锯齿瓦解了空气旋涡，使飞行完全无声，列车工程师正是由此得到降噪灵感！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The comb-like serrations on leading wing edges break up air vortices for zero-noise flight, inspiring train engineers!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Acoustic Facial Disc (雷达天线心形面盘)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Acoustic Facial Disc
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 真厉害！心形凹面就像卫星天线锅一样汇集高频声音，把微弱的脚步声放大十倍反射给耳朵！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! The parabolic heart disc channels high-frequency sounds straight into the ear canals like a radar dish!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 在完全没有任何光线的漆黑房间里，仓鸮单凭耳朵就能精准定位老鼠，主要依靠哪种独特的耳朵结构？
quizQuestions.promptEn: In complete pitch darkness, a barn owl can pounce on a mouse with 100% accuracy. Which ear structure enables this?

options.textZh: 高低错位三维立体耳 (左右耳高度不一)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太聪明了！仓鸮左右耳一高一低、角度不同，通过微秒级别的声音到达时间差，瞬间计算出目标的三维坐标！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Spot on! Asymmetrical ear openings create microsecond arrival delays that map sound in full 3D space!

nicknameZh: 翡翠百眼森林羽王
nicknameEn: The Living Kaleidoscope
lifespan: 野外约 15 - 20 年 (人工圈养可达 25 年以上)
food: 浆果植物种子、蝗虫蟋蟀，甚至小型毒蛇与蜥蜴 (杂食性)
habitat: 南亚热带常绿阔叶林、近水灌木丛与开阔林间空地
speed: 奔跑速度达 16 km/h，短距离爆发振翅可冲上高大树梢
overviewZh: 蓝孔雀是自然界中最璀璨华贵的“活体万花筒”！雄孔雀开屏时，近两百根长达 1.5 米的华丽羽毛如同众星拱月般绽放，上面缀满绚丽神秘的同心圆“百眼”斑纹。令人惊叹的是，这些流光溢彩的蓝绿光泽完全不含色素，而是羽小枝上如微型棱镜般的二维光子晶体在反射光芒！它们不仅能用剧烈抖动的羽屏发出人类听不见的深林次声波，更生有降蛇伏敌的锋利角质脚距，是兼具极致美感与野性生存智慧的林中王者。
overviewEn: The Indian Peacock is nature's most dazzling living kaleidoscope. When fanning its magnificent display, nearly two hundred elongated feathers radiate into a celestial arc adorned with mesmerizing concentric "eye" spots. Remarkably, this shimmering teal-and-cobalt iridescence contains no pigments—it is pure structural color produced by microscopic photonic crystal barbules. Capable of broadcasting human-inaudible infrasound across forest canopies and armed with defensive spurs to fend off snakes, it is an evolutionary masterpiece.

bodyParts.pinyin: bǎi yǎn kāi píng fù yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 开屏展开的并非真正的尾羽，而是特化的背部尾上覆羽，长达 1.5 米。末端带有由深蓝、青绿与古铜环环相套的同心圆眼斑，形成催眠般绚烂的视觉威慑。
bodyParts.descEn: The radiant fan consists not of true tail rectrices, but elongated upper-tail coverts up to 1.5 meters long, tipped with concentric ocelli eye-spots that create hypnotic visual illusions.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 孔雀开屏时经常被误会是在“开尾巴”，其实它真正的尾羽只有巴掌长，躲在华丽长羽后面像坚固的千斤顶一样把整个彩屏撑起来！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A peacock's actual tail feathers are short and stiff, hidden behind the flamboyant train like a hydraulic jack to hold up the heavy fan!

bodyParts.nameZh: 纳米光栅结构色羽小枝
bodyParts.pinyin: nà mǐ jié gòu sè yǔ xiǎo zhī
bodyParts.descZh: 羽毛上其实没有任何蓝色或绿色色素！羽小枝表面排列着微米级的黑色素杆与角蛋白微结构，形成周期性光子晶体光栅，通过光波干涉折射出变幻莫测的绚丽纯物理色彩。
bodyParts.descEn: Feathers carry zero blue or green pigments! Instead, periodic arrays of melanin rods in keratin form sub-micron photonic crystal lattices that reflect intense interference colors.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 如果把孔雀羽毛泡在纯净水里，由于水改变了光的折射率，羽毛璀璨的绿色光泽会瞬间神奇地变成深黄色！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Submerging a peacock feather in water alters the optical refractive index, miraculously shifting its emerald glow into a warm golden yellow!

bodyParts.pinyin: shàn xíng shēng xué yǔ guān
bodyParts.descZh: 头顶耸立着一顶精致绝伦的折扇形王冠，细长裸柄支撑着翡翠蓝绿小羽。它不仅是求偶装饰，更像一组敏锐的声学天线，能共振感知同伴求偶时发出的微弱气流与声音。
bodyParts.descEn: A regal fan-shaped crown of slender wire quills tipped with emerald-blue spatulas. Functioning as acoustic antennas, they tune into air vibrations created by other courting peacocks.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 科学实验表明，当周围有孔雀抖动羽屏时，雄孔雀和雌孔雀头顶的羽冠会发生精准的机械共振，像调频收音机天线一样！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Scientific tests reveal that a peacock's head crest vibrates in perfect mechanical resonance to the train rattles of courting peers, like an FM antenna!

bodyParts.pinyin: cì shēng bō zhèn chàn yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 开屏展示时，雄鸟以每秒约 25 次的高速剧烈摇晃羽屏。羽轴相互摩擦不仅发出沙沙声，更激发出频率低于 20Hz 的深林次声波，穿透密林向数公里外的同伴宣告领地。
bodyParts.descEn: During display, males shiver their train quills at 25 Hz. This rustling emits low-frequency infrasound (< 20 Hz) that penetrates thick jungle vegetation across several kilometers.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 孔雀发出的次声波人类耳朵完全听不见，但如果站在近处，你的胸腔会感受到一阵像低音炮震动一样的空气微波！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Though inaudible to human ears, if you stand near a displaying peacock, you can actually feel the rhythmic sub-bass pulse vibrating in your chest!

bodyParts.pinyin: bǎo lán jīn shǔ jǐng yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 脖颈与前胸覆盖着极为致密的鱼鳞状小羽毛，呈现高饱和度的皇家钴蓝色与金属微光。羽毛表面光滑防水，在强烈的阳光下如同一件光芒夺目的丝绒蓝铠甲。
bodyParts.descEn: The neck and breast are tiled with dense, scale-like feathers displaying royal cobalt blue with violet sheen, creating a water-repellent, velvet armor of radiant iridescence.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 印度蓝孔雀的这一抹深邃宝蓝如此经典，以至于国际色彩标准库中专门有一款官方颜色就命名为“孔雀蓝”（Peacock Blue）！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The peacock's intense cobalt sheen is so iconic that color systems worldwide have an official color name dedicated to it: "Peacock Blue"!

bodyParts.pinyin: jiǎo zhì fù zhí hòu jù
bodyParts.descZh: 成年雄孔雀小腿后侧各生有一枚尖锐粗硬的角质尖刺（后距）。在面对眼镜蛇捕食或情敌争夺领地时，孔雀会腾空飞踢，以后距重刺击退敌人。
bodyParts.descEn: Adult males develop sharp, bony horn spurs on the back of each leg. In defense against cobra snakes or rival males, peacocks leap into the air delivering lethal stabbing kicks.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在印度民间传说中，孔雀是天生的“百毒克星”与捕蛇能手，它们凭借敏捷的身手和这双锋利后距，经常正面战胜眼镜蛇！
bodyParts.funFactEn: In South Asian folklore, peacocks are celebrated as fearless cobra hunters, using agile jumps and lethal leg spurs to defeat deadly vipers!

bodyParts.pinyin: gāo duì bǐ bái yǎn bān
bodyParts.descZh: 眼睛上方与下方具有月牙形的无羽白色裸露皮肤，与周围深邃的暗蓝羽毛形成极高的黑白对比，使它的眼神在浓密的林下阴影中依然锐利醒目。
bodyParts.descEn: Crescent-shaped bands of bare, chalk-white skin above and below the eyelid produce vivid contrast against cobalt plumage, highlighting keen gaze in forest shade.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这对黑白分明的面部白斑就像天然的“大眼妆”，即使在几十米外的昏暗树荫下，也能让同伴一目了然看清它的头部朝向与警戒神情！
bodyParts.funFactEn: These stark white facial patches act like visual headlights, letting peers instantly discern head orientation and alertness signals from afar in dense canopies!

bodyParts.descZh: 强健有力的四趾配有厚实耐磨的角质鳞皮与粗弯脚爪。白天在泥土和枯叶堆中刨寻植物球茎与爬虫，夜晚则紧紧扣抱十几米高的树枝防范野兽偷袭。
bodyParts.descEn: Robust four-toed feet lined with tough scales and curved talons, built for scratching open forest soil for insects by day and tightly gripping high roost branches at night.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 别看孔雀拖着巨大的尾巴，它们不仅能以每小时 16 公里的速度在地面飞奔，傍晚还能一口气扑闪飞上十几米高的巨树顶端睡觉！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Despite dragging heavy tail trains, peacocks can sprint at 16 km/h on the ground and launch explosive vertical flights to roost safely in high treetops!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 雄孔雀开屏时那面巨大的“百眼彩扇”，实际上是由哪个身体部位特化形成的？
quizQuestions.promptEn: When an Indian Peacock displays its magnificent fan, which specialized body part actually forms the radiant train?

options.textZh: 百眼开屏覆羽 (背部尾上覆羽而非真正的尾巴)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答完全正确！平时大家以为孔雀开屏是在开尾巴，其实真正支撑开屏的是长达1.5米的尾上覆羽，真正的尾羽短小强壮，躲在后面当支架！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The glorious fan is composed of 1.5-meter upper tail coverts, while true tail quills stay hidden behind to provide rigid support!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Photonic Crystal Micro-Barbules (纳米光栅结构色羽小枝)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Photonic Crystal Micro-Barbules

options.textZh: 纳米光栅结构色羽小枝

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！孔雀羽毛并没有绿色或蓝色色素，而是羽小枝上如纳米光栅般的光子晶体结构折射干涉光线，呈现出的纯物理光学色彩！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Peacock feathers contain zero blue or green pigment; their colors emerge purely from physical light interference through photonic crystal nano-lattices!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 雄孔雀在开屏展示时以每秒25次剧烈抖动羽屏，科学家发现它能激发出人类听不见的哪种神秘信号？
quizQuestions.promptEn: When shivering its train at 25 Hz during display, what mysterious human-inaudible signal does the male peacock broadcast?

options.textZh: 次声波发声震颤羽 (发出低于20Hz的穿透性次声波)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太厉害了！孔雀抖动羽毛发出低于20Hz的次声波，能穿透茂密的丛林传向远方，而同伴头顶的羽冠能像收音机天线一样感知震颤！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! Peacocks generate sub-20Hz infrasound that travels vast distances through dense jungles, detected by peers' sensitive head crest antennas!

nicknameZh: 极地冰原燕尾服潜水霸王
nicknameEn: Tuxedo Deep Diver of the Polar Ice
lifespan: 约 15 - 20 年 (部分个体可达 30 年以上)
food: 南极鳞虾、南极银鱼、小型头足类乌贼
habitat: 南极大陆周边浮冰区与边缘沿岸严寒冰架
speed: 水中游速 6 - 9 km/h (极速冲刺可达 20 km/h)
overviewZh: 帝企鹅是地球上现存体型最大、最耐寒的鸟类！它们生活在零下数十度的南极严寒世界，尽管双翼已经退化无法在空中飞翔，却演化成了极其强大的水下“飞行家”。厚实的防寒脂肪、如鳞甲般紧密的双层防水羽毛、以及神奇的恒温育儿袋，让它们能在咆哮的暴风雪中傲然挺立，完成生命最震撼的繁衍奇迹。
overviewEn: The Emperor Penguin is the largest and most cold-hardy bird on Earth. Inhabiting the punishing sub-zero Antarctic wilderness, its wings have evolved from flight into biological hydrofoils for deep underwater propulsion. Armed with dense waterproof plumage, thick blubber, and a dedicated warm brood pouch, it survives the fiercest polar blizzards.

bodyParts.descZh: 细长微弯的坚硬角质喙，粉橙色的下喙基部配有锋利上喙钩。内侧密布倒刺状角质乳突，在冰海高速潜水追捕时能死死夹住滑腻的南极磷虾与银鱼。
bodyParts.descEn: A long, streamlined bill with a sharp hooked tip and pinkish lower mandible. Lined internally with backward-pointing keratin papillae to firmly trap slippery Antarctic krill and silverfish.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 帝企鹅在零下几十度的冰冷海水中潜水捕食，它的喙部鼻腔拥有独特的逆流热交换结构，吸入的刺骨空气在进入肺部前就会被加热！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When breathing sub-zero air, penguins use a counter-current heat exchanger inside their nasal chambers to warm freezing drafts before they reach the lungs!

bodyParts.pinyin: jīn huáng ěr yǔ biāo zhì
bodyParts.descZh: 耳后两侧如日落般绚丽的金黄与亮橙色羽斑，顺着颈项优雅晕染过渡到雪白的前胸。这是帝企鹅成年后最荣耀的身份勋章与求偶标志。
bodyParts.descEn: Vibrant sunset-gold and orange auricular feather patches sweeping gracefully down each side of the head, serving as crucial visual badges for mate recognition in dense polar rookeries.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在极夜狂风与成千上万只拥挤的企鹅群中，帝企鹅依靠独一无二的声调频率和醒目的金黄耳斑，能在茫茫企鹅海中精准找到自己的伴侣！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Amid blizzards and deafening colonies of thousands, penguins locate their lifelong partners within minutes using unique vocal frequencies and vibrant ear badges!

bodyParts.pinyin: liú xiàn xíng qián shuǐ tǐ xíng
bodyParts.descZh: 呈完美的鱼雷流线形水滴体态，将水下运动阻力降至最低。体表下方裹着厚达 3 厘米的致密皮下脂肪层，宛如自带极地防寒潜水服。
bodyParts.descEn: A torpedo-shaped hydrodynamic contour that minimizes underwater turbulence. Wrapped in a 3-centimeter thick sub-dermal blubber blanket that acts as natural polar thermal insulation.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 帝企鹅是鸟类中的“潜水总冠军”！它们最深可潜入 564 米的漆黑冰海深渊，闭气潜水时间长达 32 分钟！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Emperor penguins are the ultimate avian deep divers, descending down to 564 meters (1,850 ft) and holding their breath for up to 32 minutes!

bodyParts.pinyin: gāng xìng tuī jìn qí zhuàng yì
bodyParts.descZh: 翅膀骨骼高度硬化且关节锁紧，演化为扁平坚硬的推进桨。在水中如水下机翼般上下摆动，产生强大的升力与推力，像在冰海中“飞翔”。
bodyParts.descEn: Wing bones are fused and flattened into rigid biological hydrofoils. Flapping like underwater wings, they generate immense forward thrust, allowing penguins to literally fly through water.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 出水上岸时，帝企鹅在水中极速加速游动，利用羽毛间释放的微小气泡润滑减阻，像火箭一样垂直腾空跃出水面两米多高降落在冰架上！
bodyParts.funFactEn: To leap onto high ice sheets, penguins release micro-air bubbles from feathers to lubricate water friction, rocketing vertically 2 meters into the air!

bodyParts.pinyin: gé rè fáng shuǐ shuāng céng yǔ máo
bodyParts.descZh: 全鸟类中密度最高的羽毛装甲，每平方厘米分布超过 100 根微细羽毛。外层如鱼鳞般紧密重叠闭合，内层绒羽锁住保温空气层，入水滴水不透。
bodyParts.descEn: The highest feather density of any bird, packing over 100 feathers per square centimeter. Scaled outer tips lock tightly over a downy underlayer, sealing an impermeable barrier of air.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 哪怕南极遭遇时速 200 公里的零下 60℃ 特大暴风雪，帝企鹅贴身皮肤的温度依然能保持在温暖舒适的 38℃！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Even in -60°C polar blizzards howling at 200 km/h, the air locked against an emperor penguin's skin stays at a toasty 38°C (100°F)!

bodyParts.pinyin: héng wēn fū huà yù ér dài
bodyParts.descZh: 下腹部的一块垂下无毛且布满密集毛细血管网的厚实皮褶。企鹅爸爸用它将蛋稳稳覆盖在脚背上贴身保暖，整整 65 天不吃不喝站立孵蛋。
bodyParts.descEn: A thick, vascularized flap of bare abdominal skin that folds snugly over eggs resting on top of the father's feet, maintaining 38°C incubation heat for 65 days without eating.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 企鹅蛋如果掉在零下 40℃ 的冰地上，只要几分钟就会被冻透坏死，所以企鹅爸爸在暴风雪中会极其小心地用脚趾紧紧扣住蛋！
bodyParts.funFactEn: If an emperor penguin egg accidentally rolls onto the -40°C ice, it can freeze solid in mere minutes, making the father's gentle foot-cradling crucial for survival!

bodyParts.pinyin: fáng huá lín jiǎ jiān zhuǎ zú
bodyParts.descZh: 粗壮有力的脚掌覆盖着粗糙耐磨的角质鳞片，配有锋利下弯的黑色硬爪与防滑纹理肉垫，在极度光滑湿冷的海冰上行走自如、抓地力极强。
bodyParts.descEn: Heavy-duty feet sheathed in coarse keratinous scales and curved black claws. Textured non-slip sole pads deliver exceptional grip across glare polar ice sheets.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 帝企鹅的脚掌血管有奇妙的“热量逆流回收”系统，脚底温度刚好保持在略高于冰点（约 1℃-2℃），既不会冻伤脚，又不会把冰面融化！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Counter-current blood circulation keeps penguin feet just slightly above freezing (1-2°C), preventing frostbite without wasting core body heat or melting the ice beneath!

bodyParts.pinyin: sān jiǎo zhī chēng kàng hán yìng wěi
bodyParts.descZh: 粗短坚韧的楔形尾羽，羽干异常粗壮硬挺。当企鹅在冰面上站立或睡觉时，尾羽向后抵住冰面，与双脚形成一个稳固的“三脚架”。
bodyParts.descEn: Short, rigid wedge-shaped tail feathers with ultra-stiff shafts. In sub-zero winds, it presses backward against the ice, creating a stable tripod stance with the heels.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 依靠这条硬尾巴支撑身体后倾，企鹅可以把整个前脚掌抬离冻冰，只用脚后跟和尾羽着地，大大减少了与刺骨冰面的接触面积！
bodyParts.funFactEn: By rocking back on this stiff tail tripod, penguins lift their front toes entirely off the freezing ice, slashing conductive cold loss from the frozen ground!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 在南极极夜的漫长严冬中，企鹅爸爸用身体的哪个部位贴身保护企鹅蛋，整整两个月不吃不喝完成孵化？
quizQuestions.promptEn: During harsh Antarctic winter, which body part does the father penguin use to keep the egg warm for over two months without eating?

options.textZh: 恒温孵化育儿袋 (腹部下垂温暖皮褶)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答完全正确！企鹅爸爸用下腹部下垂的羽毛育儿袋把蛋紧紧盖在脚背上，里面温度高达38℃，保护小企鹅不受外界零下数十度狂风暴雪的伤害！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The father tucks the egg under his warm, feathered abdominal brood pouch onto his feet, keeping it safely at 38°C in howling sub-zero blizzards!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Rigid Hydrofoil Flipper Wings (刚性推进鳍状翼)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Rigid Hydrofoil Flipper Wings
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！企鹅的翅膀已经退化了空中飞行的能力，但高度硬化的骨骼让它变成强有力的水中机翼，像在水下展翅飞翔一样！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! While penguins cannot fly through the air, their rigid, flattened flippers act as powerful hydrofoils, letting them fly through the ocean!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 当帝企鹅在光滑冻冰上站立或休息时，它会依靠哪个部位与脚后跟形成稳固的“三脚架”，让脚趾翘起离开冰面？
quizQuestions.promptEn: When resting on icy sheets, which body part forms a stable tripod with its heels so toes can lift off the frozen ground?

options.textZh: 三角支撑抗寒硬尾 (粗短坚韧楔形尾羽)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太厉害了！粗短硬挺的尾羽在身后充当第三只支脚，企鹅重心后移后把脚趾抬离冰面，大大减少了热量向刺骨冰面的流失！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! The stiff tail feathers act as a rigid third leg, allowing penguins to rock back on their heels and lift their toes to prevent frostbite!

nicknameZh: 盐湖倒立滤水粉红舞者
nicknameEn: Pink Filter Dancer of the Soda Lakes
lifespan: 野外约 30 - 40 年 (人工饲养可达 60 年以上)
food: 水生卤虫、蓝绿藻、硅藻、微型水生昆虫幼虫
habitat: 浅水盐湖、沿海泻湖、泥泞滩涂与强碱性湿地
speed: 飞行巡航时速 50 - 60 km/h (可连飞上千公里迁徙)
overviewZh: 大红鹳（俗称火烈鸟）是湿地涉禽中最优雅壮观的粉红奇迹！它们群居在烈日暴晒的腐蚀性强盐碱湖中，拥有不可思议的倒置滤食弧形鸟嘴、长达十九节的S形天鹅长颈与修长的高跷双腿。它们从食物中摄取天然类胡萝卜素，将羽毛染成了绚烂夺目的落霞珊瑚粉，宛如在波光粼粼的水面上翩翩起舞的自然精灵。
overviewEn: The Greater Flamingo is a breathtaking pink icon of global wetlands. Thriving in harsh, caustic soda lakes where few other creatures survive, it wields an ingenious downward-bent filter bill, a graceful 19-vertebra serpentine neck, and stilt-like wading limbs. Siphoning carotenoid pigments from brine shrimp and algae, its plumage burns with vivid sunset coral-crimson.

bodyParts.pinyin: dào zhì lǜ shí hú xíng huì
bodyParts.descZh: 独特向下曲折的大喙，前端呈煤黑色。进食时火烈鸟将整个头部完全颠倒浸入水中，利用上喙当底盘、下喙当盖子，呈反向开合的高效滤水漏勺。
bodyParts.descEn: A specialized bill angled sharply downward with a jet-black tip. When feeding, the flamingo submerges its head completely upside-down, using its upper mandible as a spoon to scoop and filter water.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 火烈鸟是全地球唯一能“把头底朝天倒过来吃饭”的鸟类！它的上颌比下颌更小更轻，正好适应倒立舀水的独特姿势！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Flamingos are the only birds on Earth that eat with their heads completely upside-down! Their smaller, lighter upper beak is perfectly adapted for reverse scooping!

bodyParts.pinyin: shí jiǔ jié gāo líng huó xìng S cháng jǐng
bodyParts.descZh: 拥有多达 19 节极其灵活的颈椎骨（比长颈鹿的 7 节还要多两倍以上！），能像优雅的蛇形缎带一样自如弯曲折叠，轻松探入泥浆深处捕食。
bodyParts.descEn: Possessing 19 elongated cervical vertebrae (more than double a giraffe's seven!), this serpentine neck flexes and folds effortlessly to reach deep lake muds.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 火烈鸟睡觉时会把整条长脖子盘旋折叠成一个优雅的“麻花”，把沉重的大鸟嘴直接舒舒服服放在自己的后背羽毛软垫上！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When sleeping, flamingos twist their long necks into a cozy spiral and rest their heavy beaks comfortably cushioned upon their soft back feathers!

bodyParts.pinyin: lèi hú luó bo sù shān hú fěn yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 如盛开落霞般的亮丽粉红与绯红覆羽。初生幼鸟原本是灰白色的，完全是通过消化吸收水中的卤虫和蓝绿藻中的类胡萝卜素，才将羽毛染成了绚烂的珊瑚红。
bodyParts.descEn: Luminous coral-pink and scarlet feathers glowing like sunset clouds. Born greyish-white, flamingos derive their radiant coloration entirely from carotenoid pigments in the brine shrimp and algae they consume.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 如果不吃富含胡萝卜素的藻类或小虾（例如动物园里喂普通谷物），火烈鸟新长出来的羽毛就会慢慢褪回灰白色！
bodyParts.funFactEn: If flamingos stop eating carotenoid-rich algae and shrimp, their new feathers will gradually fade back to dull greyish-white!

bodyParts.pinyin: yǐn mì hēi sè chū jí fēi yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 静止站立时大部分被粉红覆羽遮掩，只有翼尖露出一抹墨黑。展开近 1.6 米的巨大双翼起飞时，深沉纯黑的初级飞羽与鲜红翼面形成极其震撼的视觉对比。
bodyParts.descEn: Mostly hidden beneath pink coverts when standing, only the tips peek out. When spreading its 1.6-meter wings to take flight, these jet-black primary flight feathers create an astonishing contrast against fiery crimson.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 黑色羽毛含有高密度的黑色素颗粒，比普通粉色羽毛耐磨坚硬数倍，能强力抵抗数千公里长途迁徙中强风对飞羽的剧烈磨损！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Melanin in black feathers makes them significantly tougher and more abrasion-resistant, shielding vital flight feathers from fierce winds during long migrations!

bodyParts.pinyin: gāo shè shuǐ fěn hóng gāo qiāo cháng tuǐ
bodyParts.descZh: 长达半米多的修长腿骨，让火烈鸟能在极深的腐蚀性强盐碱湖中从容涉水。表面附有坚韧的角质鳞片，完全不惧碱水灼伤；中间向后弯曲的“膝盖”其实是它的脚踝关节！
bodyParts.descEn: Over 50 cm long, these stilt-like limbs allow effortless wading through caustic alkaline soda lakes. Armed with tough keratinous scales, the backward-bending "knee" is actually the anatomical ankle joint!
bodyParts.funFactZh: 火烈鸟为什么喜欢单腿站立？科学家发现单腿锁死关节几乎零消耗肌肉能量，而且把另一条腿收进羽毛里能减少一半散失的热量！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Why do flamingos stand on one leg? Locking their unique leg joints requires zero active muscle effort, and tucking one leg into feathers cuts heat loss in half!

bodyParts.pinyin: qiǎn tān huá ní bàn pǔ zú
bodyParts.descZh: 三根向前伸展的长趾之间相连着坚韧的蹼膜。不仅在深水区能像野鸭一样划水游泳，在松软如稀泥的湖底行走时更能像雪鞋一样分散体重，防止深陷烂泥。
bodyParts.descEn: Three forward-pointing toes connected by durable webbed skin. Operating like snowshoes, they distribute weight to prevent sinking into treacherous soft lake mud while stamping to stir up food.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 火烈鸟觅食时会像跳踢踏舞一样用脚蹼快速原地“踩泥踏步”，把深埋在淤泥里的螺类、藻类和小虾统统震荡搅浑到水面来滤食！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Flamingos perform an energetic tap dance in the mud, stamping their webbed feet in circles to churn up hidden crustaceans and algae from the lakebed!

bodyParts.pinyin: huó sāi shì ròu zhì jí cì dà shé
bodyParts.descZh: 厚实巨大的肉质舌头，两缘密布微小坚硬的角质棘刺。进食时舌头在喙内以每秒高达 5-6 次的高频前后活塞式抽吸，将水流高速泵入喙内滤板，再将泥水强力排出。
bodyParts.descEn: A remarkably thick muscular tongue lined with hooked keratinous spines. Functioning as a high-speed piston at 5-6 cycles per second, it sucks muddy water through bill filters and expels wastewater.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 火烈鸟那肥厚的大舌头在古罗马时期竟然是贵族宴席上昂贵的名贵珍馐！幸好现代人类已经严加保护这种美丽优雅的生灵！
bodyParts.funFactEn: In ancient Rome, the flamingo's extraordinarily large, fleshy tongue was considered an extravagant delicacy served at imperial banquets!

bodyParts.pinyin: yán jiǎn pái xiè bí yán xiàn
bodyParts.descZh: 位于眼窝上方鼻腔根部的超级脱盐器官。火烈鸟终年在腐蚀性极强的高浓度盐碱湖中饮水觅食，依靠鼻盐腺将血液中过量的浓缩盐分高效浓缩，以高浓度盐水滴从鼻孔排出。
bodyParts.descEn: Supraorbital desalinating glands nestled above the eyes. Surviving in caustic soda lakes, these glands filter toxic excess salt from the bloodstream, discharging concentrated brine drops through the nares.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 火烈鸟常年栖息的高碱度盐湖甚至能腐蚀大部分动物的皮肉，但火烈鸟凭借鼻盐腺和坚硬腿皮，不仅毫发无损，还能直接喝滚烫的沸腾地热泉水！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The caustic soda lakes flamingos inhabit can strip flesh from other animals, yet flamingos thrive there unharmed and can even drink near-boiling geyser runoff!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 火烈鸟羽毛那令人惊艳的珊瑚粉红色，究竟是吸收了食物中的哪种神秘成分？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What mysterious dietary nutrient gives a Greater Flamingo its radiant coral-pink and crimson plumage?

options.textZh: 类胡萝卜素珊瑚粉羽 (吸收卤虫与蓝绿藻中的类胡萝卜素)
options.textEn: Carotenoid Crimson Plumage (From brine shrimp & algae)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答完全正确！火烈鸟刚孵化时是灰白色的，是通过长期摄食含有大量天然类胡萝卜素的卤虫和微藻，色素逐渐沉积在羽毛中才变成粉红色的！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! Chicks hatch with greyish-white down; the vibrant pink color accumulates gradually as they digest carotenoid-rich brine shrimp and algae!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Downward-Bent Filtering Bill (倒置滤食弧形喙)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Downward-Bent Filtering Bill
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！火烈鸟进食时把大喙倒扣进水里，像个倒置的滤水漏勺一样前后筛动，把微小藻类和小虾留下来吞下！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Flamingos hold their bill upside-down in the water like an inverted sieve, filtering tiny algae and shrimp from the muddy soup!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 在腐蚀性极强的高浓度盐碱湖中生活，火烈鸟依靠哪个身体部位把体内过量的盐分化作浓盐水滴排出体外？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Living in hyper-saline soda lakes, which body part helps flamingos excrete excess toxic salt from their bloodstream?

options.textZh: 盐碱排泄鼻盐腺 (位于眼窝上方浓缩排盐)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太厉害了！火烈鸟眼眶上方的鼻盐腺能高效浓缩血液中的盐分，以高浓度盐水滴顺着鼻孔排出来，是超强的生物海水淡化器！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! The supraorbital salt glands actively filter out excess salt, dripping concentrated brine from the nostrils like a biological desalination plant!

nicknameZh: 森林树干重击神医
nicknameEn: The Heavy-Impact Forest Surgeon
length: 体长 20 - 24 cm / 翼展 34 - 39 cm
lifespan: 野外约 9 - 11 年 (最高纪录可达 14 年)
food: 树皮蛀木天牛幼虫、松柏球果坚果种子、树汁
habitat: 温带针叶林、落叶阔叶林、森林公园与古老果园
speed: 波浪状穿林飞翔 30 - 40 km/h (敲击树干达 20次/秒)
overviewZh: 大斑啄木鸟是全地球森林中最不知疲倦的“树木外科医生”与“击鼓大师”！它们身披黑白相间的大理石斑驳羽衣，雄鸟后脑勺点缀着鲜红的英勇勋章。凭借如钢凿般自砺锋利的鸟喙、环绕整个后脑勺充当减震安全带的神秘舌骨、以及如同钢锚般的对趾爬树利爪，它们能在高达 1,200g 剧烈减速撞击下安然无恙，精准剔除潜伏在树木深处的害虫！
overviewEn: The Great Spotted Woodpecker is the tireless drum virtuoso and tree surgeon of the northern woodlands. Sporting pied black-and-white plumage with a crimson male nape badge, it possesses an ultra-dense chisel bill, an extraordinary hyoid bone sling that wraps around its entire skull like an internal seatbelt, and zygodactyl climbing claws. Enduring 1,200g impacts with zero brain trauma, it excavates deep timber grubs with surgical precision.

bodyParts.pinyin: gāo yìng dù fáng zhèn záo xíng huì
bodyParts.descZh: 如钢铁凿子般坚韧锋利的厚实鸟喙。外覆坚硬且自动磨砺的多层角质层，每秒以高达 20 次的超快频率撞击树干，凿开坚硬树皮而不崩裂。
bodyParts.descEn: A stout, chisel-tipped bill built like high-grade steel. Sheathed in self-sharpening layered keratin sheets, it hammers tree bark up to 20 times per second without blunting or fracturing.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 啄木鸟啄树时的头部减速度高达 1,200g（相当于人类遭遇致命车祸的 10 倍以上！），但它的特殊喙形让冲击波完全沿直线分散，丝毫不会震碎喙骨！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A woodpecker strikes trees at a staggering 1,200g of deceleration (10x a human car crash limit), yet its chisel bill channels the shockwaves safely along rigid linear vectors!

bodyParts.pinyin: huán nǎo lú shé gǔ jiǎn zhèn dài
bodyParts.descZh: 自然界最不可思议的体内“安全带”！由一对极其细长且高弹性的舌骨角组成，从喉部分叉向后绕过整个后脑勺，在头骨顶部闭合延伸至右鼻孔，像吊床一样悬吊并缓冲大脑。
bodyParts.descEn: Nature's most miraculous biological seatbelt. Long, elastic hyoid horns route backward from the throat, wrap entirely around the rear skull, and tether over the forehead to cradle the brain against violent g-forces.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 人类现代顶级摩托车与赛车防撞头盔、安全气囊的减震阻尼带设计，正是工程师从啄木鸟这根“环脑舌骨”中获取的仿生学灵感！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Modern high-tech racing helmets and aerospace collision dampening systems are biomimetically engineered after the woodpecker's wraparound hyoid sling!

bodyParts.pinyin: dào gōu nián yè shēn suō bǔ chóng shé
bodyParts.descZh: 长度可达体长三分之一的超长捕虫舌头！平时收缩卷绕在头骨后方，一旦凿穿树干，舌头便能如弹簧般刺入曲折的蛀虫地道。舌尖长有坚硬倒钩，并分泌强力胶水般的黏液，将肥嫩的天牛幼虫死死钩出。
bodyParts.descEn: Extending up to one-third of its entire body length, this whip-like tongue snakes through labyrinthine timber tunnels. Equipped with backward-pointing keratin harpoon barbs and glue-like saliva, it extracts wood-boring beetle grubs.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大斑啄木鸟的舌头不仅能伸缩，舌尖还布满敏锐的触觉神经末梢，在漆黑曲折的树心蛀道里，完全依靠“舌尖手感”就能精确感知幼虫的蠕动！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Packed with sensitive tactile nerve endings at its barbed tip, the woodpecker's tongue navigates pitch-black wood galleries purely by touch to feel wriggling larvae!

bodyParts.pinyin: wēi kǒng hǎi mián jiǎn zhèn gǔ bǎn
bodyParts.descZh: 位于坚硬喙基与柔软大脑之间的多孔海绵状骨板。微观结构宛如蜂窝金属泡沫，能在微秒之间将强烈的机械冲击动能转化为弹性形变并吸收耗散，杜绝脑震荡。
bodyParts.descEn: Dense yet porous trabecular bone sandwiched between the beak base and braincase. Resembling metallic micro-lattices, it rapidly absorbs and dissipates impact kinetic energy to completely prevent concussions.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 啄木鸟的大脑质量只有两克多且紧密贴合颅骨，脑脊液极少，因此几乎没有像人类大脑那样的“晃荡撞击空间”，天然杜绝脑震荡！
bodyParts.funFactEn: With a brain weighing just 2 grams packed tightly against its skull with minimal cerebrospinal fluid, there is zero room for the brain to slosh, preventing internal head trauma!

bodyParts.pinyin: duì zhǐ pá shù jiān zhuǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 专门适应垂直树干攀爬的“对趾型”足部结构：第二、三趾朝前，第一、四趾朝后。配有弯曲如铁钩般的高硬度脚爪，能牢牢嵌扣在坚硬粗糙的树皮缝隙中，如履平地。
bodyParts.descEn: Specialized for vertical tree climbing: two toes face forward (digits 2 and 3) while two face backward (digits 1 and 4). Armed with curved, needle-sharp talons that lock securely into rough bark crevices.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 不仅能在直立树干上飞速向上爬行，啄木鸟甚至还能倒挂在水平伸出的粗树枝下方，甚至倒挂着凿树找虫子吃！
bodyParts.funFactEn: In addition to sprinting up vertical trunks, woodpeckers can comfortably hang upside-down beneath horizontal tree boughs and hammer away for food!

bodyParts.pinyin: gāng xìng zhī chēng jí jiān wěi yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 羽干异常粗壮坚硬的中央尾羽，末端如荆棘般尖锐内扣。当啄木鸟垂直攀在树干上时，尾羽向下弯曲死死顶住树皮，与双脚形成一个纹丝不动的力学“三脚架”。
bodyParts.descEn: Exceptionally thick, stiff central rectrices tapering into spine-like pointed tips. When clinging to trunks, it presses firmly downward against bark, creating an unyielding structural tripod with the feet.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在一年换羽季节中，啄木鸟只有在所有新的侧面尾羽全部长齐变硬之后，才会脱落那两根至关重要的中央支撑硬羽，确保随时都能攀树！
bodyParts.funFactEn: During molting, woodpeckers retain their critical central prop feathers until all outer tail feathers are fully grown, ensuring their climbing tripod is never compromised!

bodyParts.pinyin: fáng xiè fáng chén bí kǒng yǔ xū
bodyParts.descZh: 覆盖在喙基部狭长鼻孔上的致密刚毛状羽须。在高速凿击树木飞沙走石、木屑四溅的剧烈工作中，像精密空气过滤网一样阻挡飞尘与木屑吸入呼吸道。
bodyParts.descEn: Dense, bristly feather tufts completely shielding the narrow slit-like nostrils. Acting as high-efficiency particulate air filters, they block flying woodchips and sawdust during intense excavation.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 每次在凿击木头的前一毫秒，啄木鸟还会瞬间闭上透明坚韧的第三眼睑（瞬膜），就像自带防尘口罩与全封闭护目镜！
bodyParts.funFactEn: One millisecond before every hammer blow, the woodpecker blinks its thick nictitating membrane closed, combining a sawdust dust-mask with protective safety goggles!

bodyParts.descZh: 成年雄性大斑啄木鸟后枕部一抹鲜艳夺目的红宝石色羽斑（雌鸟没有）。配合下腹部与尾下的火红羽色，在幽暗的绿叶丛林中作为强烈的领地警示与同伴识别信号。
bodyParts.descEn: A brilliant ruby-red patch emblazoned across the nape of adult males (absent in females). Paired with vivid crimson undertail coverts, it flashes as a striking visual badge for territorial defense and mate courtship.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 啄木鸟宣布领地不仅仅靠鲜红的枕斑，春天它们还会特意挑选空心树枝甚至铁皮屋顶剧烈敲击，发出响彻整座森林的“机关枪鼓鸣声（Drumming）”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: To proclaim territories in spring, woodpeckers drum at 20 beats per second on resonant hollow boughs and metal chimneys, echoing machine-gun acoustic signals across the woods!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大斑啄木鸟以每秒20次剧烈凿树却完全不会脑震荡，主要归功于环绕后脑勺的哪根神奇结构？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which extraordinary anatomical structure loops around the woodpecker's skull like a biological seatbelt to prevent brain concussions?

options.textZh: 环脑颅舌骨减震带 (绕过颅后悬吊大脑)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答完全正确！啄木鸟高弹性的舌骨从喉部绕过后脑勺一直延伸到头顶，在强力撞击时像安全带与吊床一样吸收冲击波，保护大脑！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The elastic hyoid horns wrap around the rear skull to cradle the brain like an internal suspension seatbelt during heavy impact!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Barbed Harpoon Sticky Tongue (倒钩黏液伸缩捕虫舌)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Barbed Harpoon Sticky Tongue
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！啄木鸟的舌头能伸出体长三分之一的距离，顶端有硬刺倒钩和黏液，专门探进木心曲折的隧道里把天牛幼虫像叉鱼一样钓出来！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Extending up to a third of its body length, the tongue has barbed tips and sticky mucus to harpoon beetle larvae from wood tunnels!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 在直立的树干上敲击时，啄木鸟利用哪个部位与双脚形成稳固支撑的“力学三脚架”？
quizQuestions.promptEn: When drumming on vertical tree trunks, which body part presses against the bark to form a steady tripod with the feet?

options.textZh: 刚性支撑棘尖尾羽 (坚硬粗羽死死顶住树皮)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太厉害了！啄木鸟尾羽的羽干异常粗壮硬挺，顶在树皮上充当第三条稳固支脚，身体后坐形成坚如磐石的力学支撑！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! The spine-like stiff central tail feathers press into the bark, forming a rock-solid tripod together with the feet!

pinyin: fēi hóng jīn gāng yīng wǔ
nicknameZh: 雨林彩虹巨喙滑翔手
nicknameEn: The Rainbow Nutcracker of the Canopy
lifespan: 野外 40 - 50 年 (人工饲养环境下可达 75 年以上)
food: 棕榈坚果、坚硬巴西坚果、无花果浆果、花蜜与高营养泥土矿物
habitat: 中南美洲低地热带雨林树冠层、河岸森林、红树林
speed: 平飞时速 56 - 65 km/h
overviewZh: 绯红金刚鹦鹉是中南美洲热带雨林中最绚丽璀璨的大型鹦鹉之一。它们体长接近一米，身披如烈火般的猩红、明黄与钴蓝相间的华丽彩虹羽毛。拥有聪慧绝伦的大脑与能够轻松夹碎巴西坚果的强力弯钩巨喙，常在亚马逊雨林上空成双成对高速展翅翱翔，是热带雨林王国的象征。
overviewEn: The Scarlet Macaw is one of the most magnificent and intelligent neotropical parrots of Central and South America. Measuring nearly a meter from head to tail tip, it flashes a dazzling rainbow tapestry of brilliant scarlet, lemon yellow, and cobalt blue. Armed with an immense hooked beak capable of easily cracking rock-hard Brazil nuts, pairs soar high over the rainforest canopy as enduring icons of the tropical jungle.

bodyParts.pinyin: qiáng lì jiān guǒ jiā wān gōu huì
bodyParts.descZh: 上喙呈象牙白色带有锐利下弯尖端，下喙呈墨黑色深槽型。拥有惊人的下颌咬合杠杆力，能产生超过 130 公斤的夹力，如同液压坚果钳般轻松破开岩石般坚硬的巴西坚果！
bodyParts.descEn: A massive pale horn-colored upper mandible with a razor-sharp hooked tip meeting a chisel-like black lower jaw. Delivering over 300 psi of crushing force, it shears open impenetrable Brazil nut shells with effortless hydraulic power.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 金刚鹦鹉的上喙并不是固定在头骨上的，而是通过灵活的动关节与颅骨相连，可以像第三只脚一样用力抓住树枝帮助攀爬！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A macaw's upper beak is hinged to its skull by an elastic joint rather than fused solid, allowing it to act as a formidable "third foot" when climbing branches!

bodyParts.pinyin: líng qiǎo gǔ zhì jī ròu shé
bodyParts.descZh: 舌头内部包裹着独特的舌骨骨片，质地肥厚富含敏锐神经末梢与强劲肌肉。如人类灵巧的手指一样，能够精准翻转固定滑溜的坚果，辅助巨喙剥离坚硬果壳。
bodyParts.descEn: Reinforced by an internal calcified bone shaft and rich in tactile mechanoreceptors, this dexterous, fleshy muscular tongue rolls and positions slippery seeds against the beak with the precision of human fingers.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 金刚鹦鹉的舌头非常敏锐，甚至可以在几分之一秒内用舌尖探测出果肉里极其微小的硬刺并将其剔除，绝不会扎伤自己！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A macaw's tongue is so sensitive it can detect and isolate tiny spines or poisonous seeds in fraction of a second before swallowing!

bodyParts.pinyin: cǎi hóng jiàn biàn zhōng fù yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 位于翅膀中段的覆羽展现出自然界最惊艳的光谱过渡：由鲜艳的大红向下渐变为明媚的金黄，边缘镶嵌着青翠翠绿，最后自然过渡至皇家钴蓝，如同披着微缩彩虹。
bodyParts.descEn: The middle wing coverts showcase nature's most breathtaking spectral gradation: vivid cadmium scarlet blurs into radiant golden yellow with emerald green tips, cascading seamlessly into royal cobalt blue.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 区分绯红金刚鹦鹉与绿翅金刚鹦鹉最关键的标志就是中覆羽：绯红金刚鹦鹉的中覆羽是耀眼的纯黄色（配绿尖），而绿翅金刚鹦鹉则是深绿色！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The surest field ID mark separating Scarlet Macaws from Red-and-green Macaws is these coverts: Scarlet Macaws feature brilliant yellow feathers, while the latter have dark green!

bodyParts.pinyin: gāo kōng cháng chéng gǔ lán fēi yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 翅膀末端长达半米的深邃钴蓝色飞羽，羽轴粗大柔韧，具有极佳的气动空气动力学外形。赋予它们在强风中长距离高速滑翔、穿越浩瀚雨林树冠的能力。
bodyParts.descEn: Elongated, deep cobalt-blue primary flight feathers with heavy, flexible shafts. Engineered for high-speed, long-distance aerodynamic cruising across the vast tropical forest expanse.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 金刚鹦鹉每天清晨和傍晚都要长途跋涉几十公里去觅食或返回栖息地，强韧的蓝飞羽让它们巡航时速轻松达到 60 公里以上！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Scarlet Macaws commute over 30 kilometers every morning and evening between roosting sites and feeding trees, sustaining 60 km/h cruising flights with ease!

bodyParts.pinyin: liú sū xiū cháng xīng hóng wěi yǔ
bodyParts.descZh: 长达体长一半以上的中央细长渐变尾羽。通体猩红，末梢微泛天蓝，在飞行时如鲜红绸带般随风飘逸，不仅华丽无比，更在空中急转弯时充当高灵敏方向舵。
bodyParts.descEn: Elongated central scarlet rectrices exceeding half the bird's total body length. Tipped with delicate azure blue, they stream like silk banners in flight while providing hyper-responsive aerodynamic steering.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在高速穿过茂密的雨林枝杈时，金刚鹦鹉能像折扇一样迅速展开或合拢尾羽，在千分之一秒内完成急刹车与 90 度大角度回转避障！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When weaving through thick jungle branches, macaws fan their long tail like a folding brake paddle to execute instant 90-degree banked evasive turns!

bodyParts.pinyin: duì zhǐ pān yuán jī xiè jiān zhuǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 典型的对趾型强健双足：第二、三趾朝前，第一、四趾朝后。覆满坚硬防滑灰黑鳞片与弯曲利爪，不仅抓握树枝固若金汤，还能像人类手掌一样抓取食物送入口中！
bodyParts.descEn: Specialized zygodactyl arrangement with two toes forward and two toes backward. Armed with rough scales and curved obsidian claws, they lock onto limbs and hold food items just like human hands.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 金刚鹦鹉竟然也分“左撇子”和“右撇子”！绝大多数野生金刚鹦鹉都更偏爱用左脚抓握坚果送到嘴边吃，右脚用来稳稳站立！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Macaws exhibit true "handedness"! Studies reveal that the vast majority of wild parrots preferentially use their left foot to hold food while perching on the right!

bodyParts.pinyin: shēng dòng hóng yùn luǒ bái miàn jiá
bodyParts.descZh: 眼周至喙基大片无羽毛覆盖的纯净白皙皮肤，其上点缀着微细的红色短羽线。皮肤下布满微血管网，当它们兴奋、愤怒或与伴侣互动时，会像人类一样害羞“脸红”！
bodyParts.descEn: A wide expanse of creamy unfeathered facial skin etched with delicate red feather pin-lines. Rich in superficial capillaries, this patch visibly flushes pink and red during excitement or social courtship!
bodyParts.funFactZh: 科学家发现，每只金刚鹦鹉面颊上的红色羽毛细线纹理就像人类的指纹一样独一无二，伴侣之间能通过脸部微表情和红晕深浅读懂对方的情绪！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The delicate red feather stripes on the white cheek patch are as unique as human fingerprints, and mates read micro-flushing signals to gauge emotional states!

bodyParts.pinyin: quán jǐng huán shì ruì lì shuāng mù
bodyParts.descZh: 长在头部两侧的高清大眼，拥有接近 360 度的超广角全景视野与出色的色觉辨识能力。能敏锐识别紫外光波段，轻松看穿隐藏在枝叶背后的熟透浆果与空中的哈比鹰。
bodyParts.descEn: Laterally positioned monocular eyes providing a near-360-degree panoramic field of vision. Equipped with tetrachromatic color vision and UV sensitivity, they instantly spot ripe fruit and soaring harpy eagles.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 金刚鹦鹉不仅能看到人类看不到的紫外线，还能独立转动两只眼睛同时观察不同方向——一只眼盯着树上的坚果，另一只眼警戒天空！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Macaws perceive ultraviolet light invisible to human eyes and can focus each eye independently on different targets—one watching food while the other scouts for predators!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 绯红金刚鹦鹉在热带雨林中吃坚硬的巴西坚果时，依靠哪个身体部位轻松将其夹碎并固定果肉？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which powerful anatomical tool does the Scarlet Macaw use to effortlessly crack open rock-hard Brazil nuts?

options.textZh: 强力坚果夹弯钩喙 (超大咬合力夹碎硬壳)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太聪明了！金刚鹦鹉的上下喙坚硬无比，拥有超过130公斤的惊人夹力，配合活动铰链关节，轻松破开坚硬的坚果！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The heavy hooked beak delivers over 300 psi of crushing force to crack open rock-hard nuts with ease!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Zygodactyl Perching Talons (对趾攀援机械坚爪)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Zygodactyl Perching Talons
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答正确！金刚鹦鹉前两趾后两趾的“对趾型”脚爪，不仅抓握枝干极其牢靠，而且大多数金刚鹦鹉习惯用左脚抓东西吃，非常聪明！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Zygodactyl feet (two toes forward, two back) provide a vice-like grip, and most macaws use their left foot like a hand to eat!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 当绯红金刚鹦鹉感到兴奋、开心或恋爱互动时，身体的哪个部位会像人类一样显现出神奇的粉红红晕？
quizQuestions.promptEn: When a Scarlet Macaw is excited or courting, which body part magically blushes pink and red like human cheeks?

options.textZh: 生动红晕裸白面颊 (密布毛细血管，激动时会脸红)

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 答对了！金刚鹦鹉眼部周围没有羽毛的粉白皮肤密布微血管，情绪激动时会真实地“脸红”，每只鸟的面部红色羽线也是独一无二的！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! The bare white facial skin is rich in capillaries and genuinely blushes red when excited, with feather lines unique to each individual!

nicknameZh: 湿地巨喉捕鱼巨舰
nicknameEn: The Giant Gular Net Aviator
lifespan: 野外 15 - 25 年 (圈养环境下可超过 50 年)
food: 鲤鱼、罗非鱼、淡水杂鱼与甲壳类软体动物
habitat: 浅水湖泊、淡水沼泽、三角洲湿地、沿海潟湖
speed: 巡航飞行 40 - 50 km/h (可升空至 3,000 米盘旋)
overviewZh: 大白鹈鹕是全球飞鸟中体型最宏伟的巨型水禽之一，双翼展开可达惊人的 3.6 米！它们浑身雪白如云，胸前泛着优雅的嫩黄与淡粉色光泽。喙下拥有一个容量高达 13 升的巨大高弹性喉囊，像一把水下超级大抄网。大白鹈鹕极具智慧与团队合作精神，常十几只乃至上百只排成整齐半月形战阵协同围堵鱼群，是水鸟中震撼的捕鱼巨舰队！
overviewEn: The Great White Pelican is one of the world's most awe-inspiring flying giants, with a wingspan stretching up to an incredible 3.6 meters! Clothed in immaculate white plumage with soft pastel yellowish-pink breeding flushes, its defining marvel is an enormous gular pouch holding up to 13 liters of water—acting like an expandable biological dip-net. Renowned for tactical teamwork, large flocks synchronize in graceful crescent formations to herd fish into shallows.

bodyParts.pinyin: chāo tán róng liàng bǔ yú jù hóu náng
bodyParts.descZh: 连接在下喙骨之间的巨大鲜黄色弹性皮囊。容量可高达 13 升（相当于它们体重的两到三倍水容积）！当深入水下时，下颌骨向外扩张张开巨网，一口气兜起大量水与活鱼，闭喙挤出水分后将鲜鱼整条吞下。
bodyParts.descEn: An immense, flexible yellow throat sac slung beneath the lower mandible. Expanding to hold up to 13 liters of water, it bows open like a giant scoop-net underwater to entrap schools of fish before draining the water.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 鹈鹕的巨喉囊不仅是捞鱼网，烈日炎炎时，它们还会快速颤动喉囊皮膜（喉扑呼吸），像扇扇子一样通过水分蒸发给全身降温！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Besides catching fish, pelicans flutter their vascularized throat pouch on hot days—a behavior called "gular fluttering"—to cool their body through evaporative cooling!

bodyParts.pinyin: huì duān fáng huá yìng jiǎo zhì jiǎ gōu
bodyParts.descZh: 长达 40 多厘米的粉红色扁平长喙尖端，生有一枚向下弯曲、极其坚硬锐利的角质“甲钩（Nail）”。在兜捞到黏滑剧烈挣扎的大鱼时，甲钩如鱼叉般瞬间扣住鱼身，确保猎物无法滑脱。
bodyParts.descEn: A sharp, downward-curving amber or red keratinous hook at the apex of the massive upper bill. Acting like an anchor barb, it pins down slippery, thrashing prey to prevent them from wriggling out.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大白鹈鹕的大嘴长达 47 厘米，是全地球现存所有鸟类中除澳洲鹈鹕外最长的鸟喙之一！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Reaching up to 47 cm in length, the Great White Pelican boasts one of the longest beaks in the entire avian kingdom!

bodyParts.pinyin: sān mǐ rè qì liú huá xiáng jù yì
bodyParts.descZh: 翼展可达 3.6 米的辽阔羽翼。雪白的中覆羽与漆黑如墨的初级飞羽形成强烈的黑白对比。超大的翼面积产生惊人的气动升力，让这只十公斤重的大鸟无需费力拍翅，便能借上升热气流盘旋翱翔数小时。
bodyParts.descEn: A colossal wingspan spanning up to 3.6 meters, contrasting pristine white coverts with jet-black primary flight feathers. Generates immense aerodynamic lift to effortlessly circle upward on thermal columns.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在长途迁徙中，鹈鹕群会排成壮观的“V”字形编队，后一只鸟利用前一只鸟翼尖产生的上升涡流滑翔，能节省多达 20% 的体力！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Pelicans migrate in aerodynamic V-formations, riding the vortex wing-tip upwash of the bird ahead to slash flight energy consumption by up to 20%!

bodyParts.nameZh: 全蹼推水四趾强力蹼足
bodyParts.pinyin: quán pǔ tuī shuǐ sì zhǐ qiáng lì pǔ zú
bodyParts.descZh: 鸟类中独一无二的“全蹼型”脚掌：四个脚趾（包括后趾）之间全部由厚韧皮蹼紧密相连。展开面积犹如两把强力大船桨，划水推力惊人，让体型沉重的鹈鹕在水面滑行起飞时瞬间加速。
bodyParts.descEn: Featuring a rare totipalmate design where all four toes—including the hind toe—are interconnected by broad webbing. Acts like heavy-duty marine paddles, providing immense thrust for takeoff across calm waters.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 鹈鹕不仅用这双大蹼足划水，在极寒或育雏时，它们还会把巨大的蹼足垫在刚出生脆弱的小雏鸟身体下方，用厚厚的脚蹼充当暖水袋给宝宝保温！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Pelicans also use their massive warm webbed feet during brooding, tucking delicate naked chicks beneath the webbing to keep them warm like hot water pads!

bodyParts.pinyin: yǎn kuàng gāo yán guò lǜ dài xiè xiàn
bodyParts.descZh: 隐藏在眼窝骨上方的特殊排盐腺体。当鹈鹕在沿海潟湖或高盐度咸水湖捕食吞入海水时，该腺体能过滤并浓缩血液中的多余氯化钠，以高浓度浓盐液顺着喙上的鼻沟排出体外。
bodyParts.descEn: Specialized paired supraorbital glands situated above the eye sockets. When foraging in hyper-saline lakes or lagoons, they extract excess salt ions from the blood, channeling droplets down bill grooves.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 得益于这套天然“生物海水化淡系统”，大白鹈鹕既能在纯淡水湖泊畅游，也能在非洲高腐蚀性碳酸钠咸水湖甚至红海沿岸自如生活！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Thanks to these built-in biological desalination engines, pelicans flourish in both pure freshwater rivers and caustic hypersaline soda lakes across Africa!

bodyParts.nameZh: 尾脂腺蜡质拒水羽毛装甲
bodyParts.pinyin: wěi zhī xiàn là zhì jù shuǐ yǔ máo zhuāng jiǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 尾部的尾脂腺分泌出富含蜡质与脂肪酸的防水油脂。鹈鹕用喙细心将其梳理涂抹在全身羽毛表面，形成疏水屏障。即使整天漂浮在湿冷湖面上，底层的保暖绒羽依然干燥蓬松，浮力十足。
bodyParts.descEn: Conditioned by lipid-rich preen oils secreted from the tail uropygial gland. Creates an ultra-hydrophobic barrier over outer contours, keeping the downy insulating layer bone-dry and buoyant.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 鹈鹕皮下还分布着密密麻麻的皮下微型气囊，配合防水羽毛锁住的空气，使得鹈鹕就像一个空心充气漂流艇一样，永远沉不下水！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Pelicans have a network of subcutaneous air sacs beneath their skin, which alongside their oiled feathers makes them as buoyant as inflatable rafts!

bodyParts.nameZh: 隆起龙骨突强劲飞翔胸肌
bodyParts.pinyin: lóng qǐ lóng gǔ tū qiáng jìn fēi xiáng xiōng jī
bodyParts.descZh: 胸骨中央拥有高耸的龙骨突，附着着极其强壮有力的胸大肌与胸小肌，占全身体重近 20%。赋予它们挥动三米多巨大翅膀、连续数天跨越数千公里迁徙的充沛能量。
bodyParts.descEn: Anchored to a pronounced sternal keel, dense pectoral flight muscles account for nearly 20% of total body mass. Provides the sustained propulsion required for trans-continental migratory endurance.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 尽管大白鹈鹕体重可达 10 到 15 公斤，但它们中空的充气骨骼非常轻巧，全部骨头加起来甚至还不到它羽毛重量的一半！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Despite weighing up to 15 kilograms, a pelican's skeleton is pneumatic and hollow—all its bones combined weigh less than half of its total plumage!

bodyParts.nameZh: 繁殖季飘逸冠羽与粉红华彩
bodyParts.pinyin: fán zhí jì piāo yì guān yǔ yǔ fěn hóng huá cǎi
bodyParts.descZh: 每当求偶繁殖季节来临，大白鹈鹕枕部会长出一束飘逸优美的白色小冠羽，额头前端隆起丰满的黄色瘤突，原本纯白的羽衣更会泛起一层迷人的梦幻浅粉色华彩。
bodyParts.descEn: During nuptial courtship, a tufted crest of slender plumes sprouts from the nape, a swollen yellowish knob forms on the forehead, and the body blushes with a delicate romantic pastel pink glow.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这种梦幻的粉红色并不是羽毛本身的天然色素，而是繁殖期尾脂腺分泌出特殊的类胡萝卜素红素，鹈鹕在梳理羽毛时把它当成“粉底腮红”涂遍全身！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The romantic pink flush isn't from feather pigment, but from carotenoid-rich preen secretions that the pelican paints across its body like natural cosmetic blush!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大白鹈鹕捕鱼时下颌展开的“超级大抄网”，容量高达13升，是哪个神奇的身体部位？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which incredible body part expands like an underwater dip-net holding up to 13 liters of water to scoop schools of fish?

options.textZh: 超弹容量捕鱼巨喉囊 (可容纳13升水与鲜鱼)
全蹼推水四趾强力蹼足
繁殖季飘逸冠羽与粉红华彩

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 回答完全正确！大白鹈鹕的巨喉囊弹性惊人，潜入水底一口气能兜住十几升水和鱼，闭上嘴巴把水沥出后就可以大快朵颐了！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Correct! The elastic gular pouch scoops up to 13 liters of water and fish at once, squeezing out the water before swallowing the meal!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请点击听到英文发音对应的身体部位：Totipalmate Four-Toed Paddle Feet (全蹼推水四趾强力蹼足)
quizQuestions.promptEn: Listen and find the correct body part: Totipalmate Four-Toed Paddle Feet

options.textZh: 全蹼推水四趾强力蹼足

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太棒了！大白鹈鹕是罕见的全蹼足，四个脚趾之间全由皮蹼相连，在水面上滑行和踩水时推力巨大，还能在育雏时为小鸟保温！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Awesome! Totipalmate feet have all four toes connected by thick webs, providing massive propulsion on water and warmth for brooding chicks!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 在大白鹈鹕长达四十多厘米的长喙顶端，有什么特殊的结构能死死扣住滑溜挣扎的活鱼防止逃跑？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What special structure at the very tip of the pelican's long bill acts like a barb to firmly hold slippery struggling fish?

options.textZh: 喙端防滑硬角质甲钩 (尖锐下弯坚硬角质钩)
尾脂腺蜡质拒水羽毛装甲

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 太厉害了！长喙顶端的角质甲钩非常坚硬且向下弯曲，在合拢大嘴时像铁钩一样锁住滑溜挣扎的大鱼，万无一失！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Brilliant! The hooked nail tip at the apex of the upper bill locks firmly onto slippery prey, ensuring zero escape!

nicknameZh: 撒哈拉的巨耳小精灵与沙漠散热大师
nicknameEn: The Giant-Eared Desert Sprite of Sahara
length: 体长 24 - 41 cm / 尾长 18 - 31 cm / 体重 0.8 - 1.5 kg (全地球最小狐狸！)
lifespan: 野外约 10 - 12 年 (人工饲养可达 14 年)
food: 沙漠甲虫、蝗虫、小型啮齿类、蜥蜴、鸟蛋与耐旱植物浆果
habitat: 撒哈拉大沙漠与北非干旱沙丘、砾石荒漠
speed: 沙地冲刺可达 32 km/h，腾空跳跃近 1 米
overviewZh: 耳廓狐是生活在撒哈拉大沙漠中的超萌微型狐狸，也是世界上体型最小的犬科动物！它们长着一对长达 15 厘米的巨型招风耳，不仅布满密集毛细血管充当高效的“空调散热器”，还能敏锐隔沙听到地下几米处昆虫甲虫细微的爬行沙沙声。它们毛茸茸的脚底像穿上了隔热雪地靴，能在滚烫如铁板的沙漠沙粒上轻盈飞奔！
overviewEn: The Fennec Fox is the world's smallest canid and an adorable icon of the Sahara Desert! Its oversized 15-cm ears act as natural radiators to disperse extreme daytime heat and amplify the faintest underground footsteps of burrowing insects. Thick woolly fur on their footpads protects them from scorching sand like insulated snow boots, allowing them to sprint effortlessly across blazing dunes.

bodyParts.pinyin: chāo jù xíng sǎn rè léi dá ěr
bodyParts.descZh: 占据体长三分之一的巨型大耳朵，薄薄的皮肤下密布如蛛网般的毛细血管网络，像天然空调机一样把体内热量迅速散发到凉爽夜风中。
bodyParts.descEn: Enormous ears measuring nearly half the body length, packed with a dense network of blood vessels that act like thermal radiators to cool the fox's blood.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 耳廓狐的耳朵极其灵敏，甚至能听到藏在十几厘米深沙子下面小甲虫挥动翅膀的微弱颤音！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A fennec fox's acute hearing can pinpoint a small beetle crawling several inches deep beneath shifting desert sands!

bodyParts.pinyin: gé rè máo róng shā dì xuē
bodyParts.descZh: 脚掌肉垫完全被一层厚实浓密的粗硬软毛包裹覆盖，不仅隔绝高达 70℃ 的滚烫沙粒温度防止烫伤，还能像雪鞋一样增加受力面积防止陷入流沙。
bodyParts.descEn: Paws completely enveloped in dense, bristly fur that insulates against scorching sand up to 70°C and acts like snowshoes to prevent sinking.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 因为脚底全是毛，耳廓狐在沙地上奔跑时完全静音无声，还能不留脚印悄悄接近正在打盹的小猎物！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The dense fur under their paws dampens every sound, allowing the fennec fox to stalk silent as a ghost across the dunes!

bodyParts.nameZh: 沙金色双层防晒保温被
bodyParts.pinyin: shā jīn sè fáng shài bǎo wēn bèi
bodyParts.descZh: 沙金色的厚密绒毛不仅在白天完美反射烈日紫外线并与黄沙融为一体，还能在零下几度的严寒沙漠夜晚像羽绒被一样锁住宝贵体温。
bodyParts.descEn: Thick, silky cream-colored fur that reflects harsh desert sunlight by day and traps body heat during freezing desert winter nights.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 沙漠白天可达 50℃，夜间却能跌破冰点，耳廓狐的双层毛皮就像自带冷暖双控高科技冲锋衣！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Desert temperatures swing from 50°C by day to below freezing at night—their coat handles both extremes with ease!

bodyParts.nameZh: 黑尖毛刷平衡与睡眠面罩尾
bodyParts.descZh: 蓬松浓密的长尾巴末端有一撮黑毛与气味腺，在高速转弯时充当动力学平衡杆，睡觉时卷曲裹在脸上充当防沙防风的天然面罩。
bodyParts.descEn: A bushy long tail with a distinct black tip that functions as a counterbalance during high-speed turns and wraps around the nose like a warm scarf while sleeping.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 耳廓狐睡觉时会把全身缩成一个球，将长尾巴严丝合缝地盖在小黑鼻子和眼睛上，防止沙尘暴呛入口鼻！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When sleeping, a fennec curls into a tight ball and covers its sensitive nose and eyes with its fluffy tail against sandstorms!

bodyParts.pinyin: hēi yǎn xiàn yè shì dà hēi tóng
bodyParts.descZh: 硕大明亮的圆眼睛周围有一圈深黑色泪纹毛发，像戴着天然遮光墨镜一样阻挡沙漠地表的刺眼强光反射，并在黑夜中拥有超强感光力。
bodyParts.descEn: Large, dark luminous eyes rimmed with natural black tear-stripes that reduce blinding glare from bright desert sand while maximizing low-light night vision.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 人类美式橄榄球运动员眼底涂黑油彩来防眩光的做法，与耳廓狐眼睛周围天然的黑眼线完全同理！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The black markings around their eyes inspired the dark grease used by athletes to block sun glare!

bodyParts.nameZh: 极限浓缩节水肾脏系统
bodyParts.pinyin: jié shuǐ shèn zàng xì tǒng
bodyParts.descZh: 特化的高度浓缩肾脏能够将水分损耗降至极限，甚至终生可以不直接喝地表水，完全从捕食的甲虫、浆果和根茎中获取维生水分。
bodyParts.descEn: Specialized kidneys engineered to concentrate urine to extreme levels, allowing the fox to survive indefinitely without drinking free surface water.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 耳廓狐可以数月甚至一生都不用喝一口明水，食物里的水分被身体细胞近乎 100% 榨取利用！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Fennec foxes can go months or their entire lives without drinking liquid water, absorbing all hydration from food!

bodyParts.pinyin: shǎn diàn wā jué qián zhuǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 灵巧短健的前肢配有弯曲坚硬的爪子，遇到猛禽袭击或正午酷暑时，能在短短 10 秒内在沙丘中挖出长达数米深的凉爽避暑地穴。
bodyParts.descEn: Strong curved claws on muscular forelegs capable of digging several feet into soft sand within seconds to escape predators or seek underground cool shelters.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 耳廓狐是天生的地下建筑大师，它们的地下洞穴常常长达十几米，甚至拥有多达十几个互通出入口的豪华地道！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A fennec family burrow can span up to 120 square meters with more than a dozen hidden escape exits!

bodyParts.pinyin: fěn suì yìng jiǎ jiān chǐ
bodyParts.descZh: 尖锐纤巧的犬齿与研磨臼齿，能一口咬碎沙漠黑甲虫坚硬如金属的几丁质外壳，并迅速咀嚼获取高蛋白与体液水分。
