bodyParts.descEn: Delicate yet needle-sharp canines and molars adapted for piercing and crushing the hard chitinous carapaces of desert beetles and scorpions.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 耳廓狐即使被沙漠毒蝎蛰到嘴巴也能抗受住，吃蝎子前会灵巧地一巴掌先拍掉蝎子尾巴上的毒针！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Fennec foxes expertly flick off a scorpion's venomous stinger with one swift paw swipe before crunching down!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 耳廓狐在沙漠酷暑中能够散发全身热量、还能听到沙下昆虫动静的神奇部位是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which iconic body part helps the fennec fox disperse body heat and hear insects under the sand?

options.textZh: 黑尖毛刷平衡与睡眠面罩尾

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 耳廓狐的大耳朵长达 15 厘米，薄薄的皮肤下满布毛细血管，是沙漠生存的天然高效散热空调！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: The huge 15-cm ears act as thermal radiators to dump excess heat and amplify underground sounds of prey!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请找出帮助耳廓狐在 70℃ 滚烫沙地上奔跑而不被烫伤的部位：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Find the body part that protects the fennec fox from 70°C scorching hot sand:

options.textZh: 沙金色双层防晒保温被

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 耳廓狐脚掌肉垫密布厚厚的茸毛，宛如穿上了隔热雪鞋，能轻松踩在高温沙地上！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Dense woolly fur completely encloses their footpads, acting like thermal boots over burning hot sand!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 耳廓狐在沙尘暴或寒冷冬夜睡觉时，用来挡在鼻尖防沙御寒的部位是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which part does the fennec fox wrap around its face to block cold winds and sandstorms during sleep?

options.textZh: 黑尖毛刷平衡与睡眠面罩尾

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 耳廓狐睡觉时会把蓬松的尾巴紧密包裹在面部，像柔软保暖的面罩一样挡住沙尘！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Its bushy tail wraps snugly over its snout and eyes, creating a natural dust filter and blanket!

nicknameZh: 荒漠地下的活体琥珀糖罐与储蜜大师
nicknameEn: The Living Amber Honey Casks of the Desert
length: 普通工蚁约 6 - 10 mm / 充蜜工蚁腹部直径可达 15 mm (相当于葡萄大小！)
lifespan: 普通工蚁几个月 / 充蜜贮蜜蚁可在地下静止存活数年
food: 植物花蜜、仙人掌汁液、蚜虫分泌蜜露与昆虫体液
habitat: 北美西南部与澳大利亚干旱灌木沙漠、地下数十米深巢穴
speed: 普通工蚁地面穿行敏捷 / 充蜜蚁几乎静止倒挂无法移动
overviewZh: 蜜罐蚁是干旱荒漠中进化出的最不可思议的昆虫奇迹！为了应对沙漠常年数月的干旱无花季节，蚁群中有一类特殊的“贮蜜蚁（Repletes）”。它们用自己的腹部作为活体储水储糖罐，不断吞咽同伴采集来的金色花蜜，腹部膨胀如同一颗颗晶莹剔透的金色琥珀葡萄！它们长年累月倒挂在地下清凉巢顶，在旱季用嘴对嘴反哺整个蚁巢。
overviewEn: Honeypot ants are one of nature's most astounding adaptations to extreme arid droughts! Specialized worker ants known as 'repletes' sacrifice their mobility to serve as living storage tanks. Gorging on floral nectar and honeydew gathered after rare desert rains, their abdomens swell to the size of translucent golden grapes, hanging suspended from underground ceilings to nourish the colony through harsh dry months.

bodyParts.descZh: 柔软富有弹性的腹部几丁质腹板被撑开，内部嗉囊膨胀成葡萄大小的球体，里面储存着高浓度纯天然花蜜，晶莹透亮闪耀着琥珀金光。
bodyParts.descEn: The intersegmental membrane stretches enormously, expanding the abdomen into a grape-sized amber orb packed with liquid golden nectar.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 一只完全充蜜的蜜罐蚁腹部可以装下相当于自身体重 8 倍的花蜜水，人类如果按此比例，相当于肚子里装了近半吨水！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A fully gorged replete holds up to 8 times its body weight in honey—the human equivalent of drinking half a ton of liquid!

bodyParts.descZh: 足末端的微型双钩爪与粘附吸盘（褥盘），能牢牢锁扣在地穴粗糙的泥土岩顶上，长年累月承受数十倍于自身体重的蜜囊重力下垂而不脱落。
bodyParts.descEn: Specialized dual curved hooks and sticky arolium pads on the feet that lock securely onto vault ceilings, supporting heavy nectar casks for years.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 充蜜蚁如果不慎掉下地穴天花板，腹部有可能会被摔破，其他工蚁会立刻赶来小心翼翼把洒出来的蜜汁舔食干净！
bodyParts.funFactEn: If a replete accidentally falls from the ceiling, its delicate abdomen might burst, and nurse ants will immediately lick up every drop!

bodyParts.pinyin: hù wèi jiē wěn kǒu qì
bodyParts.descZh: 精巧灵活的下颚与舌状结构，当口渴的工蚁用触角轻触它的头部时，蜜罐蚁会收缩腹部肌肉将清甜的水蜜反吐出一滴，嘴对嘴喂给饥渴的同伴。
bodyParts.descEn: Mouthparts calibrated for mouth-to-mouth regurgitation (trophallaxis), releasing tiny golden droplets of sweet liquid when stimulated by antenna taps.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 工蚁向蜜罐蚁“借蜜喝”有一套固定的摩斯密码：用触角有节奏地轻敲蜜罐蚁嘴唇，蜜罐蚁就会乖乖吐出一滴美味花蜜！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Workers use an antenna secret code: drumming rhythmically on the replete's face prompts it to dispense a single droplet of honey!

bodyParts.descZh: 腹部原本连成一体的黑色坚硬几丁质背板，在膨胀时被弹性膜撑开，像一块块黑色小岛浮在半透明金色蜜糖海洋上，极具结构美感。
bodyParts.descEn: Rigid black armor segments (tergites) separated and floating like tiny dark islands across the luminous, transparent membrane of the swollen crop.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 透过这层薄薄的半透明蜜囊腹壁，甚至能在光照下清晰看到腹腔内部的搏动微血管和神经索！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The stretched abdominal wall is so transparent that internal heart pulses can be observed under a microscope!

bodyParts.nameZh: 全天候化学触角传感器
bodyParts.pinyin: huà xué chù jiǎo gǎn yīng
bodyParts.descZh: 膝状弯曲的双触角覆盖数万个化学感受器和触觉细毛，在完全漆黑的地下深处实时感知空气湿度、二氧化碳浓度及同巢工蚁的信息素气味。
bodyParts.descEn: Flexible, elbowed antennae equipped with thousands of olfactory receptors to read pheromone signals, moisture levels, and troop status in pitch-dark nests.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 每只蜜罐蚁通过触角碰一碰，就能在 0.1 秒内辨别对方是不是同巢的“家人”，外来侵略者会被立刻识破！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A single tap of their antennae tells an ant within 0.1 seconds if a newcomer is a nestmate or a hostile intruder!

bodyParts.pinyin: nài mó jù chǐ dà è
bodyParts.descZh: 强有力的剪刀状大颚边缘长有硬质锋利锯齿，负责在地表坚硬板结的沙土地上凿出深达两米的垂直通道，将地下巢室维持在 24℃ 恒温。
bodyParts.descEn: Pincer-like powerful jaws lined with serrated teeth, engineered to chew through concrete-hard desert caliche to build subterranean chambers 2 meters deep.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 虽然地表夏季气温高达 45℃，但在蜜罐蚁两米深的地下密室里，温度常年恒定在凉爽宜人的 22℃ 到 25℃！
bodyParts.funFactEn: While the desert surface bakes at 45°C, their underground honey vaults stay at a stable, cool 24°C all year round!

bodyParts.descZh: 连接头部与腹部的坚固胸节，内部包裹着强韧的横纹肌束，支撑六足强健活动，即便腹部挂载沉重蜜罐，也能维持身体重心平衡。
bodyParts.descEn: The armored, narrow central body segment packing dense striated muscle fibers that anchor six walking legs and support the weight of the abdomen.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜜罐蚁的胸部如同悬臂吊车的底座，能承受拉扯自身数百倍的受力强度！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The chitinous thorax behaves like an industrial crane truss, withstanding enormous tensile stresses relative to its micro size!

bodyParts.descZh: 由数百只六边形小眼组成的半球形复眼，能够感应天空中的偏振光模式，即便在毫无地标的漫漫沙丘上，也能精准导航返回蚁穴入口。
bodyParts.descEn: Hemispherical compound eyes sensitive to ultraviolet and polarized sunlight patterns, functioning like an onboard compass across barren dunes.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 采集花蜜的工蚁外出几百米觅食，凭借眼中的偏振光太阳罗盘，能直线不差分毫地直接走回地下洞口！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Foraging workers can travel hundreds of meters and march back to their hidden nest entrance in an exact straight line using celestial polarization!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 蜜罐蚁中特殊的“贮蜜蚁”用来像活体糖罐一样储存大量花蜜的部位是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which body part swells into a living golden grape to store nectar for the colony?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 贮蜜蚁的腹部弹性极强，可以膨胀成正常体型数倍的半透明金黄大蜜罐！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: The replete's abdominal crop expands dramatically into an amber reservoir of sweet nectar!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请找出帮助沉重的蜜罐蚁常年倒挂在地下洞顶而不掉落的部位：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Find the specialized claws that allow heavy honeypot ants to hang from ceilings without falling:

options.textZh: 全天候化学触角传感器

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 足末端的双弯钩和粘附垫像微型攀岩锁扣，让它能年复一年挂在地下洞顶！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Curved tarsal claws and adhesive pads anchor the replete securely to rough chamber ceilings for years!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 工蚁在旱季口渴时，与蜜罐蚁嘴对嘴反哺获取甜美花蜜依靠的是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which mouthparts are used in mouth-to-mouth nectar sharing (trophallaxis)?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 蜜罐蚁通过嘴对嘴（交哺行为）将腹中的花蜜反吐出一滴，滋养整个缺水少食的蚁群！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Trophallaxis allows the replete to regurgitate micro-droplets of nectar to feed thirsty worker ants!

nicknameZh: 荒漠黑夜的荧光夜行霸主与毒刺守卫
nicknameEn: The Fluorescent Night Titan of the Dunes
length: 体长 14 - 17 cm (北美洲体型最大的蝎子！)
lifespan: 野外约 7 - 10 年，圈养可达 15 年以上
food: 沙漠甲虫、蟋蟀、蜘蛛、其他蝎子、甚至小型沙漠蜥蜴与幼蛇
habitat: 美国西南部与墨西哥索诺拉大沙漠的干旱砂石地带
speed: 螯肢钳击闪电瞬发，尾刺刺杀仅需 0.15 秒
overviewZh: 沙漠毛蝎是北美洲体型最庞大、最霸气的节肢动物！它的身上长满密密麻麻的感觉刚毛，能够像地震仪一样感知周围几米内昆虫走动引起的微小沙粒震动。更神奇的是，它的角质甲壳含有特殊的荧光化合物，在紫外线下会发出惊艳全场的蓝绿色荧光！尾部翘起一柄尖锐的毒刺，配合一对强有力的巨螯，是沙漠黑夜中令昆虫闻风丧胆的顶级猎手。
overviewEn: The Giant Desert Hairy Scorpion is the largest scorpion species in North America! Covered in specialized sensory brown hairs that register ground micro-vibrations like biological seismographs, it detects approaching prey in pitch blackness. Mysteriously, its hard chitinous exoskeleton glows brilliant neon cyan-green under ultraviolet light. Armed with crushing pincers and a curved venomous stinger, it commands the nocturnal desert sands.

bodyParts.pinyin: wěi jié dǎo gōu dú cī
bodyParts.descZh: 后腹部末端膨大的球状毒囊连着尖锐弯曲的角质毒针，内部配有一对毒腺，能够在 0.15 秒内如离弦之箭般高高刺入猎物体内注入神经麻痹毒素。
bodyParts.descEn: A bulbous telson housing paired venom glands tipped with a razor-sharp curved needle, delivering defensive neurotoxins in lightning strikes under 0.15s.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 虽然长相极其吓人，但沙漠毛蝎的毒性对人类其实并不致命，被蜇后的感觉大致相当于被大黄蜂蛰了一下！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Despite its formidable size, its venom is mild to humans—comparable to a painful honeybee sting!

bodyParts.pinyin: qián jiǎ qiáng lì dà áo
bodyParts.descZh: 特化的巨大须肢螯爪，表面覆盖致密的耐磨齿突和刚毛，肌肉力量极其强大，绝大部分猎物被它一钳夹住便直接粉碎，甚至无需动用尾刺。
bodyParts.descEn: Muscular, robust raptorial pedipalp claws armed with serrated inner margins, exerting crushing torque that overpowers prey without needing venom.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 沙漠毛蝎通常很节省毒液，对付体型较小的甲虫，只用大铁钳一夹就把甲虫夹扁了，根本舍不得浪费一滴宝贵毒汁！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Scorpions are thrifty with venom; for small prey, they crush it with brute pincer strength alone to save toxins!

bodyParts.descZh: 身体和钳腿上密布着褐红色的感觉刚毛，底部连着极度敏感的神经感受器，能精确测定空气微弱气流与沙子表面一微米的细小颤动方向。
bodyParts.descEn: Dense, hair-like setae and trichobothria on legs and pincers that register minute soil soundwaves and air currents from yards away.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这就是它叫“毛蝎”的原因！这些细毛就像给全身安装了成百上千个微型地震仪，不用眼睛看也知道猎物在哪！
bodyParts.funFactEn: That is why it is called the 'hairy' scorpion! Its setae function as a field of biological seismographs!

bodyParts.nameZh: 紫外荧光神秘角质甲壳
bodyParts.pinyin: zǐ wài yíng guāng jiǎ qiào
bodyParts.descZh: 外骨骼的最外层角质透明层中含有β-咔啉等有机荧光复合物。当暴露在紫外光（黑光灯）下时，全身会激发出令人惊叹的霓虹亮绿蓝光。
bodyParts.descEn: Exoskeleton saturated with beta-carboline compounds that glow vibrant neon cyan-green under ultraviolet wavelengths in the dark.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 科学家用紫外线手电筒能在漆黑沙漠中一眼找到数十米外发光的蝎子！哪怕蝎子化石经过上千万年，依然能在紫外光下发光！
bodyParts.funFactEn: UV flashlights light up scorpions like neon signs in desert darkness; even million-year-old scorpion fossils still fluoresce!

bodyParts.nameZh: 腹底栉状器化学触觉排梳
bodyParts.descZh: 腹部正下方生有一对独特的羽状梳形器官（栉状器），贴近地面扫动，专门用来“品尝”地表的化学信息、辨识异性气味并测量沙粒粗细。
bodyParts.descEn: Paired, comb-like sensory organs on the belly swept across the substrate to chemically sample pheromones and soil texture.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 栉状器就像蝎子长在肚皮上的“鼻子加舌头”，雄蝎子正是依靠这对小梳子追踪雌蝎子留下的荷尔蒙足迹找到伴侣！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Pectines act like chemical tongues on their belly, allowing males to track female scent trails across vast sand plains!

bodyParts.nameZh: 五节高弯曲后腹部尾铠
bodyParts.pinyin: wǔ jié hòu fù wěi kǎi
bodyParts.descZh: 通常被称为“尾巴”的五节坚硬后腹部，由厚实的环状几丁质甲壳节节相扣，强韧的内部肌腱让它能以极高自由度向前翻卷到头部前方实施穿刺。
bodyParts.descEn: Five thick, cylindrical chitinous abdominal segments interconnected by flexible joints, enabling high-arc curling over the head to strike.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蝎子的这截结构在解剖学上不是真正的尾巴，而是它延长的腹部，消化道贯穿其中直到毒刺基部！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Anatomically, a scorpion's 'tail' is actually an elongated posterior abdomen, with its digestive tract running through it!

bodyParts.nameZh: 中央与侧位全景复眼簇
bodyParts.pinyin: zhōng yāng cè wèi dān yǎn
bodyParts.descZh: 头胸部正中央有一对大单眼，两侧各分布着 3 到 5 对侧单眼。虽然成像分辨率不高，但对光线强弱和地平线星光具有超敏感应度。
bodyParts.descEn: A pair of central median eyes flanked by clusters of smaller lateral ocelli that detect subtle changes in moonlight and shadow overhead.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 沙漠毛蝎即便在只有星光的极暗黑夜里，也能凭借这些敏锐的单眼感知上方猫头鹰飞过的微弱暗影！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Even under faint starlight, their eyes detect the fleeting shadow of a predatory owl banking overhead!

bodyParts.descZh: 四对修长结实的步行足末端配有微型抓钩爪，能够在松散流动的沙丘斜坡上稳步爬行，并在沙地中向后快速刨沙挖掘两米深的安全斜洞。
bodyParts.descEn: Four pairs of jointed legs ending in clawed tarsi that provide firm traction on shifting dunes and dig spiraling burrows up to 2.5 meters deep.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 沙漠毛蝎是挖掘地穴的超级冠军，它挖的洞穴呈 45 度角斜向深处，最深可达两米半直到触及潮湿的泥土层！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Their spiraling burrows descend at a 45-degree angle, burrowing down over 2 meters until they hit cool, moist earth!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 在紫外线黑光灯照射下，沙漠毛蝎会发出亮绿蓝荧光的部位是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which part of the desert hairy scorpion glows brilliant neon green-blue under UV light?

options.textZh: 紫外荧光神秘角质甲壳

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 沙漠毛蝎的外骨骼中含有荧光有机复合物，在紫光照射下会发出惊艳的霓虹光泽！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Fluorescent chemicals inside its chitin cuticle glow bright neon green-cyan under ultraviolet rays!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请找出帮助沙漠毛蝎在完全看不见的漆黑夜里感知猎物脚步微震的部位：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Find the specialized hairs that detect tiny footsteps of prey through sand vibrations:

options.textZh: 腹底栉状器化学触觉排梳

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 身躯和螯肢上的细微刚毛连着神经，像微型地震仪一样能感应沙粒的极微弱振动！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Trichobothria hairs act as seismic sensors, pinpointing ground vibrations caused by passing insects!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 沙漠毛蝎贴在地面上像梳子一样嗅探化学气味和荷尔蒙的腹部器官是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which comb-like ventral organ sweeps the ground to sense chemical pheromones?

options.textZh: 腹底栉状器化学触觉排梳
五节高弯曲后腹部尾铠

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 栉状器长在肚皮下方，像小梳子一样贴地扫视，专门收集地面化学信息！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Pectines under the abdomen function as chemical sensors to track pheromones and soil moisture!

nicknameZh: 纳米布沙丘的透明滑雪小精灵与舔眼饮水大师
nicknameEn: The Translucent Sand-Skater of the Namib
length: 体长 10 - 13 cm / 体重约 10 克 (轻巧如羽毛)
lifespan: 野外约 5 - 8 年，人工环境可达 10 年
food: 沙漠白蚁、甲虫幼虫、蟋蟀与小型夜行性蜘蛛
habitat: 西南非纳米布大沙漠由大西洋晨雾滋润的高耸流动沙丘
speed: 流沙上滑雪般奔跑，遇到危险迅速钻进松散沙丘深处
overviewZh: 纳米布蹼足壁虎是地球最古老沙漠——纳米布沙漠中的奇迹生灵！它通体呈现晶莹剔透的半透明粉白沙色，甚至能隐约透过皮肤看到腹内器官。它没有可以闭合的眼睑，大眼睛常年睁着，每天清晨它会用自己柔软细长的粉红色大舌头，像雨刷器一样优雅地舔舐凝结在大眼球上的大西洋晨雾露珠来喝水解渴！四只脚趾间长有宽阔的透明皮蹼，让它在松软的流沙上奔跑如履平地，被称为沙海中的“滑雪小超人”。
overviewEn: The Namib Web-Footed Gecko is a wonder of nature in the world's oldest desert! Almost ethereal with translucent salmon-pink skin, its internal organs are visible through its abdomen. Possessing no movable eyelids, it uses its long, nimble pink tongue like a windshield wiper to lick condensed ocean fog droplets directly from its vast spherical eyes to drink! Its fully webbed feet act like snowshoes, allowing it to skate effortlessly across loose desert dunes.

bodyParts.nameZh: 流沙滑雪宽阔透明皮蹼足
bodyParts.pinyin: kuān kuò tòu míng pǔ zú
bodyParts.descZh: 五个脚趾之间连接着宽大的半透明柔软皮蹼，极大地增加了与沙面的接触面积，不仅在滚烫松散的沙坡上奔跑不陷沙，还能像小铲子一样高速刨沙遁地。
bodyParts.descEn: Extensive translucent skin webbing between all five digits acts like sandshoes to distribute body weight, allowing swift sprinting across steep shifting dunes.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 正是因为这双奇特的蹼足，它能在人类踩一脚就滑落坍塌的 45 度陡峭沙丘斜坡上健步如飞！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Thanks to its webbed feet, it can sprint up a 45-degree sand dune face that would collapse under human footsteps!

bodyParts.nameZh: 凝露擦拭粉红灵巧长舌
bodyParts.descZh: 柔软而富有弹性的粉红色长舌头，能够轻巧地翻折向上舔到整个硕大的眼球表面，把凝结在角膜透明鳞片上的晨雾微小水珠一滴不落地卷入嘴中饮用。
bodyParts.descEn: A long, agile pink tongue that sweeps cleanly across the broad spherical eye to lap up droplets of marine fog that condense during cool dawn breezes.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 纳米布沙漠一年下的雨少得可怜，但大西洋每天清晨会吹来海雾，蹼足壁虎把自己的大眼球当成了最棒的“集水天平”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: In a rainless desert, Atlantic fog condenses on its giant eyes, turning them into natural morning water collectors!

bodyParts.nameZh: 大视界透明护目镜无睑眼
bodyParts.nameEn: Eyelidless Eyes with Clear Spectacle Scales
bodyParts.pinyin: tòu míng hù mù jìng yǎn
bodyParts.descZh: 一双硕大突出的深褐色圆眼，没有可以眨动的眼皮，而是被一层像透明手表表蒙一样的透明角质特化鳞片永久覆盖保护，阻挡狂风中的飞沙刮蹭。
bodyParts.descEn: Huge, lidless dark eyes permanently protected by a transparent immovable scale called a 'spectacle', keeping cornea free from abrasions during sand gusts.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 每次蜕皮时，壁虎连眼睛外面这层透明“护目镜”也会一起脱落换新，永远保持镜片一尘不染！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When shedding, the gecko also sheds the clear spectacle scale over its eyes, getting a brand-new pristine 'windshield'!

bodyParts.nameZh: 半透明发光鲑粉色伪装皮肤
bodyParts.pinyin: bàn tòu míng fěn sè pí fū
bodyParts.descZh: 极度娇嫩的半透明皮肤呈现柔和的鲑鱼粉与浅沙黄色，几乎缺少深色黑色素，光线能够穿透皮肤边缘，在沙漠强光下产生微弱的天然荧光反光。
bodyParts.descEn: Silky, delicate translucent skin with pale salmon and cream hues that blends seamlessly against coastal dunes, with subtle bioluminescent sheen.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 如果在暗处从壁虎身体一侧打手电筒，光线甚至能穿过它的头骨从另一只耳朵里透出来！
bodyParts.funFactEn: If you shine a flashlight into one ear canal in the dark, light travels straight through and shines out the other ear!

bodyParts.descZh: 粗短圆润的肉质尾巴储存着维系生命的脂肪与水分储备，不仅在滑沙时提供动力平衡，遇到天敌捕咬时还能主动断尾逃生，并在几个月内重新长出。
bodyParts.descEn: A plump, fleshy tail that stores emergency fat and moisture. It detaches voluntarily (autotomy) to distract predators, fully regenerating within months.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 断掉的小尾巴在沙地上还能自己扭动乱跳好几分钟，把捕食者的注意力吸引过去，壁虎趁机溜之大吉！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A detached tail wriggles vigorously on the sand for minutes, keeping the predator busy while the gecko slips away!

bodyParts.pinyin: xiē xíng zuān shā bí wěn
bodyParts.descZh: 头部扁平略呈流线型楔状，闭合紧密的唇鳞和微型鼻孔瓣膜能够防止细微沙尘灌入呼吸道，让它能像潜水艇潜水一样瞬间钻入沙层下躲避正午暴晒。
bodyParts.descEn: A blunt, streamlined wedge-like snout with muscular nostril flaps that seal tight, allowing rapid sub-sand swimming to escape blazing heat.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 遇到盘旋的沙漠老鹰时，壁虎一低头就能在 2 秒钟内像跳进水里一样潜入沙海，沙面只留下一圈微小的涟漪！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When threatened, it dives headfirst into loose sand in two seconds, disappearing beneath the surface like a dolphin into water!

bodyParts.descZh: 背部排列着微细光滑的圆形颗粒状鳞片，具有极佳的疏水疏沙特性，细微沙粒不会黏附在皮肤表面，减少在地下穿行时的摩擦阻力。
bodyParts.descEn: Tiny, non-overlapping bead-like scales with hydrophobic properties that repel sticky grains of sand and reduce drag during underground burrowing.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这种微观鳞片结构是天然的防刮磨砂护甲，即使整天在粗粝沙粒中钻来钻去，皮肤也丝毫不受磨损！
bodyParts.funFactEn: These microscopic bead scales resist abrasion so well that rubbing against quartz sand crystals never scratches their skin!

bodyParts.descZh: 眼睛后方清晰可见的无遮挡大鼓膜，能够精确接收黑夜中沙漠白蚁咬噬干草根和鸣蟋蟀发出的高频超细微声波，定位捕食目标。
bodyParts.descEn: Prominent, exposed ear openings leading to sensitive eardrums calibrated to hear the faint clicks of desert termites chewing underground roots.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 夜间只要周围有只小蟋蟀在沙子上迈出一步，壁虎就能通过这对大耳朵在数米之外精准测定方向！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The gecko's large eardrums can detect the footsteps of a single tiny cricket crawling over quartz sand grains meters away!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 纳米布蹼足壁虎清晨用来舔舐大眼球上凝结的雾水解渴的神奇器官是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which agile organ does the web-footed gecko use to lick morning fog water from its eyes?

options.textZh: 凝露擦拭粉红灵巧长舌
流沙滑雪宽阔透明皮蹼足

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 壁虎用长长的粉红舌头舔舐大眼球上凝结的海雾水滴，这是它在无雨沙漠中的关键饮水来源！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Its long pink tongue licks Atlantic fog droplets straight from its vast cornea to stay hydrated!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请找出帮助纳米布壁虎在松散陡峭的流动沙丘上滑雪般奔跑而不陷沙的部位：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Find the wide, translucent body part that acts like snowshoes across loose sand:

options.textZh: 流沙滑雪宽阔透明皮蹼足
半透明发光鲑粉色伪装皮肤

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 五个脚趾之间的透明皮蹼增大了接触面积，像沙地雪鞋一样让它在流沙上飞奔！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Broad webbing between toes distributes weight like sandshoes, preventing the gecko from sinking into loose dunes!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 纳米布蹼足壁虎没有能闭合的眼睑，保护大眼睛不受风沙刮擦的透明结构是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: What transparent protective shield covers the gecko's eyes since it has no movable eyelids?

options.textZh: 大视界透明护目镜无睑眼
options.textEn: Eyelidless Eyes with Clear Spectacle Scales

options.textZh: 凝露擦拭粉红灵巧长舌

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 它的大眼睛被一层固定的透明护目镜鳞片（眼镜鳞）永久覆盖，每次蜕皮还会一起更新！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: A clear, immovable scale called a spectacle acts like a permanent safety shield over the eye!

nicknameZh: 荒漠夜行防刺小勇士与毒液免疫大师
nicknameEn: The Desert Spiny Guardian & Venom-Immune Champion
length: 体长 12 - 27 cm / 体重 250 - 500 克 / 大耳朵长达 4 - 5 cm
lifespan: 野外约 5 - 7 年，圈养可达 8 年以上
food: 沙漠毒蝎、蜈蚣、甲虫、小型蜥蜴、鸟蛋与掉落的野果
habitat: 中亚与中东半干旱荒漠、干草原与砾石绿洲边缘
speed: 四肢比普通刺猬修长，小跑速度可达 10 km/h
overviewZh: 大耳猬是生活在中东与中亚荒漠中的“超级小勇士”！它的标志性特征是一对占头部比例极大的直立大耳朵，不仅能高效散热，还能隔着沙层捕捉甲虫爬行的沙沙声。大耳猬拥有令人惊叹的生物学超能力 —— 它对沙漠毒蛇（如锯鳞蝰）和剧毒蝎子的毒液具有极强的天然免疫力，即使被毒蝎蛰咬多次也安然无恙！遇到强敌时，它会瞬间把全身蜷缩成带刺的铁球，让捕食者无从下口。
overviewEn: The Long-Eared Hedgehog is a spiny desert superhero! Distinctive for its prominent upright ears that radiate body heat and detect the subtle scurrying of nocturnal beetles, it is far more agile than ordinary hedgehogs. Incredibly, it possesses natural physiological resistance to deadly desert viper and scorpion venoms—up to 40 times higher than other mammals! When threatened, it contracts into a fortress-like ball of sharp defensive quills.

bodyParts.nameZh: 直立高耸散热雷达大耳
bodyParts.pinyin: zhí lì sàn rè dà ěr
bodyParts.descZh: 大耳朵长度可达头长的一半以上，外侧覆盖稀疏细毛，内侧密布血管网，既能在炎热干旱的沙漠夜晚快速散发体内余温，又能超远距离锁定猎物声波。
bodyParts.descEn: Oversized upright ears measuring up to 5 cm long, packed with blood vessels that radiate body heat into night air and pinpoint faint underground sounds.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 普通欧洲刺猬的耳朵很小常藏在毛里，而大耳猬的耳朵足足有身体比例的数倍大，是荒漠高温环境造就的进化杰作！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike tiny-eared woodland hedgehogs, the desert hedgehog's ears are massive—an evolutionary marvel for desert cooling!

bodyParts.pinyin: kōng xīn fáng yù jí cì
bodyParts.descZh: 背部覆盖着数千根米黄与暗褐色相间的坚硬短刺。棘刺内部是蜂窝中空结构，极度轻便且富有弹性，既能刺伤敌人，从高处跌落时还能充当避震气垫。
bodyParts.descEn: Thousands of stiff, yellowish-brown keratin quills with spongy honeycomb interiors, providing impenetrable armor and shock-absorbing impact cushioning.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大耳猬的刺不会像豪猪那样射出来，每根刺基部都连着独立的小肌肉，受到惊吓时全身硬刺会瞬间向四面八方齐齐竖立！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Hedgehog spines don't detach like porcupine quills; individual arrector muscles erect thousands of sharp quills in an instant!

bodyParts.nameZh: 毒液天然中和免疫血清
bodyParts.pinyin: dú yè miǎn yì xuè qīng
bodyParts.descZh: 体内血液中含有天然抗毒蛋白，能够高效结合并中和剧毒蝎毒和致命蝰蛇毒素中的出血性神经性蛋白质，抗毒能力是普通哺乳动物的 40 倍以上。
bodyParts.descEn: Blood serum packed with natural anti-venom globulin proteins that neutralize lethal hemorrhagic viper venom and neurotoxic scorpion stings.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大耳猬抓到毒蝎子后，常常连毒针带尾巴一口嚼碎吃下去，就像吃嘎嘣脆的烤薯片一样，完全不惧剧毒！
bodyParts.funFactEn: They crunch whole scorpions—stinger and all—like crispy potato chips, completely immune to the venomous payload!

bodyParts.descZh: 背部边缘有一条强韧的环状皮下肌肉（环肌），遇到狼或猛禽袭击时能在 0.2 秒内把软肚子、四肢和脸全部收紧锁在背刺内部，变成无懈可击的带刺保龄球。
bodyParts.descEn: A powerful drawstring-like circular muscle (orbicularis) along the skin's edge that contracts in 0.2s, locking vulnerable belly and head inside a spiny sphere.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 蜷成刺球后的大耳猬外表没有任何抓握缝隙，即便是饥饿的野狼想要张嘴咬它，也只会被扎得满嘴是血哀嚎离去！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Once rolled tight, there are zero gaps; any wolf trying to bite it gets a mouth full of painful puncture wounds!

bodyParts.descZh: 与森林刺猬短腿不同，大耳猬长着修长的四肢，腹部离开地面较高，不仅奔跑速度更快更敏捷，还能防止腹部被白天沙漠沙石烫伤。
bodyParts.descEn: Noticeably longer, lighter legs than European hedgehogs, elevating the soft belly above hot sand and providing agile 10 km/h cruising speed.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大耳猬遇到危险不一定只当缩头乌龟，如果发现打不过敌人，它修长的小腿能以惊人的速度在灌木丛里飞奔逃跑！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike clumsy woodland cousins, long-eared hedgehogs often choose flight over fight, sprinting into dense thorny scrub at surprising speeds!

bodyParts.nameZh: 探穴灵敏湿润鼻吻与触须
bodyParts.pinyin: líng mǐn bí wěn chù xū
bodyParts.descZh: 尖锐如圆锥的黑色小鼻子常年保持湿润，嘴边密布长长的触须，能够深入沙土缝隙和岩石裂痕嗅探隐藏昆虫的微量气味分子。
bodyParts.descEn: A slender cone-shaped dark muzzle equipped with sensitive vibrissae (whiskers), designed to probe into rock crevices and detect hidden beetles.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大耳猬有一种神奇的“自我涂油（self-anointing）”行为：吃完有强烈刺激性气味的植物或蟾蜍后，会把口水泡沫吐在自己背部的刺上！
bodyParts.funFactEn: They exhibit 'self-anointing': frothing saliva after tasting pungent bugs and smearing it over their spines for extra protection!

bodyParts.descZh: 口腔内有 36 颗锋利的牙齿，前门齿向前突出如钳子，臼齿带有尖锐的多突起齿尖，能轻易咬穿蜈蚣和硬甲虫的几丁质外壳。
bodyParts.descEn: A full set of 36 sharp teeth with forward-projecting incisors and pointed premolars that shear cleanly through tough insect exoskeletons.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大耳猬每天晚上要吃掉相当于自身体重三分之一的各种昆虫，是荒漠绿洲里保护植物庄稼的除害小能手！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A single hedgehog eats up to a third of its body weight in desert pests every night, protecting oasis crops!

bodyParts.descZh: 与背部硬刺形成鲜明反差，它的腹部和面部覆盖着极度柔软细腻的纯白色绒毛，在夜晚降温时贴着地面保温，触感如丝绸般温润。
bodyParts.descEn: In stark contrast to its prickly armor, its throat and belly are lined with ultra-soft, silky cream-white down that preserves core warmth.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 虽然背上的刺扎人，但大耳猬肚皮上的绒毛比刚出生的小羊羔毛还要柔软亲肤！
bodyParts.funFactEn: While its back is an impenetrable pincushion, its belly fur is softer than newborn lamb's fleece!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大耳猬在荒漠中既能散发体内多余热量、又能听见沙下昆虫走动的标志性部位是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Which signature body part helps the long-eared hedgehog radiate excess heat and hear beetles?

options.textZh: 直立高耸散热雷达大耳

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 大耳朵长达 4-5 厘米，血管密集，是荒漠生活不可或缺的天然散热雷达！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Its 5-cm ears act as thermal air-conditioners and acoustic radar dishes to locate food!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 请找出大耳猬遇到危险时在 0.2 秒内把全身收拢成坚硬刺球依靠的肌肉：
quizQuestions.promptEn: Find the circular muscle that locks the hedgehog into an impenetrable spiny ball:

options.textZh: 探穴灵敏湿润鼻吻与触须

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 皮下的环形肌肉收紧后，像扎紧布口袋一样把柔软的腹部完全锁在刺甲内部！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: The drawstring-like orbicularis muscle contracts in 0.2s, concealing head and belly completely inside sharp quills!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大耳猬即使吃下剧毒蝎子也不会中毒死亡，依靠的是它体内的神奇能力：
quizQuestions.promptEn: What extraordinary internal defense allows the hedgehog to eat venomous scorpions unharmed?

options.textZh: 毒液天然中和免疫血清
探穴灵敏湿润鼻吻与触须

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 大耳猬血液中富含抗毒蛋白，抗毒能力是普通动物的 40 倍，能中和蝎毒和毒蛇毒液！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Its blood serum contains natural anti-venom proteins that neutralize deadly scorpion and viper toxins!

nicknameZh: 红沙漠的带刺微型装甲龙与毛细吸水奇迹
nicknameEn: The Spiky Red Sand Dragon & Capillary Water Wizard
lifespan: 野外可存活 15 - 20 年
food: 专吃黑头蚁等微型蚁类，一顿可吞食 1000 - 3000 只小蚂蚁
habitat: 澳大利亚中部红色沙质大荒漠与刺槐自流盆地
speed: 慢速摇摆晃动步态，遇险停滞拟态装死
overviewZh: 刺角魔蜥是生活在澳大利亚红色沙漠中的神奇爬行动物！虽然全身披满坚硬锋利的棘刺、宛如来自远古时代的迷你恐龙，但它们实际上性情极其温和，专门以小蚂蚁为食。它们最令人惊叹的超能力是全身皮肤布满微米级毛细管吸水网络，哪怕只是把脚踩在湿润的泥沙或朝露中，水滴就会自动逆着重力“爬”向嘴边，无需低头就能畅饮！
overviewEn: The Thorny Devil is an extraordinary reptile native to Australia's vast red sand deserts! Despite its fearsome armor of sharp conical spines resembling a miniature prehistoric dragon, it is a completely harmless creature that feeds exclusively on tiny ants. Its most astonishing superpower is a network of microscopic capillary grooves running between its scales: simply standing in morning dew or moist sand causes water to be drawn upward against gravity directly into its mouth!

bodyParts.pinyin: jǐng bèi ròu zhì jiǎ tóu jí tū
bodyParts.descZh: 脖子后方长着一个凸起的带刺大肉瘤。遇险时它会低下真正的头部藏在前肢之间，将肉瘤竖起伪装成假头，引诱天敌咬错目标。
bodyParts.descEn: A prominent spiny knob on the nape of its neck. When threatened, the lizard ducks its real head between its front paws, offering the spiky decoy to predators.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 假头不仅长满倒刺让捕食者难以下咽，而且即使被咬伤也不会伤及大脑等关键器官！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The false head is covered in tough prickles; even if a predator attacks it, the lizard's vital brain remains safely protected below!

bodyParts.nameZh: 毛细微米汲水吸管沟纹
bodyParts.pinyin: máo xì wēi mǐ jí shuǐ gōu wén
bodyParts.descZh: 鳞片间密布互通的微观凹槽网络，利用强大的毛细作用力将身体任何部位接触到的水分自动抽吸输送至嘴角。
bodyParts.descEn: A complex network of microscopic grooves between scales that draws water from any part of the body straight to the mouth via capillary action.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 只要把后脚泡在一小滴水洼里，短短几秒钟水流就会顺着表皮一直爬到嘴唇，仿佛身体自带抽水泵！
bodyParts.funFactEn: If it steps in a puddle with just its hind feet, water travels up its skin against gravity right into its mouth within seconds!

bodyParts.pinyin: qīn shuǐ zhuī xíng jiǎo zhì dùn cì
bodyParts.descZh: 全身覆盖粗大坚硬的锥形角质尖刺，除了让蛇和鸟类无法下咽外，清晨还能充当冷凝收集塔汇聚沙漠晨雾水汽。
bodyParts.descEn: Rigid, sharp conical spines covering its head and body. They deter predators from swallowing it and act as condensation points for desert fog.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 沙漠夜晚温差极大，空气中的微量湿气会首先凝结在它的刺尖上，随后滑入皮肤水沟中！
bodyParts.funFactEn: During cool desert nights, scarce moisture in the air condenses onto the spine tips and flows directly into the capillary channels!

bodyParts.pinyin: gāo sù tán shè nián yǐ shé
bodyParts.descZh: 细长且分泌强力粘液的舌头，能以极高频率向外弹射，精准把行进中的黑头小蚂蚁粘入口中，每分钟可进食多达 45 次。
bodyParts.descEn: A long, sticky tongue flicked out with remarkable speed, precision-targeting crawling ants at a rate of up to 45 flicks per minute.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 它们一天能轻松吃掉数千只小蚂蚁，吃饱一顿饭需要静静守在蚁道旁舔食好几个小时！
bodyParts.funFactEn: A thorny devil can devour thousands of ants in a single feeding session, patiently sitting alongside an ant trail for hours!

bodyParts.pinyin: nǐ tài yáo bǎi kū zhī bù tài
bodyParts.descZh: 行走时缓慢地向前迈一步再后退半步，身体左右轻轻摇晃，完美模拟被沙漠风吹拂的干枯落叶或刺灌木枝条。
bodyParts.descEn: A jerky, rocking forward-and-back walking motion that mimics dry desert shrubs swaying in the wind, confusing aerial predators.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这种慢动作摇摆步态极为逼真，天上的猛禽即使盘旋在头顶也很难将它与风中杂草区分开！
bodyParts.funFactEn: This robotic rocking rhythm is so deceptive that circling birds of prey mistake the lizard for wind-blown dry desert twigs!

bodyParts.pinyin: hóng zhě shā yán jiàn biàn bǎo hù sè
bodyParts.descZh: 表皮根据气温和日光强度会动态改变色调，在温暖白天呈淡金黄红赭色，在寒冷清晨转为深灰褐色吸收热量。
bodyParts.descEn: Skin that shifts between pale golden-yellow and dark ochre-brown, blending seamlessly with red desert sand while aiding thermal regulation.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 早晨气温低时它会变黑加快吸热升温，中午阳光酷烈时变亮反射阳光防止过热，是天然智能温控皮衣！
bodyParts.funFactEn: It darkens to soak up morning warmth, then lightens to reflect intense midday sunlight like an active temperature shield!

bodyParts.pinyin: péng zhàng dài cì fù jiǎ qì náng
bodyParts.descZh: 遭遇大型掠食动物威胁时，它会大口吸入空气将腹部胀大成一个带刺圆球，使自己体型增大数倍难以被咬合吞入。
bodyParts.descEn: When cornered, it gulps air to inflate its spiny torso into an oversized prickly ball that predators find impossible to bite or swallow.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 鼓成球状的刺角魔蜥就像一颗长满尖刺的坚硬坚果，连巨蜥也很难下嘴将其吞下！
bodyParts.funFactEn: An inflated thorny devil turns into a prickly fortress so difficult to grasp that even hungry monitor lizards give up!

bodyParts.pinyin: wā jué bì shǔ shā xué lì zhuǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 短小强健的四肢生有坚硬锐利的弯曲脚爪，能在几分钟内快速刨开灼热表层沙土，钻入几十厘米深的凉爽地下沙层。
bodyParts.descEn: Stout legs equipped with sharp, curved claws capable of rapidly excavating cool underground burrows to escape surface scorching heat.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在沙漠气温高达 45℃ 的炎夏午后，地表下 30 厘米的沙洞温度只有 28℃，十分凉爽惬意！
bodyParts.funFactEn: While desert surface sand can sizzle at 45°C, just a foot underground the temperature stays a comfortable 28°C!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 刺角魔蜥不需要低头喝水，哪怕只把脚踩在湿沙里也能喝到水，依靠的是身体哪个神奇结构？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What unique physical feature allows the thorny devil to drink water drawn up through its skin without bowing its head?

options.textZh: 毛细微米汲水吸管沟纹

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 刺角魔蜥皮肤鳞片之间布满微米级毛细管凹槽，能利用物理毛细吸力逆着重力把水直接吸到嘴里！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Microscopic capillary channels between its scales pump water straight from moist ground to its mouth!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 当遇到天敌猛烈攻击时，刺角魔蜥会低头把真正的头藏起来，展示出哪个部位来欺骗敌人？
quizQuestions.promptEn: When attacked, what feature does the thorny devil present to fool predators while tucking away its real head?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 它颈部后面长有带刺的大肉瘤假头，不仅满布棘刺很难吞咽，还能诱使敌人咬错地方保护真头！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Its neck bears a spiny false head that tricks attackers into targeting a non-vital, hard-to-swallow decoy!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 刺角魔蜥在野外最主要、甚至是唯一的食物来源是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: What is the primary, almost exclusive prey of the thorny devil in the Australian wild?

options.textZh: 专吃小蚂蚁（高速粘蚁舌）

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 刺角魔蜥是专性蚁食动物，一条细长的粘舌一顿饭能快速吞食数千只特定品种的小蚂蚁！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Thorny devils are ant specialists, flicking their sticky tongue thousands of times per meal to harvest tiny ants!

nicknameZh: 撒哈拉的金色飞毛腿与终生免饮奇迹
nicknameEn: The Golden Sahara Sprinter & Waterless Miracle
length: 肩高 55 - 65 cm / 体长 90 - 110 cm / 体重 15 - 20 kg
lifespan: 野外约 12 - 15 年
food: 金合欢树嫩叶与豆荚、沙漠多肉植物、晨露润湿的耐旱草叶
habitat: 北非撒哈拉大沙漠、萨赫勒干旱灌丛及石质荒漠边缘
speed: 最高奔跑时速 80 - 90 km/h，垂直弹跳超 2 米
overviewZh: 多加瞪羚是撒哈拉沙漠中最具代表性的敏捷羚羊！它们优雅修长，全身披着如沙漠金沙般的浅黄皮毛。在终年少雨、地表完全没有水塘的无垠荒漠中，多加瞪羚能够一辈子不喝一滴水！它们不仅能从所吃植物叶片中榨取微量水分，还拥有地球哺乳动物中最强悍的高浓缩肾脏，把排泄水分损失压制到极致。当察觉猎豹逼近时，它们能瞬间以近 90 公里时速如离弦之箭疾驰！
overviewEn: The Dorcas Gazelle is the graceful emblem of resilience in the Sahara Desert! Slender and swift, their pale sandy-buff coat matches the desert dunes. Miraculously, dorcas gazelles can survive their entire lives without drinking open water! They extract every drop of moisture from acacia foliage and succulents, backed by super-efficient kidneys that produce highly concentrated, crystal-like urine. When a cheetah stalks near, they explode into action at blistering speeds of up to 90 km/h!

bodyParts.pinyin: chāo qiáng shuǐ fèn huí shōu nóng suō shèn
bodyParts.descZh: 拥有极长的亨利氏套肾小管，能够极限重吸收原尿中 99% 以上的水分，将尿液高度浓缩成微量糊状晶体排出。
bodyParts.descEn: Extraordinarily elongated kidney tubules that reabsorb over 99% of filtered water, voiding urine as dense, paste-like crystals.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 多加瞪羚不仅尿液浓缩如糊，排出的粪便也干燥得如压缩木炭颗粒，几乎没有浪费一滴体液！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Their water recycling is so complete that their dung pellets are bone-dry, like compressed sawdust!

bodyParts.pinyin: shuāng qū huán líng shù qín fáng wèi jiǎo
bodyParts.descZh: 雌雄皆长有优雅弯曲的竖琴形长角，角长达 25-38 厘米，表面布满防滑骨质环棱，用于抵御胡狼与同伴角力。
bodyParts.descEn: Gracefully curved horns shaped like an ancient lyre, 25-38 cm long with pronounced ridges, used for sparring and self-defense.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 角上的环形骨棱像汽车保险杠的加强筋一样坚韧，在高速撞击较量时能分散冲击力防止折断！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The raised rings strengthen the horn structure, distributing violent impact forces during intense mating duels!

bodyParts.nameZh: 弹簧储能超长肌腱细腿
bodyParts.pinyin: tán huáng chǔ néng chāo cháng jī jiàn xì tuǐ
bodyParts.descZh: 细长如竹竿的四肢包裹着强韧高弹性腱索，奔跑着地时像高强度弹簧一样存储能量，反弹释放时提供极高加速度。
bodyParts.descEn: Ultra-slender legs packed with elastic tendons that store kinetic energy upon impact and release it explosively like titanium springs.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 靠着这种天然弹性悬挂系统，它们不仅百米冲刺飞快，而且奔跑极其省力，能连续狂奔数公里甩脱猛兽！
bodyParts.funFactEn: This biological spring suspension makes galloping ultra-efficient, allowing them to sustain high speeds for miles!

bodyParts.pinyin: sì tí téng kōng jǐng bào tán tiào
bodyParts.descZh: 发现敌人时四蹄笔直绷紧、高高腾空跃起（Stotting），同时露出臀部雪白醒目的毛束，向同伴发出危险警报。
bodyParts.descEn: A rigid-legged leaping display called 'stotting,' bouncing high into the air while flashing bright white rump patches to warn the herd.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这种夸张的弹跳其实也是在对捕食者炫耀实力：“我精力充沛弹跳惊人，你追不上我的，别费力气了！”
bodyParts.funFactEn: Stotting signals to predators: 'I am young, fit, and agile—chasing me is a waste of your energy!'

bodyParts.pinyin: shā jīn sè fǎn guāng gé rè pí máo
bodyParts.descZh: 背部沙黄淡金色的毛发光滑致密，能反射沙漠中强烈的阳光辐射，腹部纯白毛皮则阻隔来自滚烫地面的热辐射。
bodyParts.descEn: Dense, sleek pale-fawn fur that reflects harsh solar rays on top, paired with a snow-white belly that insulates against ground heat.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 多加瞪羚站在沙丘上时，沙色毛皮能产生视觉虚化效果，距离稍远就如同在热浪空气中凭空消失！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Against golden dunes, their color creates an optical illusion that causes them to blend into shimmering heat mirages!

bodyParts.pinyin: mí gōng jiàng wēn lěng níng bí jiǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 鼻腔内拥有精密卷曲的鼻甲骨黏膜网络，在快速呼吸时使呼出的湿热废气迅速降温，让水分重新冷凝回体内，并冷却流向大脑的动脉血。
bodyParts.descEn: Intricately folded nasal membranes that condense moisture from exhaled air and cool arterial blood heading to the brain.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 通过鼻腔的微型“热交换器”，流经大脑的血液温度可比身体核心温度低整整 3℃，防止狂奔时大脑过热！
bodyParts.funFactEn: This biological radiator cools brain-bound blood by up to 3°C, protecting the brain even during full sprints in 45°C heat!

bodyParts.pinyin: fáng huá tán xìng shuāng bàn tí zhǎng
bodyParts.descZh: 蹄壳坚韧且可适当向两侧展开，着地时扩大受力面积防止陷入松散沙层，坚硬的蹄尖能抓牢陡峭的碎石山坡。
bodyParts.descEn: Tough, cloven hooves that splay slightly on impact to distribute weight over soft sand, with sharp edges that grip rocky slopes.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 不论是在流沙沙丘还是锋利的火山碎石荒漠上，多加瞪羚都能以 80 公里时速急停变向，蹄子从不打滑！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Whether over shifting dunes or razor-sharp volcanic rubble, their hooves provide instantaneous traction at 80 km/h!

bodyParts.nameZh: 全景广角警惕横瞳大眼
bodyParts.pinyin: quán jǐng guǎng jiǎo jǐng tì héng tóng dà yǎn
bodyParts.descZh: 长在头部两侧的大眼睛拥有横向缝隙状瞳孔，提供超过 320 度的开阔水平视野，即使低头啃草也能看清后方动静。
bodyParts.descEn: Large, dark eyes set on the sides of the head with horizontal slit pupils, granting an unobstructed 320-degree panoramic field of vision.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 横向瞳孔就像宽银幕电影摄像机，能始终与地平线保持平行，在开阔荒漠上数百米外就能发现潜行猎豹的耳朵！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Horizontal slit pupils rotate to remain level with the horizon, spotting a crouching cheetah's ears hundreds of meters away!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 多加瞪羚能一辈子不喝地表水依然在极度干旱的撒哈拉生存，依靠的是身体哪个器官极限节水？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What internal organ allows the dorcas gazelle to live without drinking surface water by recycling virtually all fluid?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 多加瞪羚拥有超强浓缩肾脏，能回收 99% 的水分，将尿液浓缩成晶体状，完全靠植物水分生存！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Its hyper-efficient kidneys recycle over 99% of body water, excreting concentrated uric crystals instead of liquid urine!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 多加瞪羚发现猎豹或豺狼时，四蹄绷直腾空高高跃起并露出白尾的警报行为称作什么？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What is the specialized leaping warning display called when the gazelle bounces stiff-legged into the air?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 这种被称为 Stotting 的弹跳不仅能警示同伴，还能向猎豹展示自己极佳的体能，促使捕食者放弃追逐！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Stotting alerts the herd while proving superior stamina to predators, often persuading them not to give chase!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 多加瞪羚即使低着头吃地上的金合欢嫩叶，也能同时看清身后悄悄靠近的敌人，秘密在于：
quizQuestions.promptEn: How can the dorcas gazelle keep an eye on predators approaching from behind even while grazing with its head down?

options.textZh: 全景广角警惕横瞳大眼

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 横向瞳孔与侧置眼位提供了超过 320 度的全景视野，低头吃草时瞳孔会自动旋转与地面平行看清后方！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Its horizontal pupils and side-facing eye sockets provide panoramic vision covering over 320 degrees at all times!

nicknameZh: 荒漠地下特工与长腿奔跑猫头鹰
nicknameEn: The Desert Underground Agent & Long-Legged Running Owl
lifespan: 野外约 6 - 8 年
food: 沙漠甲虫、蝗虫、蝎子、蜈蚣、小型沙鼠与沙漠蜥蜴
habitat: 美洲干燥草原、沙漠边缘旷野、废弃土拨鼠或地松鼠地穴
speed: 地面奔跑敏捷如小鸡，低空飞行约 40 km/h
overviewZh: 穴居鸮是猫头鹰家族中独树一帜的“反传统奇兵”！绝大多数猫头鹰生活在高耸树上并在黑夜出动，而穴居鸮却选择生活在干燥沙漠的地底下，并且喜欢在阳光明媚的白天站在洞口站岗！它们长着一双如同踩着高跷的超长细腿，在地上追捕甲虫时奔跑如飞。当危险敌人钻入地洞时，它们甚至能模仿致命响尾蛇的恐怖嘶鸣声，把入侵者吓得魂飞魄散！
overviewEn: The Burrowing Owl is the ultimate rule-breaker of the owl family! While most owls dwell high in trees and hunt under cover of darkness, burrowing owls live underground in arid desert burrows and actively forage in broad daylight! Standing tall on stilt-like yellow legs, they can sprint across dry dirt like miniature roadrunners. When an intruder approaches their underground nest, the owls unleash a spine-chilling acoustic mimicry of a venomous rattlesnake to send the predator running!

bodyParts.pinyin: mó fǎng xiǎng wěi shé zhèn shè míng guǎn
bodyParts.descZh: 雏鸟与成鸟在洞穴中感到危险威胁时，能从鸣管发出极度逼真的响尾蛇尾环高频“嘶嘶”尖响，令天敌误以为钻进了蛇窟。
bodyParts.descEn: When trapped in darkness underground, chicks and adults emit a terrifyingly accurate mimicry of a venomous rattlesnake's buzzing rattle.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这种绝技是自然界最著名的声学拟态之一，连獾、狐狸和土狼听到这刺耳嘶鸣都会吓得立刻退出洞穴！
bodyParts.funFactEn: One of nature's best acoustic mimicries—badgers, foxes, and coyotes immediately retreat fearing a lethal snakebite!

bodyParts.pinyin: gāo qiāo liè chóng cháng pǎo shuāng tuǐ
bodyParts.descZh: 拥有猫头鹰中比例最长的小腿骨，裸露少毛利于在地面草丛和沙地间快速奔跑，追逐捕食敏捷的沙漠甲虫与蜥蜴。
bodyParts.descEn: Unusually long, bare lower legs that enable rapid terrestrial running to chase down ground insects, scorpions, and lizards.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 它们抓虫子时常常懒得飞，而是像一群调皮的小陆禽一样在荒漠上迈着大长腿狂奔追赶！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Instead of swooping down, they often prefer sprinting on foot across the dirt like miniature roadrunners to catch bugs!

bodyParts.nameZh: 白昼防眩金色大眼与遮阳眉棱
bodyParts.pinyin: bái zhòu fáng xuàn jīn sè dà yǎn
bodyParts.descZh: 硕大的金黄色大眼睛上方长有凸出的骨质白眉，像天然棒球帽檐一样遮挡刺眼的沙漠日光，在正午强光下视野依然清晰锐利。
bodyParts.descEn: Striking bright yellow eyes crowned with prominent white brow feathers acting as sun visors against bright desert sunlight.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 它们的大眼睛几乎没有盲区，但眼球固定在眼眶里无法转动，全靠灵活的脖子看清四周！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Their eyes cannot move within their sockets, so they rely on high-mobility neck swiveling to track targets!

bodyParts.pinyin: yuán hú dī fēng zǔ zuān dì yì
bodyParts.descZh: 翅膀紧凑圆润，边缘羽毛消音柔软，既能在贴近沙丘地表数十厘米处无声超低空掠过，又能在缩拢时顺畅穿行狭小地洞。
bodyParts.descEn: Short, rounded wings tailored for stealthy low-level skimming over desert flats and easy maneuvering within narrow underground tunnels.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在洞口起飞时，它们能几乎垂直向上弹射飞出，并在空中悬停观察地面猎物！
bodyParts.funFactEn: They can launch almost vertically from burrow mouths and briefly hover in place to survey the surrounding sand!

bodyParts.pinyin: diāo fèn yòu chóng yīng gōu ruì huì
bodyParts.descZh: 坚硬锋利的下弯鹰钩嘴，它们会巧妙叼取牛马粪便或野兽干粪堆放在洞口，利用气味吸引大批美味的蜣螂甲虫自投罗网。
bodyParts.descEn: A sharp, hooked bill used not only to tear prey, but remarkably to collect dried manure around its burrow to attract dung beetles.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这是鸟类中极罕见的“使用工具诱饵捕食”的高智商行为，洞口摆放的粪堆就像它们的天然外卖送餐点！
bodyParts.funFactEn: One of the few birds that uses 'bait fishing' tactics on land—the manure attracts hundreds of delicious beetles straight to their door!

bodyParts.pinyin: tī tǔ kuò xué jué dì wān zhuǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 脚趾生有坚韧利爪与防滑角质突起，虽然经常借住废弃兽穴，但它们会用脚爪向后大力踢沙，把地洞扩建得深达数米。
bodyParts.descEn: Sharp, dexterous claws used to kick dirt backward like a miniature backhoe, renovating and expanding underground chambers up to several meters deep.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 挖掘时它们一边用喙啄松硬土，一边用双爪像小推土机一样把沙石踢出洞外，干起工程来毫不含糊！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Working like miniature backhoes, they peck hard soil loose with their beaks and kick the debris backward out of the entrance!

bodyParts.pinyin: suì shí bān bó mí cǎi yǔ yī
bodyParts.descZh: 全身羽毛呈灰棕褐色并点缀着密集的白色斑点，低头静止站在荒漠碎石堆旁时与干燥泥土和砾石浑然一体。
bodyParts.descEn: Dense plumage of mottled earthy-browns spotted with buff-white streaks, flawlessly mimicking dry soil and gravel outcroppings.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 一旦发现天空中有红尾鵟等大型猛禽，它们会立刻缩起脖子紧贴地面，瞬间在开阔沙地上“隐形”！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Spotting a hawk high in the sky, they crouch flat against the gravel, melting instantly into the open landscape!

bodyParts.pinyin: shàng xià diǎn tóu cè jù jǐng zhuī
bodyParts.descZh: 拥有多达 14 块高度灵活的颈椎骨，头部不仅能旋转 270 度，还经常滑稽地快速上下点头（Bobbing），利用双目视差精准计算猎物距离。
bodyParts.descEn: High-mobility neck vertebrae permitting 270-degree rotation and comical rapid head-bobbing used to calculate precise stereoscopic distance to prey.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 穴居鸮滑稽的“点头鞠躬舞”并不是在打招呼，而是在用大脑高级光学三角测距锁定几十米外的小蚱蜢！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Their hilarious bobbing dance isn't for fun—it's high-tech optical triangulation calculating the exact distance to a grasshopper!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 穴居鸮在地洞中遇到危险侵犯时，能发出哪种致命沙漠动物的逼真声音把敌人吓跑？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What deadly desert creature does the burrowing owl imitate acoustically to scare predators out of its tunnel?

options.textZh: 剧毒响尾蛇的嘶鸣振响

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 穴居鸮具有自然界高超的声学拟态本领，能发出与响尾蛇尾环振动完全一致的刺耳嘶声，把土狼和獾吓跑！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: They emit a perfect acoustic mimicry of a buzzing rattlesnake, tricking badgers and coyotes into fleeing!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 穴居鸮抓小虫子时经常懒得飞，而是依靠什么身体特征在荒漠地面上狂奔追赶？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What unusual physical feature allows burrowing owls to sprint after crawling insects like little roadrunners?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 与绝大多数短腿树栖猫头鹰不同，穴居鸮长着如同踩高跷的修长小腿，在地上奔跑如飞！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Unlike other short-legged owls, burrowing owls sport elongated stilt-legs adapted for rapid terrestrial sprinting!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 穴居鸮经常在洞口滑稽地上下点头（Bobbing），它的真实科学目的是什么？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What is the true biological function when a burrowing owl humorously bobs its head up and down?

options.textZh: 立体视差精准光学测距

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 因为猫头鹰眼球无法转动，它们通过快速改变头部高度利用双眼视差进行精准的三维距离三角测量！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Since owl eyes cannot rotate, bobbing allows them to use parallax motion to triangulate 3D distance to prey!

nicknameZh: 潘帕斯荒漠装甲哭包与沙层潜水员
nicknameEn: The Armored Screamer of Pampa & Sand Diver
length: 体长 22 - 40 cm / 尾长 9 - 15 cm / 体重 0.8 - 1.2 kg
lifespan: 野外约 10 - 15 年
food: 沙土甲虫幼虫、蝎子、植物多汁块茎、种子、小型蜥蜴与腐肉
habitat: 南美阿根廷、玻利维亚的大查科干旱灌丛、荒漠沙丘与低降雨量沙原
speed: 沙地冲刺敏捷，掘地潜沙只需 3 秒完全隐没
overviewZh: 大号哭犰狳是南美洲干旱荒原中最具戏剧性的“装甲萌物”！它们全身披着坚韧灵活的带状骨质铠甲，并在甲壳缝隙间长着蓬松的长硬毛。当被天敌或者人类抓起时，它们会像哭闹的婴儿一样发出极其尖锐刺耳、高分贝的凄厉号叫，常常能当场把捕食者吓得不知所措！同时它们还是不可思议的“沙海潜水员”，前肢生有一对强壮的铲状铁爪，能在 3 秒钟内挖开沙地消失在地下！
overviewEn: The Screaming Hairy Armadillo is the drama star of South America's arid scrublands! Covered in flexible bony armor shields interspersed with long bristly hairs, this fascinating creature boasts a hilarious defense: when captured, it emits a shockingly loud, shrill, baby-like crying scream that startles predators into dropping it! In addition to its acoustic alarm, it is an elite 'sand diver' armed with mighty digging claws capable of tunneling underground in three seconds flat!

bodyParts.nameZh: 惊退天敌凄厉哭叫声囊
bodyParts.pinyin: qī lì kū jiào shēng náng
bodyParts.descZh: 特化的声带与喉部声囊，在被捕食者抓握或按压时能爆发出高达 90 分贝的尖锐凄厉哭啼声，令敌人惊慌松口。
bodyParts.descEn: Specialized vocal cords that produce an ear-splitting, high-pitched scream mimicking a wailing infant when grasped by a predator.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这种凄厉的尖叫常常能把好奇靠近的猎狗或胡狼吓退好几步，以为自己抓到了什么恐怖的未知怪兽！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The deafening wail often startles hunting dogs and coyotes so severely that they drop the armadillo in confusion!

bodyParts.nameZh: 披拂长硬毛灵活分节骨甲
bodyParts.pinyin: pī fú zhǎng yìng máo fēn jié gǔ jiǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 由 18 块带状骨板构成，中间 6-8 条活动铰链赋予身体极佳的弯曲柔韧性，骨板间长出浓密硬毛抵御寒夜与沙尘磨损。
bodyParts.descEn: An armor shield composed of 18 bony bands with flexible joints, laced with long protective hairs that guard against desert chills and sand friction.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 普通犰狳身上光秃秃的，而哭犰狳却披着像胡须一样的灰色长毛，在严寒的荒原冬夜能抵御零下低温！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Unlike naked armadillos, its coat of long shaggy hair traps warm air to endure freezing desert winter nights!

bodyParts.pinyin: sān miǎo qián shā jù xíng tiě chǎn zhòng zhuǎ
bodyParts.descZh: 前肢长有宽厚如铁铲的弯曲巨爪，配合强大的肩胸肌群，能在坚硬黏土沙地中以惊人速度向下挖掘，几秒内全身钻入沙中。
bodyParts.descEn: Massive spade-like curved claws driven by powerful shoulder muscles, capable of digging through hard packed sand in mere seconds.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 如果有人在平地上试图抓住它，它会像跳水运动员一样瞬间垂直“潜入”沙土，只留下扬起的沙尘！
bodyParts.funFactEn: If pursued on flat sand, it dives headfirst into the ground, completely vanishing beneath the surface in under three seconds!

bodyParts.nameZh: 坚硬破土三角形防撞头盾
bodyParts.pinyin: jiān yìng pò tǔ sān jiǎo xíng tóu dùn
bodyParts.descZh: 头顶覆盖三角形坚韧骨板护盾，钻洞时既能保护眼睛和大脑免受岩石撞击，又能充当破土推土铲破开硬土层。
bodyParts.descEn: A rigid triangular plate of dermal bone covering the head, functioning as a bulldozer blade to push away rocks and soil.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 钻进洞穴后，它会用坚硬的骨盾顶住洞壁死死卡住，任何猛兽从后面拉都无法将它拔出来！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Once inside a burrow, it wedges its triangular head armor firmly against the tunnel roof, locking itself immovably in place!

bodyParts.pinyin: sǎo píng shā jì jiǎo liàn zhuāng jiǎ wěi
bodyParts.descZh: 尾部由 6-8 节覆瓦状骨环完整保护，钻入洞穴后能像小扫帚一样扫平沙土隐匿洞口痕迹，并形成坚实后防盾牌。
bodyParts.descEn: An armored tail covered with overlapping bony rings that sweeps loose sand to conceal burrow entrances while shielding the rear.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 装甲尾巴还具有温度调节功能，通过分布在骨环缝隙间的血管网络在夜间散去白天积累的多余体热！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Blood vessels between the tail segments also help dissipate excess body heat during cool desert evenings!

bodyParts.nameZh: 防沙微孔可闭合呼吸鼻
bodyParts.pinyin: fáng shā kě bì hé hū xī bí
bodyParts.descZh: 鼻孔周围生有特殊的肌肉括约肌与密集的滤沙绒毛，在快速剧烈掘地潜沙时能瞬间紧闭，防止粉尘吸入呼吸道。
bodyParts.descEn: Nostrils encircled by muscular sphincters and protective bristles that seal airtight while tunneling through powdery sand.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 即使整张脸完全埋在沙尘暴或沙层中数分钟，它的封闭呼吸道也能确保一点沙子都不吸进肺里！
bodyParts.funFactEn: It can dig continuously through choking dust for minutes without a single grain entering its respiratory system!

bodyParts.nameZh: 耐旱微量代谢节水生理
bodyParts.pinyin: nài hàn jié shuǐ wēi liàng dài xiè
bodyParts.descZh: 基础新陈代谢率仅为同等体型哺乳动物的一半，极低的新陈代谢减少了呼吸散热导致的水分蒸发，极度耐渴。
bodyParts.descEn: A basal metabolic rate roughly half that of typical mammals, minimizing respiratory water evaporation during intense drought.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 在长达数月的干旱旱季里，它完全依靠挖掘植物多汁的根茎和昆虫幼虫来获取所需全部水分！
bodyParts.funFactEn: During months of severe drought, it stays completely hydrated solely from the juicy beetle larvae and tubers it digs up!

bodyParts.nameZh: 探寻地下块茎敏锐鼻吻
bodyParts.pinyin: tàn xún kuài jīng mǐn ruì bí wěn
bodyParts.descZh: 扁平铲状且布满触觉神经与灵敏嗅觉细胞的鼻吻，能贴地嗅出深埋沙下 20 厘米处的昆虫幼虫和富水块茎。
bodyParts.descEn: A shovel-shaped snout rich in tactile receptors and olfactory nerves, capable of pinpointing grubs and tubers buried 20 cm underground.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 它的嗅觉极其敏锐，在沙地上慢跑时只要闻到沙子底下有甲虫蛹，便会立刻原地刨坑精准捕获！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Its sense of smell is so sharp it can detect a sleeping grub buried nearly a foot deep simply by sniffing the surface sand!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 大号哭犰狳为什么被称为“哭犰狳”？它受到惊吓时会做出什么不可思议的举动？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Why is the screaming hairy armadillo named 'screaming'? What bizarre defense does it display when captured?

options.textZh: 发出如婴儿般凄厉尖锐的号哭尖叫

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 大号哭犰狳受惊时能发出高达 90 分贝如婴儿号哭的尖锐惨叫，往往能当场把捕食者吓得松口！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: It emits a piercing infant-like scream reaching 90 decibels, often startling predators into releasing it immediately!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 当在平坦沙地上被追赶时，大号哭犰狳能利用身体哪个强大武器在 3 秒钟内潜入地下？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What powerful anatomical tool allows this armadillo to dive underground within 3 seconds when chased?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 它前肢长有强壮的弯曲铁铲重爪，能在坚硬沙地上瞬间刨土，几秒钟就能完全隐没在沙层之下！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Its massive curved spade-like claws dig furiously, allowing the armadillo to submerge beneath the sand in 3 seconds!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 与其他光溜溜的犰狳不同，大号哭犰狳背甲缝隙中长满了蓬松长硬毛，这有什么生存妙用？
quizQuestions.promptEn: Unlike naked armadillo species, what is the survival advantage of the long bristly hair growing from its shell?

options.textZh: 在寒冷荒原冬夜保暖并防沙尘磨损

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 它长满长硬毛的背甲能有效锁住体温，帮助它安然度过南美荒漠零下低温的严寒冬夜！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Its shaggy bristly hairs insulate against sub-zero winter chills in the harsh arid Argentine scrublands!

nicknameZh: 撒哈拉的超能微型袋鼠与弹簧跳远王
nicknameEn: The Sahara Pocket Kangaroo & Spring Jump Champion
length: 体长 10 - 12 cm / 尾长 16 - 22 cm / 体重 45 - 75 g (掌心大小！)
lifespan: 野外约 4 - 6 年
food: 荒漠植物干种子、草根、多肉芽苞、沙柳嫩枝与偶尔抓食的小昆虫
habitat: 北非撒哈拉大沙漠、阿拉伯半岛流动沙丘与坚硬盐泥漠
speed: 腾跃时速高达 24 km/h，单次跳跃可达 3 米远、1 米高
overviewZh: 埃及跳鼠是撒哈拉沙漠中最不可思议的“掌心跳远冠军”！它们虽然体型只有手掌大小，却长着一双堪比微型袋鼠、长达体长 4 倍的超长弹簧后腿，只需轻轻一蹬就能腾空跃起 1 米多高、滑跃近 3 米远！它们终生不喝一滴水，完全依靠体内消化干燥种子的新陈代谢来制造生命所需的水分。长长的尾巴末端有一撮黑白相间的“羽毛球”，在空中闪电变向甩掉猛禽，是荒漠夜行大逃杀的绝对王者！
overviewEn: The Lesser Egyptian Jerboa is the Sahara's extraordinary pocket-sized kangaroo! Weighing just 50 grams, it commands spring-loaded hind legs four times the length of its torso, propelling it over a meter high and three meters far in a single explosive bound! Incredibly, it never drinks water in its entire life, generating all necessary hydration metabolically from the dry seeds it digests. With a feathered rudder tail that executes mid-air jukes against hunting owls, it rules the desert night!

bodyParts.pinyin: sān zhǐ tán huáng wēi xíng dài shǔ tuǐ
bodyParts.descZh: 跖骨高度融合形成一体化天然弹簧骨骼，仅保留 3 个着地趾，奔跑时以后足交替或双足同时大跳，时速达 24 km/h。
bodyParts.descEn: Fused cannon bones forming an integrated biomechanical spring with only three functional toes, rocketing the jerboa across dunes at 24 km/h.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 按身体比例换算，如果人类拥有跳鼠的弹跳力，能一口气跳上三层楼高、跨越半个足球场！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Scaled to human proportions, a jerboa's jump would clear a three-story building and half a football field!

bodyParts.nameZh: 黑白羽毛球空中转向舵长尾
bodyParts.pinyin: kōng zhōng zhuǎn xiàng duò cháng wěi
bodyParts.descZh: 尾长是身长的两倍，末端生有一丛显眼的黑白双色毛簇，高速腾空时充当空气动力学方向舵，能瞬间完成 90 度折线转向。
bodyParts.descEn: A slender tail twice the length of its body tipped with a dramatic black-and-white brush, serving as an aerodynamic rudder for mid-air 90° zig-zags.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 当猫头鹰自以为抓准路线俯冲扑来时，跳鼠尾巴猛地一甩便在空中横向飘移变轨，让猛禽扑空撞进沙里！
bodyParts.funFactEn: When an owl swoops down, the jerboa flicks its tail to pull a violent mid-air drift, leaving the owl slamming into empty sand!

bodyParts.nameZh: 防陷流沙硬毛雪鞋足底
bodyParts.pinyin: yìng máo xuě xié zú dǐ
bodyParts.descZh: 脚趾下侧生长着如刷子般极其浓密坚硬的横向刷毛，极大增加受力面积防止陷入松散流沙，并阻隔滚烫沙温。
bodyParts.descEn: Dense, stiff bristles fringing the underside of each toe that function like snowshoes, spreading weight over powdery dunes without sinking.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这些毛刷足垫非常轻便，在沙地上奔跑时完全不留深脚印，身轻如燕如履平地！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The bristly snowshoes leave almost zero footprint on loose shifting dunes, allowing frictionless gliding!

bodyParts.nameZh: 黑暗地道超长声呐触须丛
bodyParts.pinyin: chāo cháng shēng nà chù xū cóng
bodyParts.descZh: 脸颊两侧长着几乎与整个身体一样长的密集触须，毛囊基部密布机械感受器，在漆黑曲折的地下迷宫洞穴中无光导航。
bodyParts.descEn: An astonishing array of whiskers nearly as long as the entire animal, packed with nerve sensors for tactile 3D navigation in pitch-black tunnels.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 触须稍有微弱气流拂过它就能感知洞壁形状，即使全黑地道也能以极速穿梭从不撞头！
bodyParts.funFactEn: They can sense faint air currents bouncing off tunnel walls, sprinting through pitch-dark labyrinths without touching the sides!

bodyParts.nameZh: 聚光夜视黑色超大萌眼
bodyParts.pinyin: jù guāng yè shì hēi sè dà yǎn
bodyParts.descZh: 按头部比例极度巨大的深黑眼睛，拥有超大瞳孔与高密度视杆细胞，在微弱星光或月色下就能清晰洞察数十米外的危险潜伏。
bodyParts.descEn: Enormous, round dark eyes packed with rod photoreceptors and oversized pupils, capturing every photon under dim desert starlight.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 大眼睛具有极宽的广角后视能力，在地面埋头啃种子时，不用转头就能看见头顶上方悄然滑翔的猫头鹰阴影！
bodyParts.funFactEn: Their wide spherical vision detects owl shadows swooping directly from above without needing to lift their head from seeds!

bodyParts.pinyin: dòng mén tuī tǔ mì fēng duǎn wěn
bodyParts.descZh: 坚固圆钝的鼻吻部配合小前足，在清晨钻入地洞入眠前能快速用湿润沙土将洞口严密封死（Plug），隔绝白天外界 50℃ 热浪并锁住洞内湿度。
bodyParts.descEn: A stout, muscular snout used like a trowel to ram loose sand into an airtight plug, sealing the burrow entrance against 50°C daytime desert heat.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 封死洞口后，地洞内温度常年保持在凉爽舒适的 20-25℃，还能防止沙蛇趁它睡觉时溜进洞穴！
bodyParts.funFactEn: The sand plug keeps the underground nursery at a cool 20-25°C while barring desert vipers from slithering in!

bodyParts.nameZh: 内生代谢水全自给节水内脏
bodyParts.pinyin: nèi shēng dài xiè shuǐ nèi zàng
bodyParts.descZh: 终生完全不喝一滴水，体内拥有神奇的碳水化合物氧化机制，消化一克干燥种子可转化为自身所需的宝贵代谢水，且无汗腺绝不流汗。
bodyParts.descEn: Possesses a miracle metabolism that extracts pure hydration by breaking down dry seeds, with zero sweat glands and hyper-dense urine output.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 如果把它放在装满水碗的笼子里，它甚至不知道水是用来喝的，完全靠一颗颗小干谷粒就能健康生活一辈子！
bodyParts.funFactEn: If offered a bowl of water in captivity, it doesn't even recognize it as a drink—dry seeds supply 100% of its life needs!

bodyParts.descZh: 比普通老鼠大数倍的薄耳，几近透明且密布毛细血管，除了敏锐倾听沙蛇滑行的极细微沙沙声外，在凉爽夜风中充当散热排风机。
bodyParts.descEn: Delicate, oversized translucent ears mapped with dense capillaries that vent body heat into cool night breezes while tuning in to viper movements.
bodyParts.funFactZh: 这对大耳朵不仅散热灵敏，睡觉时还能向前折叠紧贴头部，防止沙粒钻入耳道！
bodyParts.funFactEn: They can fold their delicate paper-thin ears flat against their head while sleeping to keep desert sand out of the ear canals!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 埃及跳鼠虽然只有巴掌大，却能一口气跳起1米多高、跳跃3米远，依靠的是身体哪个部位？
quizQuestions.promptEn: What body feature gives the tiny Egyptian jerboa the explosive power to leap 1 meter high and 3 meters far?
quizQuestions.explanationZh: 它的后腿长达体长的 4 倍，融合的足骨构成强大的生物弹簧，弹跳力惊人！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Its fused hind legs are four times its body length, acting like biological springboards to launch it over 3 meters!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 埃及跳鼠在空中高速腾跃时，遭遇猫头鹰俯冲扑击能瞬间完成90度空中变轨转向，依靠的是：
quizQuestions.promptEn: How does the jerboa execute sudden mid-air jukes and 90-degree turns to evade hunting owls?

options.textZh: 黑白羽毛球空中转向舵长尾

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 它长达两倍体长的尾巴末端有一撮黑白毛簇，在空中像方向舵一样挥动，能瞬间改变飞行轨迹避开猛禽！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: Its brush-tipped tail acts as an aerodynamic rudder, allowing it to sharply drift sideways in mid-air!

quizQuestions.promptZh: 埃及跳鼠在极度缺水的沙漠中一辈子不喝一滴水也能生存，它的水分来自哪里？
quizQuestions.promptEn: How does the Egyptian jerboa survive its entire life in bone-dry deserts without ever drinking water?

options.textZh: 体内分解消化干燥种子生成的内生代谢水
options.textEn: Metabolic Water from Digesting Dry Seeds

options.textZh: 挖到地底下的地下暗河

quizQuestions.explanationZh: 埃及跳鼠体内拥有极强的生物化学氧化能力，仅靠消化干燥种子中的碳水化合物就能自主合成生命所需的水分！
quizQuestions.explanationEn: It synthesizes metabolic water internally through cellular oxidation of carbohydrates in dry seeds!
